Its product lineup spans QD-COB and QD-COB Pro Series panels for large-format commercial and home-theater displays and the T-Series monolithic full-color micro-displays for all-day wearable AR eyewear and AI smart glasses. Saphlux is a semiconductor materials and display-module manufacturer that sells hardware to OEMs and display integrators; it publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK.

providers.name: TRIDITIVE
providers.description: TRIDITIVE is an automated additive manufacturing company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Meres, Asturias, Spain, with offices in Hartford, Connecticut and London. It builds the AMCELL family of automated industrial 3D printing machines (Amcell 1300, 4300, 8300, Bulkam), the Traced traceability system, and the EVAM Software platform for additive manufacturing workflow management, digital warehousing, and on-demand production of polymer and metal parts. A Techstars portfolio company, TRIDITIVE publishes no public API, developer portal, or client SDKs as of July 2026.

providers.name: 5B Australia
providers.description: 5B is an Australian cleantech manufacturer that builds prefabricated, pre-wired ground-mount solar technology for utility-scale, mining, industrial and remote-community power projects. Founded in Sydney in 2013 by solar engineers Chris McGrath and Eden Tehan, the company designs and manufactures the 5B Maverick, an accordion-folded east-west solar array that is assembled in a factory and unfolded on site in under an hour rather than built panel by panel, cutting on-site labour by roughly 80% and roughly doubling energy yield per hectare compared with single-axis trackers. 5B manufactures in Adelaide, South Australia, with a global assembly model, and has deployed projects across Australia, the United States, Panama, Puerto Rico, El Salvador and Chile. 5B is a hardware and deployment-services company: as of this profile it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Aante
providers.description: Aante (爱安特) is a Chinese factory-automation (FA) parts distributor and one-stop industrial e-commerce procurement platform, operated by Aante (Changzhou) Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. (爱安特（常州）精密机械有限公司) and headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu. Established in 2002 as the successor to Sandi Automation, it sells linear motion, transmission, standard, machined, framing, motion-unit, electrical and pneumatic components across 96 product categories and roughly two million SKUs, distributing 30+ international brands including SMC and THK alongside its own Aante-branded line. It serves customers in semiconductors, new energy, 3C electronics, photovoltaics, LCD, automotive, medical and food manufacturing from three production bases and 30+ service centers, and in 2026 acquired software firm Zhuiguang Geometry to pair components with design software. The storefront at ant-fa.com is a Chinese-language Nuxt commerce site; no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract is published.

providers.name: Ball Corporation
providers.description: Ball Corporation is a global supplier of sustainable aluminum packaging for beverage, food, personal care, and household products, as well as aerospace and other technologies and services for commercial and government customers. Ball operates more than 80 manufacturing plants worldwide and is a leader in aluminum can sustainability and recycling.

providers.name: Cabot Corporation
providers.description: Cabot Corporation is a global specialty chemicals and performance materials company serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment, and consumer industries. The company's products include reinforcing carbons, specialty carbons, fumed silica, inkjet colorants, and engineered elastomer composites.

providers.name: Califia Farms
providers.description: Califia Farms, LLC is a Los Angeles, California based plant-based beverage company founded in 2010 by Greg Steltenpohl and named for the mythical Queen Califia. It manufactures and distributes non-dairy oatmilks, almondmilks and organic soymilks, coffee creamers, barista blends, cold brew coffees and teas, and ready-to-drink creamy refreshers, sold through grocery retail, foodservice distribution and direct-to-consumer channels across North America and Europe. Its public web presence is a marketing, recipe and where-to-buy site built on Gatsby and hosted on Netlify; the company publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Intrinsic
providers.description: Intrinsic is a Mountain View, California industrial robotics software company spun out of Alphabet's X "moonshot factory" and led by CEO Wendy Tan White. Its mission is to make industrial robots radically easier to program, use, and innovate with so that automation is accessible to a much broader range of businesses. Intrinsic's flagship product is Intrinsic Flowstate, an all-in-one web-based developer environment for designing, building, simulating, and deploying production-grade robotics solutions, paired with Intrinsic Intelligence — a portfolio of AI-powered capabilities including pose estimation, motion planning, grasp planning, and sensor-guided control — and IntrinsicOS, a robot operating system that spans cloud to edge. Developers extend Flowstate by writing Skills and Services in Python and C++ via the open-source Intrinsic SDK (Apache-2.0), or compose them visually via behavior trees in the Flowstate Process Editor. The platform integrates deeply with ROS through Intrinsic's 2022 acquisition of Open Source Robotics Corporation (OSRC) — the commercial arm of Open Robotics — while ROS, Gazebo, and Open-RMF stewardship remain with the independent OSRF non-profit. Flowstate is currently in a gated beta / trusted-tester program; production access is granted to enterprise customers, systems integrators, and participants in programs such as the AI for Industry Challenge. Pricing is not publicly disclosed and there is no self-service developer signup.

providers.name: MayMaan Research
providers.description: MayMaan Research is a clean-energy engineering company that redesigns the internal combustion engine around its patented AquaStroke platform, a piston engine that runs on a blend of roughly 70% water and 30% bio-alcohol (ethanol or methanol) instead of gasoline or diesel. The company builds modular generator sets and powertrains that scale from a 35 kW unit (A35) through the AV2 to multi-megawatt installations, and it positions them as drop-in replacements for diesel gensets in power generation, EV charging infrastructure, data centers, telecommunications, marine, construction, agriculture, defense and off-grid deployments, with near-zero NOx, SOx, CO2 and particulate output. MayMaan is headquartered in Hollywood, Florida with a European office in Paris, holds engine and fuel-system patents internationally, and raised a $30 million Series A led by WAVE Equity Partners. It is a hardware manufacturer: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Ohmium
providers.description: Ohmium International designs, manufactures and deploys modular, vertically-stackable proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzer systems for cost-competitive green hydrogen production. Its Lotus PEM electrolyzer platform integrates power electronics, water treatment and controls into skid-mounted modules for industrial, energy and mobility customers, and is paired with EPC and remote monitoring and maintenance (RM&M) services. Ohmium is a hardware and clean-energy engineering company: it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable specification, and its customer-facing monitoring and service portals are third-party SaaS products hosted on Ohmium subdomains behind login.

providers.name: Photoneo
providers.description: Photoneo is a Slovak (Bratislava, founded 2013) machine-vision company and a global pioneer of high-resolution structured-light 3D measurement. Its flagship products are the PhoXi 3D Scanner family and the MotionCam-3D, a parallel structured-light camera that captures moving scenes in real-time 3D, together with AI-enabled software such as Bin Picking Studio, Locator, and Palletizing for robotic automation. Rather than a hosted web/REST API, Photoneo exposes a developer surface through the PhoXi Control software and its official C++, C#, and Python device APIs, GenICam/GigE Vision standard connectivity, TCP/IP robot interfaces (UR, ABB, FANUC, Staubli, Mitsubishi, Kawasaki, Yaskawa), and a set of BSD-licensed example repositories on GitHub. Documentation lives in the Photoneo Knowledge Base (docs.photoneo.com) and the 3D scanning wiki. Photoneo (now part of the Brightpick Group) was acquired by Zebra Technologies.

providers.name: StoreDot
providers.description: StoreDot is an Israeli battery technology company founded in 2012 by Doron Myersdorf, Simon Litsyn and Gil Rosenman, headquartered in Herzliya with an advanced technology campus in Irvine, California. It develops extreme fast charging (XFC) lithium-ion cells built on proprietary silicon-dominant anode chemistry and synthesized organic and inorganic compounds optimized with machine-learning models, targeting the range and charging anxiety that gate mainstream electric-vehicle adoption. Its "100inX" product roadmap sets 100 miles of range charged in 5 minutes (100in5, 2024), 3 minutes (100in3, 2028) and 2 minutes (100in2, 2032); the company has demonstrated pouch and prismatic XFC cells sustaining more than 1,000 and later 2,000 extreme fast charging cycles while retaining over 80 percent of original capacity, and designs its chemistry to drop into existing Li-ion production lines. Strategic investors and partners include Daimler/Mercedes-Benz, BP, VinFast, Volvo, Polestar, Ola Electric, Samsung Ventures, TDK and manufacturing partner EVE Energy. In 2026 a planned SPAC merger with Andretti Acquisition Corp. II was terminated and the company returned to private fundraising. StoreDot is a hardware, materials and cell-manufacturing business: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server or machine-readable API contract, and no /.well-known/ discovery surface, llms.txt or developer subdomain resolves on store-dot.com.

providers.name: Twelve
providers.description: Twelve is a carbon transformation company that converts CO2, water, and renewable electricity into fuels and chemicals that serve as drop-in replacements for petroleum-based products. Its proprietary eManufacturing technology powers AirPlant One in Moses Lake, Washington, which produces E-Jet sustainable aviation fuel and E-Naphtha, while its eMade program partners with consumer brands on CO2-made materials. Investors include TPG, DCVC, Microsoft, Carbon Direct, Breakout Ventures, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. Twelve publishes no public developer API, but its Wix-hosted site exposes an llms.txt and a live site MCP endpoint for agentic access.

providers.name: Upwing Energy
providers.description: Upwing Energy is an energy technology company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Cerritos, California, with service operations near Houston, Texas, operating as an affiliate of Calnetix Technologies. It designs, manufactures and deploys the Subsurface Compressor System (SCS) — a downhole gas compressor installed up to two miles inside a natural gas well — along with Magnetic Drive Systems and the supporting high-speed permanent magnet motors, passive magnetic radial bearings, active magnetic thrust bearings, magnetic couplings and sensorless long-step-out variable speed drives that make it work. The company sells hardware and an end-to-end field service (planning and completions, deployment and startup, operations and monitoring, analysis and predictions) to natural gas operators worldwide, including deployments with Equinor, ENAP and operators across MENA and Central Asia. It publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: ZeroAvia
providers.description: ZeroAvia is a UK/US hydrogen-electric aviation company founded in 2017 by Valery Miftakhov, developing hydrogen fuel cell and electric propulsion systems for commercial aircraft. Its powertrain line runs from the ZA600 (600kW, 10-20 seat regional turboprops) through the ZA2000 (2-5MW, 40-80 seat turboprops) to the ZA2000 RJ (5MW+, up to 90 seat regional jets), alongside a component business selling electric propulsion systems, inverters, electric motors and HTPEM/SuperStack fuel cell stacks to other clean-aviation manufacturers, plus a hydrogen airport refuelling ecosystem of electrolyzers, mobile refuelers and LH2 development. It operates from Cotswold Airport in Kemble, UK and from Everett, Washington, and holds FAA and CAA experimental certificates for its flight-test aircraft. ZeroAvia sells certified aerospace hardware to airframers, airlines, lessors and defense customers; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: 4D Bios
providers.description: 4D Bios Co., Ltd. (四维生态, Hangzhou, China) is an ag-tech manufacturer of smart vertical-farming systems, founded in 2018 by Dr. Gary Hua. It designs and builds fully enclosed, digitally controlled plant factories — 3D, nursery, strawberry, leafy-greens and specialty lines — alongside containerized grow systems, indoor grow boxes, full-control planting equipment and LED horticultural lighting. The hardware is operated from the company's own software layer: the 4D Cloud Platform, the 4D CUBE MS management console and 4D BOX, which combine IoT telemetry, environmental and HVAC control, nutrient-solution circulation and big-data analytics for year-round continuous production. 4D Bios markets a "4D Bios Open Platform API" for customers who have already purchased its products and want to build their own software or hardware against the platform, and invites third-party platform service providers to develop applications on the Open Platform. That API has no public developer portal, reference, or machine-readable contract; the Open Platform and IoT consoles are login-gated single-page applications.

providers.name: actnano
providers.description: actnano, Inc. is a Massachusetts-based advanced materials company that develops and manufactures PFAS-free protective nanocoatings for electronics. Its flagship Advanced nanoGUARD technology is a gel-state, 100% fluorine-free conformal coating applied to printed circuit board assemblies, connectors, antennas, LEDs and high-heat-generating components, delivering up to IPx8 moisture and condensation protection without trapping heat or degrading signal integrity. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with a Munich center of excellence and operations in Mexico and Japan, actnano serves mobility and automotive electronics, consumer electronics, AI and data-center infrastructure, solar, industrial electronics, medical devices and optical anti-fog applications. The company states REACH and RoHS compliance and ISO 9001:2015 certification, and is backed by BMW i Ventures, Porsche Ventures and Emerald Technology Ventures. actnano is a materials manufacturer: it publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Antheia
providers.description: Antheia, Inc. is a Menlo Park, California synthetic-biology company that manufactures biosynthetic key starting materials (KSMs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for essential medicines. Founded on Christina Smolke's Stanford research, Antheia engineers yeast strains that reconstruct long, complex plant biosynthetic pathways and ferment sugar into molecules previously obtainable only through agricultural cultivation, compressing production timelines from years to weeks. Commercial products include fermentation-derived thebaine, oripavine and scopolamine, with a development pipeline of 70+ KSMs and APIs spanning neurology, gastrointestinal and oncology programs. NOTE FOR THE CATALOG: Antheia's "APIs" are Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, not web APIs — the company publishes no developer API, SDK, or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: Catena-X
providers.description: Catena-X is the automotive industry's data space standard, published by Catena-X Automotive Network e.V. — a non-commercial German registered association founded on 15 May 2021 by BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Bosch, SAP, Siemens, Schaeffler, ZF, BASF, Henkel, Deutsche Telekom and Fraunhofer, with backing from the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action. It publishes a numbered CX-xxxx library of 77 standards covering how a supply chain exchanges part data, carbon footprints, quality records, demand and capacity signals and digital product passports without any participant surrendering its data to a central platform. Standards move forward together in named releases — Jupiter, Io, Saturn, Titan — gated by a Technical Committee for Standardization, and conformance is certified by nominated third-party assessment bodies including TÜV Rheinland and TÜV SÜD. The reference implementation is open source as Eclipse Tractus-X, and the network is operated commercially by Cofinity-X. It is the most institutionally complete industry API standard in Europe, and the one whose endpoints an outside developer can never call: in a data space every participant runs its own connector and registry, so there is nothing to call until you are onboarded, credentialed and certified.

providers.name: EnPro Industries
providers.description: EnPro Industries is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The EnPro Industries API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Mettler-Toledo International
providers.description: Mettler-Toledo International is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Mettler-Toledo International API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Nordson Corporation
providers.description: Nordson Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Nordson Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Patrick Industries
providers.description: Patrick Industries is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Patrick Industries API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Quaker Houghton
providers.description: Quaker Houghton is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Quaker Houghton API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Regal Rexnord
providers.description: Regal Rexnord is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Regal Rexnord API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: RPM International
providers.description: RPM International Inc. is a multinational specialty coatings and sealants company headquartered in Medina, Ohio, with annual revenues of approximately $7.4 billion. RPM operates a portfolio of over 100 leading brands across three segments: Consumer (Rust-Oleum, DAP, Zinsser), Construction (Tremco, Dryvit, Flowcrete), and Performance Coatings (Carboline, Stonhard, Plasite). RPM International does not currently offer a public developer API, but its subsidiaries and brands serve the construction, maintenance, and protective coatings markets globally.

providers.name: Scimplify
providers.description: Scimplify is a Bengaluru-based advanced specialty chemicals company that combines deep chemical expertise, software, and global manufacturing capacity to make complex chemical supply predictable at scale. Founded in 2023, it operates as a contract research (CRO) and contract manufacturing (CMO) organization across the specialty-chemicals lifecycle, serving pharmaceutical, agrochemical, flavors & fragrances, industrial, beauty & personal care, food & nutrition, dyes & pigments, oleochemicals, flame retardants, and critical-metals industries. Its integrated Scinode platform, IONS R&D and ATOMS manufacturing ecosystems, and Scira AI agentic layer coordinate discovery, sourcing, and production. Scimplify publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its web, content, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Sensata Technologies
providers.description: Sensata Technologies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Sensata Technologies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Venwiz
providers.description: Venwiz is a Bengaluru, India based B2B digital platform for the procurement of industrial and infrastructural project services, covering both CapEx and MRO requirements for the manufacturing sector. Founded in 2020 by Rajesh Reddy and Sandesh Paturi, it operates a marketplace that connects industrial buyers with a verified, pan-India database of service vendors, adding vendor discovery, order expediting, project management tooling and vendor intelligence on top. Backed by Accel and other investors (~$11.4M raised), Venwiz digitises what has traditionally been an offline, relationship-driven industrial services procurement process. No public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDK, or documentation surface is published as of this enrichment pass; the public presence is a marketing/content website plus a login-gated application.

providers.name: Watts Water Technologies
providers.description: Watts Water Technologies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Watts Water Technologies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Cornerstone Robotics
providers.description: Cornerstone Robotics (CSR) is a Hong Kong-headquartered surgical robotics manufacturer founded in 2019 at Hong Kong Science Park, building the Sentire Endoscopic Surgical System (C1000) — a multi-specialty, minimally invasive robot-assisted surgery platform developed entirely in-house and indicated for general surgery, gynecology, thoracic and urology. The Sentire system has received regulatory clearance in China (NMPA), the European Union and Singapore, and has completed multicenter clinical trials in China and the United Kingdom. The company operates three global R&D hubs, six business centers and a 30,000 square meter manufacturing facility, and sells a regulated physical medical device rather than software: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Unspun
providers.description: Unspun is a fashion-technology company building Vega, the world's first 3D weaving machines, which transform yarn directly into finished woven garments in about twenty minutes for automated, localized, on-demand apparel manufacturing. Founded by Beth Esponnette, Walden Lam, and Kevin Martin and operating from Oakland, California and Hong Kong, the company pairs its weaving hardware with software for custom-fit patternmaking and design automation, working with manufacturers and brands to eliminate overproduction, with a mission of reducing global human carbon emissions by one percent. Unspun is backed by DCVC and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Agile Robots
providers.description: Agile Robots SE is a Munich-based robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the German Aerospace Center (DLR) Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics. The company develops force-sensitive industrial and service robots, robotic arms (Diana series), grippers and hands (Agile Hand), mobile robotics, and the AgileCore / AgileAI software platform that lets system integrators and operators build and deploy AI-driven automation for the automotive, consumer electronics, healthcare, and service industries. Headquartered in Munich's Sendling district with manufacturing across Europe, China, and India, Agile Robots reached unicorn valuation in a 2021 Series C and is backed by investors including Hongshan (Sequoia Capital China). This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Agile Robots does not currently publish a public developer portal, REST API, or first-party SDKs.

providers.name: Eat Just
providers.description: Eat Just, Inc. is a food technology company founded in 2011 by Josh Tetrick and Josh Balk, headquartered in Alameda, California, that makes plant-based alternatives to animal products. Its flagship product is JUST Egg, a liquid and folded plant-based egg made from mung bean protein, alongside JUST Meat, JUST Protein and JUST condiments. Its GOOD Meat subsidiary produces cultivated chicken and in December 2020 became the first company in the world to receive regulatory approval to sell cultivated meat, in Singapore, followed by US FDA and USDA approval in June 2023. The company sells through retail, foodservice, restaurant and industrial channels in North America and Europe. Eat Just publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; this profile records its public web and corporate surface only.

providers.name: Isar Aerospace
providers.description: Isar Aerospace is a European space launch service provider founded in 2018 and headquartered in Ottobrunn near Munich, Germany. The company designs and manufactures Spectrum, a two-stage orbital small-lift launch vehicle capable of carrying up to 1,000 kg to low Earth orbit or up to 700 kg to Sun-synchronous orbit, using liquid oxygen and propane propulsion. Spectrum is fully developed and produced in-house with automated, scalable manufacturing including additive manufacturing and carbon-composite structures. Isar Aerospace offers dedicated, lead, and rideshare launch services for small and medium satellites and constellations. Backed by more than EUR 500 million in private capital from investors including Earlybird and HV Capital, the company employs over 400 people from nearly 50 nations and conducted the inaugural Spectrum test flight from Andoya Spaceport, Norway, on 30 March 2025.

providers.name: Moleaer
providers.description: Moleaer Inc. is a Hawthorne, California nanobubble technology company that designs and manufactures nanobubble generators — Clear, Bloom, Lotus, Neo, Nexus, Trinity, Freya, Indalo, Titan and XTB, plus the NanoShield service — used to raise dissolved oxygen, act as a chemical-free oxidant, and control algae and biofilm in aquaculture, horticulture and irrigation water, lakes and ponds, wastewater treatment, food and beverage, car washes, mining, and oil and gas. Its only digital surface is a customer-only remote monitoring service, launched in 2020 with industrial IoT provider AMI Global, that reports equipment status and water-quality readings (DO, pH, ORP, temperature, conductivity) into a login-gated portal at www.monitoring-moleaer.com. Moleaer publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification; equipment-level integration is offered through industrial control protocols (SCADA/Modbus/EtherNet-IP) on the generators themselves, not through a web API.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Believer Meats
providers.description: Believer Meats is a cultivated-meat company founded in 2018 in Rehovot, Israel as Future Meat Technologies by Hebrew University bioengineer Yaakov Nahmias, rebranded to Believer Meats in November 2022 and later headquartered in the United States under CEO Gustavo Burger. It grew chicken, lamb and beef from animal cells in a continuous fermentation process rather than raising and slaughtering animals, raised roughly USD 390 million across a 2019 Series A and a 2021 USD 347 million Series B backed by Tyson Foods, ADM, Emerald Technology Ventures, Bits x Bites, Cibus Fund and Menora Mivtachim, and completed a 200,000 square-foot production plant in Wilson, North Carolina billed as the largest cultivated-meat facility in the world. In 2025 it received an FDA "No Questions" letter for its cultivated chicken followed by USDA label and facility clearance, and then ceased operations in December 2025 after its largest investor withdrew. It was a food-biotechnology and manufacturing business rather than a software vendor: it published no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs and no machine-readable API contract, and its Webflow marketing site — last republished in October 2025 — now stands as an archive of a company that is no longer operating.

providers.name: Chobani
providers.description: Chobani is an American food and beverage company founded in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, best known for popularizing strained Greek yogurt in the United States and for operating what it describes as the world's largest yogurt facility in Twin Falls, Idaho. Its portfolio spans Greek yogurt, oat milk, plant-based yogurt, probiotic drinks, nutritional shakes, and — following the 2023 acquisition of La Colombe Coffee Roasters — ready-to-drink coffee. Chobani sells through retail grocery, an away-from-home foodservice channel, Chobani Cafe locations, and a direct-to-consumer shop. Chobani is a privately held consumer packaged goods manufacturer and does not operate a public developer program: it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs, or public webhook surface, and integrates with retail and distribution partners through EDI and private supply-chain connections rather than an open API.

providers.name: DouxMatok
providers.description: DouxMatok is an Israeli food-technology company, rebranded as Incredo Ltd in May 2023, that develops Incredo Sugar — a sugar-based sugar-reduction ingredient built on a patented silica-carrier delivery technology that improves how efficiently real cane or beet sugar reaches sweet taste receptors, enabling manufacturers to cut sugar in bakery, confectionery, chocolate, spreads and nut butters by 30-50% (the company markets up to 70%) without artificial sweeteners, sugar alcohols or the aftertaste and cooling effects of alternative sweeteners. The technology is protected by more than 20 patents, was named a TIME Best Invention of 2020, and was featured in Netflix's "Explained". The company sells as a B2B ingredient to food manufacturers through distributors and partner enquiries, and is backed by Sienna Venture Capital, Pitango, DSM-Firmenich Venturing and BlueRed Partners. It is an ingredient manufacturer, not a software vendor: as of this profile it operates a twelve-page marketing website and publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence
providers.description: Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence is a division of Hexagon AB providing metrology, quality management, and manufacturing intelligence software and hardware. Products include PC-DMIS (CMM measurement software), WORKXPLORE (CAD viewer), SFx (smart factory platform), and HxGN Smart Quality. The division offers APIs and SDKs for automating CMM measurement programs, integrating quality data into MES and ERP systems, and building custom metrology applications.

providers.name: Koobz
providers.description: Koobz is a Ventura, California additive-manufacturing company rebuilding the footwear supply chain around on-demand 3D printing. Its "gigafactory" prints circular-ready, mono-material foamed-TPU shoes to order, so brands carry zero inventory and face no minimum order quantities: a consumer buys on the brand's own storefront, the order and personalization specs sync to the Koobz factory, the shoe is printed in Ventura and dropshipped direct to the customer in days. The company markets 10x faster concept-to-market cycles (4-6 weeks, no tooling), custom cushioning and foot-scanning personalization, and a KoobzWeave toolpath-as-textile upper pattern engine. Its mono-material architecture is positioned for Extended Producer Responsibility regimes such as California SB 707, since a single-polymer shoe yields premium TPU on take-back rather than mixed waste. Koobz has raised $7.2M and is backed by Uncork Capital. It describes its factory as API-driven and its order intake as an API sync from brand storefronts, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definition; integration appears to run through its partner ("Partner With Us") channel.

providers.name: Leapmotor
providers.description: Leapmotor (Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd., HKEX: 9863) is a Chinese intelligent electric vehicle manufacturer founded in 2015 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, which sold its first vehicles in 2019. Leapmotor designs and builds battery-electric and range-extended (REEV) passenger vehicles — including the T03 city car and the B03X, B05, B10 and C10 SUVs — on its own vertically integrated LEAP platform, developing its electric drive, battery, and intelligent cockpit and driving systems in house. Stellantis took a stake in the company in 2023 and, through the Leapmotor International joint venture, distributes Leapmotor vehicles across Europe and other export markets via leapmotor.net. Leapmotor operates connected-vehicle services — the Leapmotor mobile app, OTA software updates, and the Leapmotor Connected Experience — but publishes no public developer API program, developer portal, or API documentation; the vehicle cloud interfaces used by its mobile app are private and only reached through unofficial, reverse-engineered community clients.

providers.name: MagnusMetal
providers.description: Magnus Metal (MagnusMetal Ltd.) is an Israeli advanced-manufacturing company bringing metal casting into the Industry 4.0 era with its patent-pending Digital Casting System. Founded in 2017 and headquartered at the Revadim Industrial Park in Kibbutz Revadim, Israel, the company builds machines that combine additive-manufacturing and casting principles: a slicer designs a ceramic mold layer by layer and solid alloy is deposited into each layer, so parts are produced from widely available solid metals rather than powders and with no hard tooling. The company markets the process for powertrains, engines, industrial machinery and structural components, claiming removal of 6-18 weeks of tooling lead time, up to 70% raw-material savings and roughly 50% lower energy use. Magnus Metal is a hardware and materials manufacturer - it sells castings and casting systems, not software - and publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Pragmatic
providers.description: Pragmatic Semiconductor Limited is a UK semiconductor manufacturer that designs and produces FlexICs - ultra-thin, physically flexible integrated circuits built on thin-film transistor (TFT) technology rather than conventional crystalline silicon. Founded in 2010 by Richard Price and Scott White and headquartered at Cambridge Science Park with manufacturing at Pragmatic Park in Sedgefield, County Durham, the company operates the Pragmatic FlexIC Foundry, a service that takes third-party custom flexible IC designs from tape-out to delivery in roughly six weeks. Product lines include the FlexIC Platform Gen 3 mixed-signal flexible ASIC design flow, Pragmatic NFC Connect and Pragmatic NFC Protect. The company raised a $231M Series D in 2023. Its only network-reachable API surface is the undocumented, authentication-gated backend of its customer portal; it publishes no developer program, no machine-readable contract and no public API reference.

providers.name: Spotlock
providers.description: Spotlock is a commodity risk management platform that helps organizations monitor, manage, and mitigate exposure to raw-material price volatility. It lets businesses track material exposures across inventory, customer contracts, and supplier commitments, set company-wide risk policies, and execute optimized hedging strategies — enabling fixed-price long-term contracts, profit margin protection, hedge accounting treatment, framework/agreement pricing, and global price intelligence for sectors such as construction and infrastructure, metal service centers and distribution, manufacturing and fabrication, automotive, energy, and transportation.

providers.name: Terra CO2
providers.description: Terra CO2 Technology is a Golden, Colorado climate-technology and building-materials manufacturer that produces low-carbon replacements for Portland cement. Its commercial product, OPUS SCM, is a supplementary cementitious material that replaces up to 50% of the Portland cement in a concrete mix as a drop-in substitute for legacy SCMs such as fly ash, cutting CO2 by roughly 70% and NOx by roughly 90% per ton replaced, and it is produced from abundant silicate feedstocks rather than coal-plant by-products. A second product, OPUS ZERO, targets a full zero-carbon cement replacement and is in concrete trials. The company runs a pilot and materials R&D facility in Golden and is building a 240,000-ton-per-year commercial plant in Cleburne, Texas, backed by more than $250M raised from climate and construction investors including Cemex Ventures. Terra CO2 sells physical material into the construction supply chain; it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Zero Motorcycles
providers.description: Zero Motorcycles is an American manufacturer of electric motorcycles and powertrains, founded in 2006 in Santa Cruz, California. It designs and builds street, dual-sport and off-road electric motorcycles across its S, DS, FX and X lines — including the SR/S, SR/F, DSR/X, FXE and XE — around a proprietary Z-Force electric powertrain and aircraft-grade aluminum frame. Its bikes run the Cypher operating system, which pairs with the Zero Motorcycles NextGen mobile app over Bluetooth and cellular telematics for ride data, remote diagnostics, over-the-air updates and performance customization, and with the Cypher Store, where owners purchase software upgrades that unlock additional power, top speed and features. Zero sells internationally through a dealer network and serves retail, fleet and authority/first-responder segments. Its connected-vehicle platform is consumer-facing only: Zero publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Hadrian
providers.description: Hadrian (Hadrian Automation) is a Los Angeles-area precision-manufacturing company founded in 2020 by Chris Power, building software-driven, AI-powered factories that produce high-tolerance machined components for the aerospace and defense industrial base — including parts for rockets, satellites, jets, drones, and missiles. The company's core software stack is Opus, described as a full-stack, AI-powered Factory Autonomy platform that interprets legacy engineering designs, automates CNC machining, inspection, tool-path optimization, adaptive programming, scheduling, and quality assurance, and enables new operators to be productive in 30 days or less. Hadrian operates multiple factories — Factory 2 (F2) and Factory X (FX) in Torrance, California, and Factory 3 (F3) in Mesa, Arizona — and offers three commercial models: precision component manufacturing, Manufacturing-as-a-Service (dedicated automation cells for a single customer), and Factories-as-a-Service (turnkey factory design and operation). Customers and partners include major aerospace and defense primes such as Lockheed Martin. Hadrian has also launched an additive manufacturing division to expand U.S. defense production capacity. The Opus platform is internal-only — Hadrian sells finished precision parts and factory capacity, not software access — and there is no public developer API, SDK, GitHub organization, or open-source release for Opus or any Hadrian system.

providers.name: Kilsar
providers.description: Kilsar is an AI-powered maintenance training and operations platform for the aviation, defense, and industrial sectors. Its flagship product, Orion, turns static technical manuals and maintenance procedures into intelligent, guided workflows so technicians learn faster and perform complex tasks correctly. The platform provides AI-assisted search across operational and maintenance manuals, dynamic data storage and library management, custom workflow and procedure building, real-time task tracking and work-log monitoring, and predictive maintenance and troubleshooting guidance. Kilsar promises measurable outcomes including reduced downtime, faster mean-time-to-repair, and increased equipment uptime. Kilsar is a Techstars-backed company. As of this profile it publishes a marketing site and a Secureframe-hosted trust center but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: PharmaCann
providers.description: PharmaCann is one of the largest vertically integrated cannabis companies in the United States, founded in 2014 and operating cultivation centers, processing facilities and retail dispensaries across eight states — Colorado, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New York, Ohio and Pennsylvania. The company runs nine cultivation and processing facilities (Denver CO, Dwight IL, Lothian and Stevensville MD, Holliston MA, Warren MI, Hamptonburgh NY, Buckeye Lake OH and Olyphant PA) and sells through two retail banners, LivWell (Colorado and Michigan) and Verilife (Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New York, Ohio and Pennsylvania), alongside a house of product brands including Matter, Magnitude, Full Melt, CAM, P3, LivWell Flower, Hash and PC Nursery. PharmaCann is a physical-goods operator in a federally restricted, state-regulated industry; it publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: SVT Robotics
providers.description: SVT Robotics builds the SOFTBOT Platform, a software integration and orchestration foundation for warehouse automation and the supply chain. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, the company lets enterprises connect industrial systems, robotics, AMRs, and warehouse management software through standardized, prebuilt SOFTBOT Connectors — reducing integration complexity and enabling real-time visibility, faster automation deployments, and a resilient data backbone for automation and AI. Customers include DHL Supply Chain, Barrett Distribution Centers, and the Hagen Group. The provider operates a developer documentation hub for the SOFTBOT integration API (docs.svtrobotics.com, currently password-protected) and a public status page; no public OpenAPI, SDK, or open API surface was discoverable at enrichment time.

providers.name: BAE Systems
providers.description: BAE Systems is a British multinational defense, security, and aerospace company and one of the largest defense contractors globally. BAE Systems does not publish public developer APIs; technology integration is delivered through classified and ITAR-controlled customer programs, the Discover supplier portal, defense-program-specific data exchanges (e.g. F-35 ALIS / ODIN, Eurofighter), and FMS / government-to-government channels.

providers.name: Haber
providers.description: Haber (Elixa Technologies Private Limited), headquartered in Pune, India with a US presence in Chicago, is an industrial AI company delivering AI-led automation for smart manufacturing across heavy industries including pulp, paper, packaging and tissue, metals and mining, food and beverages, oil and gas, and water/utility institutions. Its product suite spans eLIXA, an IIoT-powered process intelligence platform; Mt. Fuji for historical data storage, visualizations, digital twins and predictive interventions; Kaiznn, an optimization engine for trim-loss reduction, inventory and production scheduling; plus Kensei and FiMorph. The platform emphasizes real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and enterprise-grade security (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022). Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Advantive
providers.description: Advantive is an AI-enabled software company for specialty manufacturing and distribution operations, unifying ERP, MES, quality (SPC/SQC), PLM, WMS, and B2B commerce workflows into industry-specific systems. Built from a portfolio of brands including Advantzware, DDI System, Distribution One, InfinityQS (Enact and ProFicient), Kiwiplan, WinSPC, and VIA, Advantive serves more than 2,500 customers across eight countries in verticals such as food and beverage, packaging (corrugated, folding carton, plastics), automotive, aerospace and defense, electronics, and distribution of fasteners, bearings, HVAC, and janitorial supplies. The company is a private-equity-backed operations software provider; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public digital surface. No public developer API or OpenAPI has been found — integration is delivered through the products' own connectors and the Advantive support portal.

providers.name: Aiko Solar
providers.description: Aiko Solar (Zhejiang Aiko Solar Energy Co.) is a solar photovoltaic manufacturer specializing in high-efficiency solar cells and modules, best known for its ABC (All Back Contact) module technology for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale applications. A BloombergNEF Tier 1 manufacturer, the company reports 200 GW+ accumulative cell and module shipments and mass-production cell efficiency around 25%. This is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer or API surface; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: AMSC
providers.description: American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) is a power control systems company headquartered in Ayer, Massachusetts, and traded publicly on NASDAQ under the ticker AMSC. The company designs and delivers grid and power-electronics solutions across three specialties - power supply, power protection, and power innovation - serving the energy, renewables, utility, industrial, materials, and military sectors. Its offerings span grid capacity and resiliency systems, renewable generation integration, industrial process power control, and shipboard power protection for naval defense. AMSC is an early Battery Ventures portfolio investment. AMSC does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's corporate identity and domain security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Avathon
providers.description: Avathon — formerly SparkCognition, rebranded in November 2024 — is an industrial AI company whose Industrial AI Platform combines a data platform, industrial digital twin, AI modeling and application development layers to bring predictive maintenance, asset performance management, visual intelligence and autonomy to physical operations. Its solutions span renewables, oil and gas, power and utilities, manufacturing, mining, aerospace and defense, maritime, rail, aviation, logistics, warehousing and retail, with named offerings including Asset Performance Management, Visual AI / Visual Intelligence, Autonomy for Health, Safety and Environment, the Digital Maintenance Advisor and the Multidomain Awareness Advisor. The platform is sold and delivered as an enterprise engagement — marketing material references an application development SDK and APIs, but no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification is published; the only documentation surface, support.avathon.com/help, redirects to a HubSpot member login. Avathon is backed by investors including Temasek, Verizon Ventures and Boeing, and is headquartered in Silicon Valley after relocating from Austin, Texas.

providers.name: Belts
providers.description: Belts covers the landscape of APIs, data standards, and digital resources related to conveyor belts and industrial belt systems. This topic encompasses conveyor belt monitoring and predictive maintenance APIs, industrial IoT sensor data for belt condition tracking, and the standards bodies that govern belt conveyor design and safety. Key organizations include CEMA (Conveyor Equipment Manufacturers Association) and ANSI, which define design, installation, and safety standards for belt conveyors used in mining, manufacturing, food processing, and bulk material handling industries.

providers.name: Boom Supersonic
providers.description: Boom Supersonic is a Denver-based aerospace company building supersonic commercial aircraft to make the world dramatically more accessible. Its flagship airliner, Overture, is designed to carry passengers at twice the speed of today's jets and has orders and pre-orders from United Airlines, American Airlines, and Japan Airlines. The company develops the Symphony medium-bypass turbofan engine purpose-built for supersonic flight, flew the XB-1 demonstrator past Mach 1, and is applying its propulsion technology to Superpower gas turbines for data-center energy. Boom is a deep-tech, hardware-first manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API surface; this profile tracks its identity and security posture in the API Evangelist network. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Electric Capital, and Homebrew.

providers.name: California Forever
providers.description: California Forever is a real estate and urban development company founded by Jan Sramek in 2017, backed by prominent Silicon Valley investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Laurene Powell Jobs, Reid Hoffman, Marc Andreessen, and Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison. Through its subsidiary Flannery Associates the company assembled roughly 60,000-70,000 acres of land in southeastern Solano County, California, and is planning a new walkable city for up to 400,000 residents alongside the Solano Foundry advanced manufacturing park and the Solano Shipyard. The company describes the effort as a $215 billion private investment intended to create hundreds of thousands of jobs, 170,000+ new homes, and billions in annual tax revenue over 40 years. California Forever is a physical-development and land-use company; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable interfaces at this time.

providers.name: Calumet Specialty Products Partners
providers.description: Calumet, Inc. (NASDAQ: CLMT) is a publicly traded U.S. manufacturing company established in 1919, headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. The firm specializes in the manufacture of lubricating oils, solvents, waxes, packaged and synthetic specialty products, fuels, renewable diesel, and fuel-related products. It operates 12 production facilities across North America and serves approximately 2,700 global customers in over 90 countries through brands including Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, Penreco, Orchex, and TruFuel. Calumet does not publish a public developer API program; commercial integrations are handled via B2B portals and EDI.

providers.name: Capstone Turbine
providers.description: Capstone Turbine Corporation, now operating as Capstone Green Energy (and its operating entity Capstone Energy+), is a California-based manufacturer of low-emission microturbine energy systems founded in 1988. The company designs and builds oil-free, air-bearing microturbines ranging from 65 kW to multi-megawatt configurations for on-site and on-demand power, combined heat and power (CHP), and combined cooling, heat and power (CCHP). Its systems power data centers, microgrids, ports, EV charging, oil and gas operations, critical power, and renewable energy applications. Capstone was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It is an industrial energy manufacturer with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Cintas
providers.description: Cintas Corporation is a Fortune 500 provider of uniform rental, facility services, first aid and safety products, and fire protection services. Cintas does not currently publish a public developer portal; B2B integrations (ordering, EDI, route management, billing) are delivered to enterprise customers through the myCintas portal, the Cintas Partner Connect program, and account-managed EDI relationships.

providers.name: Datacor
providers.description: Datacor is an enterprise software company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Florham Park, New Jersey, that builds industry-specific business management and engineering software for process manufacturers, chemical distributors, and animal-nutrition producers. Its business-automation suite spans ERP, CRM, MES, WMS, formulation management, BLISS LIMS, regulatory and nutrition labeling, and TrackAbout asset tracking, while its engineering line delivers chemical process simulation and flow-modeling tools including CHEMCAD, Fathom, Arrow, Impulse, and xStream. Datacor serves the petrochemical, refinery, energy, feed, and specialty-chemical sectors, and has begun layering AI-driven capabilities across its products. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Datacor does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or API specifications; this profile captures its verified public identity while the API surface (if any) remains behind its customer support portal.

providers.name: E-Peas
providers.description: e-peas is a Belgian fabless semiconductor company founded in 2014 in Louvain-la-Neuve that designs power management integrated circuits (PMICs) for energy harvesting, enabling battery-free and battery-assisted IoT devices to power themselves from ambient energy. Its flagship Ambient Energy Manager (AEM) family harvests from photovoltaic (light), thermal, vibration/piezoelectric, radio-frequency, and hybrid multi-source inputs, and the company also develops ultra-low-power microcontrollers for autonomous data acquisition. e-peas positions itself as a pioneer of the "Ambient IoT" concept serving smart buildings, industrial IoT, consumer electronics, and wearables, with an ecosystem of 30+ partners including Panasonic, TDK, Vishay, and Silicon Labs. This is a hardware/silicon company that does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Fibmold
providers.description: Fibmold is an eco-friendly molded-fiber packaging manufacturer building sustainable, plastic-free alternatives to rigid single-use plastic packaging. Its products are thermoformed from natural fibres such as bagasse, bamboo, and hard/soft wood pulp collected from farms, forests, and agro-processing units, then upcycled into compostable and recyclable packaging. Applications span food-service packaging, customised industrial solutions, fibre-based dosing scoops, aviation casseroles, cosmetic inserts, pharma injectable trays, chocolate trays, and noodle cups. Fibmold also runs the Primo by Fibmold retail storefront and builds manufacturing eco-systems and material-science innovation to scale sustainable packaging on the supply side. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: INGU
providers.description: INGU is a pipeline integrity technology company delivering inline inspection for oil & gas and water/wastewater pipelines through its Pipers multi-sensor free-floating inspection system paired with AI analytics and GIS-based pipeline viewer software. The platform performs leak detection, deposit and wall-condition assessment, and detection of gas pockets, magnetic features, bends, and hot taps across pipelines of any diameter or material. INGU has inspected over 900 pipelines for operators including Chevron, Shell, TotalEnergies, SUEZ, and Vale. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; the company publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Keychain
providers.description: Keychain is an AI-powered operating system and network for the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, connecting brands and retailers with the contract manufacturers, co-packers, and suppliers that make their products. The platform lets CPG brands discover and match with vetted manufacturing partners, manage sourcing and production relationships, and streamline the supplier-discovery workflow that has traditionally been manual and relationship-driven. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Keychain was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile surfaced from the a16z venture portfolio. As of this enrichment pass Keychain publishes a marketing and product web presence at keychain.com but does not expose a public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API discovery surface (no developer/API subdomain, no /.well-known catalog, no llms.txt).

providers.name: MycoTechnology
providers.description: MycoTechnology, Inc. is a Colorado-based food ingredient technology company that uses mushroom mycelial fermentation to create naturally derived ingredients for the food and beverage industry. Operating publicly as Myco (mycoiq.com), the company develops and manufactures flavor-modulation and sweetening ingredients — ClearIQ natural flavor, ClearHT natural flavor, and Zukora honey truffle sweet protein — used for bitterness masking, off-note mitigation, sugar reduction, and clean-label formulation in plant proteins, meat analogues, dairy alternatives, and health and wellness products. It also offers Fermentation as a Service (FaaS) and a MyCulinary culinary science program for food brands. This is an ingredient manufacturing and food science business, not a software or API company: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Nanotronics
providers.description: Nanotronics (rebranded to CubeFabs in 2025) builds AI-driven inspection, process-control, and automation systems for advanced industrial manufacturing, with a focus on semiconductors, data centers, EV/automotive, and aerospace/defense. Its "AI factory" platform combines optical imaging, machine learning, and robotics to improve manufacturing precision, yields, and cost efficiency for customers including Hologic, Broadcom, Coherent, and Standard BioTools. Surfaced as a founders-fund portfolio company; no public developer/API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Neurala
providers.description: Neurala is a Boston-based edge AI company whose Lifelong Deep Neural Network (L-DNN) technology is delivered as an embeddable, customized software library for on-device computer vision and visual inspection. Its stack trains on minimal data and runs entirely at the edge without cloud dependency, keeping data private on the device. Neurala partners directly with hardware and software makers rather than publishing a public self-service API; no public developer API, SDK registry package, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Nexii
providers.description: Nexii is a green construction technology company that designs and manufactures prefabricated wall and roof panel systems for commercial and industrial buildings. Its panels are made from Nexiite, a proprietary low-carbon building material the company says is up to 80% lighter than conventional concrete, and bolt together on site to cut build times by as much as five times while producing near-zero construction waste. Nexii serves retail, residential, warehouse, data center, cold storage, healthcare, office and education verticals, with projects for Starbucks, McDonald's, Pizza Hut, Popeyes, Dutch Bros, Walmart and Marriott. The original Vancouver-based Nexii Building Solutions entered creditor protection in January 2024; Dallas-based 3 Gates acquired its assets in a court-approved sale completed 28 June 2024 and relaunched the business as NEXII, Inc., headquartered in Dallas, Texas with manufacturing in Squamish, British Columbia. Nucor Corporation subsequently made a strategic equity investment. Nexii is a manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Re:Build
providers.description: Re:Build Manufacturing is a U.S.-based industrial engineering and manufacturing company that takes complex products from concept to full-rate production through integrated design, engineering, and scalable domestic manufacturing. Founded to rebuild American manufacturing capacity, the company operates a family of specialized engineering and production businesses across more than 14 U.S. locations, spanning aerospace and defense, electrification, energy and environment, medical devices, and robotics and automation. With 400+ engineers and roughly one million square feet of industrial footprint, Re:Build partners with startups and established manufacturers to develop, industrialize, and produce advanced physical products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment confirms it is an industrial/manufacturing company with no public API, developer, or machine surface at this time.

providers.name: Robust.AI
providers.description: Robust.AI is a robotics company building Carter, an AI-powered collaborative mobile robot for warehouse fulfillment and manufacturing environments. Founded by Rodney Brooks (co-founder of iRobot and Rethink Robotics) and colleagues, the company designs human-centered autonomous material-handling robots that work alongside people with minimal infrastructure change, no capital expenditure, and rapid ROI. Robust.AI is backed by Playground Global and was recognized among Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026. This is a physical-robotics company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or GitHub surface.

providers.name: Sakuu
providers.description: Sakuu Corporation is a Silicon Valley advanced-manufacturing company that builds commercial-scale printing equipment for the battery and supercapacitor industries. Founded in 2016 as KeraCel and renamed Sakuu in 2021, it develops the Kavian platform — a dry-process electrode printing system that produces cathodes and anodes without solvents or drying ovens, covering NCA, NCM, LFP, LTO, graphite and silicon-graphite chemistries as well as sodium-ion, aluminum-ion and solid-state formulations. Kavian was named a TIME Best Invention of 2024 and a Fast Company World Changing Idea of 2025, and the Kavian 2000 platform is sold to battery makers serving AI data centers, energy storage, two- and three-wheel mobility, aerospace and industrial electrification. Sakuu sells capital equipment and process technology; it does not operate a software product, a developer program, or any public API.

providers.name: Sarla Aviation
providers.description: Sarla Aviation is an Indian advanced air mobility company building electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for urban transportation. Its flagship flying taxi, Shunya, uses a hybrid-electric propulsion system (seven electric units, dual battery packs, and a sustainable aviation fuel tank) to reach up to 250 km/h with a range up to 800 km and 150 km fully electric, in cabin configurations spanning 6-seat, 4-seat, cargo, and ambulance variants. Founded by former Lilium engineers Rakesh Gaonkar and Adrian Schmidt, the company is a portfolio company of Accel. The public website exposes no developer, API, or technical integration surface as of this enrichment pass; this profile captures corporate identity, legal, and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: SmartMore
providers.description: SmartMore Corporation (思谋科技) is a Hong Kong- and Shenzhen-headquartered industrial AI and machine vision company founded in 2019, building products and solutions for smart manufacturing and digital innovation. Its flagship SMore ViMo platform bundles ViMo Cloud, ViMo Deeplearning and ViMo Studio into a low-code industrial vision stack covering data management, model training, visual solution design and production-line deployment, and is sold alongside first-party hardware — industrial smart cameras, barcode readers (VS600/VS800P/VS1000/VS2000), vision sensors (VN2000/VN4000) and lenses — through the SmartMoreInside sub-brand. The company also markets digital platforms (Light3D, Data, Gauge, AIoT) and industrial large models (IndustryGPT, SMore LrMo). SmartMore states it has filed 400+ global patent applications with 200+ granted, served 200+ enterprise customers, and reached unicorn status on a Series B that exceeded USD 200 million in 2021, with R&D and business centers in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Suzhou, Tokyo, Beijing, Hangzhou and Singapore. As of this pass the company publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; ViMo model export to an SDK is described in marketing copy but is delivered with the licensed product rather than documented publicly.

providers.name: Viewlocity
providers.description: Viewlocity Technologies Pty Ltd is a supply chain management software company that provides supply chain visibility, control tower, and execution solutions for global manufacturers, distributors, and logistics providers. Its solution set spans supply chain design, inventory and asset management, supply chain management, logistics and transportation, planning and production, order lifecycle management, and supplier management, delivered as SaaS and managed services to industries including aerospace and defense, automotive and industrial, consumer goods, high tech and electronics, manufacturing, retail, and third-party logistics. Viewlocity publishes a corporate marketing and resource website but does not expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: ANYbotics
providers.description: ANYbotics is a Swiss deep-tech robotics company that builds ANYmal, an autonomous four-legged inspection robot used to automate routine and hazardous industrial inspections across power and utilities, oil and gas, mining, chemicals, and metals. Its platform pairs the legged robot with inspection-management software and analytics to increase plant uptime, cut costs, and remove workers from dangerous areas. ANYbotics is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface is exposed; this API Evangelist profile currently captures the company's published security and trust posture.

providers.name: CF Industries Holdings
providers.description: CF Industries Holdings is a Fortune 500 American manufacturer and distributor of nitrogen-based fertilizers (ammonia, urea, ammonium nitrate, UAN) and clean-energy products serving agricultural and industrial customers worldwide. CF operates one of the largest global ammonia production networks and is scaling clean (blue and green) ammonia for low-carbon energy. CF does not publish a public developer API program; programmatic data access is limited to investor-relations SEC filings feeds, press/news RSS, and partner EDI/B2B integrations with agricultural distributors, rail, terminal, and industrial customers.

providers.name: Cirsium Biosciences
providers.description: Cirsium Biosciences is a biotechnology company democratizing gene therapy through transformative manufacturing methods. It develops viral vector production systems that use whole plants as bioreactors, offering a highly scalable, linear scale-out platform for producing recombinant AAV (adeno-associated virus) vectors. The plant-based, controlled-environment agriculture approach targets the industry's core production bottlenecks - inadequate global capacity, poor scalability, high clinical-grade manufacturing costs, and standardization challenges - claiming up to a 70% reduction in manufacturing lead times. Cirsium is a private, venture-backed therapeutics-manufacturing firm and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Divergent
providers.description: Divergent Technologies, Inc. is a Torrance and Long Beach, California manufacturer that built the Divergent Adaptive Production System (DAPS), an end-to-end software-hardware production system for industrial digital manufacturing. DAPS pairs AI-driven generative design software with in-house metal additive manufacturing — the Monolith One printer, compatible with aluminum, nickel, steel and titanium alloys — and automated fixtureless robotic assembly, so complex multi-part structures can be engineered, printed and assembled without fixed tooling. Founded in 2013 by Kevin and Lukas Czinger, the company is a Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and has expanded into aerospace and defense, including selection under the US Air Force Eglin Wide Agile Acquisition Contract. Divergent sells manufactured structures and production capacity, not software: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Omnifold
providers.description: Omnifold is an AI supply chain planning platform for physical product companies — CPGs, manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company trains a custom AI model for each supply chain to forecast demand, optimize inventory, and surface revenue, margin, and cash that traditional planning systems miss, positioning itself in the Forbes "Purpose-Built AI" tier and competing with Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, and o9. Omnifold was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Omnifold publishes marketing and product content but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or authentication surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: POMS
providers.description: POMS Corporation develops POMSnet Aquila, a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) purpose-built for pharmaceutical, biotech, cell and gene therapy, and medical device manufacturers. The platform delivers FDA-compliant electronic batch records (EBR), production execution, review-by-exception, and plant-floor integration with ERP and equipment systems, deployed on-premise or in the cloud. POMS also offers the POMSnet Falcon EBR analytics dashboards. Founded around its first MES implementation in 1988 and headquartered in Redmond, Washington, POMS sells enterprise software to regulated life-sciences manufacturers rather than publishing a public developer API. Surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio lead, this profile is enriched from the company's public web presence; no public API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found.

providers.name: Ryerson Holding
providers.description: Ryerson Holding Corporation is a leading value-added processor and distributor of industrial metals, with operations across the United States, Canada, Mexico, China, and Brazil. The company offers a broad range of stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, and alloy steels in various shapes and forms. Ryerson operates an e-commerce platform at Ryerson.com enabling online metal ordering, order status tracking, and shipment management. The company has integrated its CRM (Salesforce) with ERP (SAP) for streamlined order management and uses EDI and API-based integration for wholesale distribution operations.

providers.name: 24M
providers.description: 24M Technologies is a battery technology company founded in 2010 out of MIT laboratories and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Rather than manufacturing cells at scale itself, 24M licenses its battery materials, cell architecture and SemiSolid manufacturing platform to energy-storage system integrators, EV battery manufacturers and OEMs worldwide. Its product portfolio spans the Eternalyte electrolyte (ultra-fast charging and low-temperature performance), the Impervio separator (thermal-runaway prevention), the LiForever electrode, the 24M ETOP electrode-to-pack architecture, and 24M production equipment. Partners and corporate investors have included Volkswagen Group, Kyocera, Itochu and FREYR Battery. 24M is a hardware, materials and manufacturing company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: ABL Space Systems
providers.description: ABL Space Systems is an American launch vehicle company founded in 2017 by Harry O'Hanley and Dan Piemont, headquartered in El Segundo, California, with operations at the Port of Long Beach, Mojave and Kodiak, Alaska. ABL built RS1, a two-stage, kerosene/liquid-oxygen small satellite launch vehicle designed to deliver 1,350 kg to low Earth orbit and 1,000 kg to sun-synchronous orbit, powered by nine in-house additively manufactured E2 engines on the first stage and one on the second. Its companion GS0 ground system packages an entire orbital launch site into standard shipping containers so a pad can be activated anywhere with a flat concrete surface and moved by land, sea or air. RS1 attempted its first orbital flight from Pacific Spaceport Complex Kodiak in January 2023 and was lost shortly after liftoff; a second vehicle was destroyed during preflight static-fire testing in July 2024. In November 2024 the company announced its exit from the commercial orbital launch market, and in February 2025 it rebranded as Long Wall, refocusing on containerized missile defense — the Cyclops exoatmospheric interceptor, RSX low-cost liquid boosters for flight testing and threat replication, and the Ironwood ground support equipment line. ABL/Long Wall is an aerospace and defense hardware manufacturer: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, machine-readable API contract or developer portal.

providers.name: Albemarle
providers.description: Albemarle Corporation is a global specialty chemicals company and leading provider of lithium, bromine, and other essential elements. Operating from its global headquarters in Charlotte, NC, Albemarle serves customers in approximately 70 countries with world-class hard-rock and brine lithium resources, state-of-the-art lithium conversion facilities, advanced lithium material and process development, bromine production facilities, and the US's only producing lithium resource in Silver Peak, NV. The company serves critical markets including electric vehicle batteries, energy storage, flame retardants, pharmaceutical ingredients, catalysts, and specialty chemicals, employing approximately 7,800 people and holding over 1,500 active patents worldwide.

providers.name: Arzana
providers.description: Arzana is an AI-powered Office Execution System for US manufacturers and distributors, founded in 2025 in San Francisco and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026). Arzana trains custom models on a factory's historical data and deploys agents that automate back-office work — quoting, estimating, order entry, purchasing, prospecting, outreach, CRM, AP 3-way match, AR tracking, and customer service — alongside a customizable ERP/CRM/MES with every agent pre-installed. Forward-deployed engineers configure each agent per operation; Arzana reports going live in 120 days with 99%+ accuracy. Arzana currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it does publish a /llms.txt for agent discovery.

providers.name: BETA Technologies
providers.description: BETA Technologies is a Vermont-based aerospace company that designs and manufactures all-electric aircraft and the supporting electric aviation charging network. BETA produces two variants of its ALIA platform: ALIA CTOL (conventional take-off and landing) and ALIA VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), each carrying a pilot plus five passengers or equivalent cargo, with demonstrated range of 336 nautical miles and sub-hour recharge. BETA's Charge Cube is an interoperable multimodal charger now deployed at sites across the U.S. covering more than 50 million people within 50 miles, and the company operates a 188,000-square-foot net-zero manufacturing facility in South Burlington, Vermont. Customers include UPS, United Therapeutics, the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Army (via AFWERX Agility Prime), Air New Zealand, Bristow, Surf Air Mobility, and other early operators; BETA was selected for seven of the eight FAA eVTOL Integration Pilot Program initiatives.

providers.name: C-Infinity
providers.description: C-Infinity is a Mountain View, California company founded in 2023 that builds foundational AI for mechanical design and manufacturing — AI that reasons about geometry, motion, spatial constraints, and production logic. Its platform, AutoAssembler, connects directly to existing CAD and PLM environments to automate assembly process planning, accelerate engineering change order (ECO) reviews, and generate production-ready assembly work instructions, compressing work that historically took weeks into minutes. The product is described by the company as API-first, with an integration layer that connects upstream to engineering systems and downstream to production, but as of July 2026 C-Infinity publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition — the AutoAssembler application is gated behind a request-a-demo flow and integration is arranged directly with the company. C-Infinity raised a $16M round in April 2026 led by Canaan Partners, with participation from Inventus Capital, Bee Partners, and Radius Capital, and reports deployments across Global Fortune 100 manufacturers as well as small and mid-sized enterprises.

providers.name: Electric Hydrogen
providers.description: Electric Hydrogen (EH2) is a Massachusetts-based clean-energy company that designs, manufactures, and commissions the world's most powerful PEM electrolyzers, packaged into a fully-integrated 100MW HYPRPlant that turns water and renewable electricity into the lowest-cost green hydrogen. The complete plant solution bundles power conversion, gas processing, water treatment, and thermal management so heavy industry can decarbonize ammonia, e-fuels, steel, and refining at gigawatt scale. Founded in 2020 and led by CEO Raffi Garabedian, EH2 operates a 1.2GW gigafactory in Devens, Massachusetts, became green hydrogen's first unicorn with a $380M Series C, and is backed by Fifth Wall, Fortescue, Energy Impact Partners, bp Ventures, Temasek, and Microsoft's Climate Innovation Fund. This profile enriches the API Evangelist network stub with the company's real public web surface.

providers.name: Forge Nano
providers.description: Forge Nano is a materials-technology manufacturer headquartered in Thornton, Colorado that commercializes particle and wafer Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) under its Atomic Armor platform and patented ALDx architecture. The company applies atomic-scale nanocoatings to powders, electrodes and semiconductor wafers to improve energy density, cycle life, thermal stability and yield, and sells three lines of business: US-sourced lithium-ion cells from its Morrisville, North Carolina gigafactory, commercial semiconductor wafer-fabrication equipment including the TEPHRA cluster tool for 200mm wafers, and Powder ALD coating systems for batteries, catalysts and composites.
