The company offers strain development, process development, piloting, scale-up, and manufacturing services for custom renewable chemistry used across personal care, cosmetics, flavors and fragrances, and other industries, emphasizing resilient supply chains, product consistency, and reduced ecological impact. Amyris is a private company that emerged from a 2023 Chapter 11 restructuring; it does not currently publish a public developer API or technology platform.

providers.name: B/E Aerospace
providers.description: B/E Aerospace was a manufacturer of aircraft cabin interior products and a provider of aerospace services for commercial aircraft and business jets. The company was acquired by Rockwell Collins in 2017 and subsequently merged into Collins Aerospace (a Raytheon Technologies subsidiary) in 2020. B/E Aerospace products included seating, food and beverage preparation equipment, lighting systems, and oxygen systems for commercial and business aviation.

providers.name: Berry Global
providers.description: Berry Global is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials for consumer and industrial end markets. In 2024, Berry Global merged with Amcor to form one of the world's largest packaging companies. Berry's products include rigid open top packaging, closures and dispensing systems, flexible packaging, tapes, and engineered materials.

providers.name: Shelby Williams Industries
providers.description: Shelby Williams Industries is the premier designer, manufacturer, and distributor of seating products in the hospitality and food service industries. With over 70 years of experience, the company produces an extensive line of chairs, barstools, banquet seating, sofas, and tables made from wood, metal, rattan, and fully upholstered materials. Headquartered with US manufacturing in Newport, Tennessee, Shelby Williams serves hotels, restaurants, country clubs, senior living facilities, and banquet venues worldwide. As a contract furniture manufacturer focused on custom B2B orders, Shelby Williams does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: VerdaFresh
providers.description: VerdaFresh is a Wayne, Pennsylvania materials-science company that develops water-based, saran-free oxygen barrier coatings for recyclable flexible food packaging. Its High Oxygen Barrier and Ultra High Barrier coatings are applied to BOPP, HD-BOPE, MDO-PE and PET film substrates to extend shelf life while keeping the finished package mono-material and recyclable, replacing PVdC and metallized structures. The company sells coatings and coated films to converters and CPG brands, is APR-recognized and a member of the U.S. Plastics Pact, and publishes technical datasheets rather than software. It is a physical-products manufacturer with no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: biolink
providers.description: BioLink (百林科医药科技（上海）有限公司) is a Shanghai-based bioprocessing company that manufactures core equipment and single-use consumable solutions for biopharmaceutical manufacturing. Its product lines span cell culture and bioreactors, fluid management, chromatography purification, process filtration, and pre-formulated aqueous products (buffers, water for injection, defoamers), serving antibody therapeutics and ADCs, vaccines, cell and gene therapy, and recombinant protein production. BioLink is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Central Coast Agriculture
providers.description: Central Coast Agriculture, Inc. (CCA) is a vertically integrated California cannabis cultivator and manufacturer headquartered in the Santa Ynez Valley north of Santa Barbara, best known for its Raw Garden brand of fresh-frozen concentrates, vapes and infused pre-rolls. The company describes itself as a progressive farm focused on utilizing science and sustainability to grow quality, modern crops, and operates its own farming, genetics/breeding and extraction programs. It is a physical agricultural and consumer-packaged-goods business: it publishes a corporate site, a consumer brand site and a wholesale ordering page, but no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Cooper Standard Holdings
providers.description: Cooper Standard Holdings is a global automotive supplier headquartered in Northville, Michigan, that designs, engineers, manufactures, and sells sealing systems, fuel and brake delivery systems, and fluid transfer systems for global automotive original equipment manufacturers including Ford, General Motors, Stellantis, and Volkswagen. The company operates in approximately 20 countries with around 32,000 employees and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CPS. Cooper Standard does not publish a public developer program or REST APIs. Its digital presence centers on corporate, investor, supplier, and careers websites.

providers.name: Forus Health
providers.description: Forus Health Pvt Ltd is a Bengaluru, India based medical device manufacturer specializing in advanced eye-care and retinal-imaging technology. Its 3nethra family of devices covers adult and neonatal retinal imaging, refraction and myopia management, and anterior-segment imaging, complemented by the FH-POISE AI diagnostic platform that screens for diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, cataract, hypertensive retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and dry eye. Forus also operates connected telemedicine platforms (FH TeleCare, FH TeleEye, FH TeleOpticals) for remote eye screening. The company reports more than 5,000 installations across 85+ countries. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Lumachain
providers.description: Lumachain provides computer-vision AI for the food supply chain, delivering real-time detection of critical production events across high-throughput meat and food processing plants. Its on-site platform monitors deboning-equipment yield, animal welfare, foreign-object detection, and quality control across beef, pork, poultry, and finished-goods facilities, generating structured signals that integrate with existing plant systems. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners with investors including Chipotle. No public developer portal, API documentation, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: Physical Property Testing
providers.description: Physical Properties Testers (PPT) Group is a Halifax, UK based multinational manufacturer of physical property test and measurement instrumentation, built through acquisition around four brands: James Heal (textile testing including bursting strength, abrasion and tear), Mecmesin (universal testing machines, torque testers and digital force gauges), Alluris (handheld force gauges and force/torque instrumentation) and Lansmont (shock, vibration and drop testing systems). The group designs, produces and services testing equipment that verifies the physical integrity and quality of raw materials, components and finished products across textiles, packaging, manufacturing and consumer goods. It is a hardware and laboratory-instrumentation business with no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface. Registered in England and Wales (company no. 09210539); a portfolio company of SK Capital Partners since March 2025 (previously backed by Battery Ventures). This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio lead and enriched with company identity from public sources.

providers.name: Project Eaden
providers.description: Project Eaden (PROJECT EADEN GmbH) is a Berlin-based food-technology company building fiber-spinning technology to power the next generation of whole-cut plant-based protein. Its platform reconstructs the fibrous structure of animal muscle from plant ingredients to create alternatives such as plant-based fish and meat, and it collaborates on consumer brands including LEKKA. Backed by Creandum and co-funded through EIT Food and the European Union, the company operates as a consumer food-tech producer and currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Reframe
providers.description: Reframe (usereframe.ai) is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator Winter 2026 company, founded in 2025 by Bryan Zin (previously a Product Design Engineer on the iPhone team at Apple) and Eric Wiener, building an AI-native hardware procurement platform. Reframe automates the manual procurement process in hardware supply chains: instead of emails and spreadsheets, AI agents handle purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, and part tracking for both COTS and custom-manufactured components, with Slack and Gmail integrations for team workflows. This API Evangelist profile tracks Reframe as a company in the network; the company does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Sensmore
providers.description: Sensmore (sensmore GmbH) is a German industrial-automation and embodied-AI company that turns robotics research into field-proven systems for heavy machinery in raw material operations. Its platform connects machines, sites, and data across mining, aggregates/construction, and defense, spanning products including Site Intelligence (live site operations), Machine Assist (driver assistance and collision warning), Eye (visual monitoring), Live Mapping (real-time site mapping), and Loader Automation (autonomous vehicle systems), with claims of reducing downtime by up to 30% while improving safety and resource efficiency. Sensmore was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or developer documentation; its web presence is a marketing and corporate site.

providers.name: Sortera Technologies
providers.description: Sortera Technologies (formerly Sortera Alloys) is an AI-driven metals recycling company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Markle / Fort Wayne, Indiana. It combines sensor fusion (XRF plus optical), machine-learning image and data analytics, and an advanced high-throughput scrap feeder to sort end-of-life scrap by metal type and alloy composition, upgrading feedstock streams and removing contaminants at industrial scale. From a 200,000 square foot sortation facility opened in 2023 the company produces specification aluminum scrap across cast, extrusion and sheet fractions - including 380, 356, 319 and wrought grades such as 3105 - and sells it back into domestic manufacturing. Its stated vision is 100% reuse of metals recovered from end-of-life products. The artificial intelligence runs inside Sortera's own sorting lines as an in-house platform; the product sold is recycled metal, not software, and the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Sunrise
providers.description: Sunrise Robotics builds intelligent, two-armed autonomous robotic cells for manufacturing. The AI-driven system combines built-in perception and environmental awareness with autonomous execution to transform existing production processes, increase capacity, and free human workers for higher-value tasks. Cells deploy quickly (needing only a three-phase outlet), are flexible across manufacturing applications, and are built to ISO 10218 / TS 15066 safety standards. The company is backed by Seedcamp and Slow Ventures.

providers.name: Armstrong World Industries
providers.description: Armstrong World Industries (NYSE: AWI) is a leading global designer and manufacturer of innovative commercial and residential ceiling, wall, and suspension system solutions. Armstrong offers a broad portfolio of ceiling and wall products across mineral fiber, fiberglass, wood, metal, and specialty substrates for use in commercial construction and renovation projects worldwide. The company provides BIM content, product data, and specification tools for architects and designers but does not offer a public developer API.

providers.name: Sonoco Products
providers.description: Sonoco Products Company is a global leader in sustainable metal and fiber consumer and industrial packaging, operating 285 facilities across 40 countries with 23,000+ employees. Products include metal packaging (aerosol cans, steel food cans, closures), rigid paper packaging (paper containers, fiber cartridges), industrial paper packaging (tubes, cores, recycled paperboard), and industrial specialty packaging (plastic components, reels, spools). Serves food and beverage, pet care, household products, beauty, automotive, and industrial markets. A Fortune 500 company (NYSE: SON).

providers.name: WestRock
providers.description: WestRock (now Smurfit Westrock following its 2024 merger with Smurfit Kappa) is one of the world's largest paper and packaging companies. The company provides differentiated paper and packaging solutions including corrugated containers, consumer packaging, displays, and specialty packaging. WestRock serves consumer and industrial markets with an integrated supply chain connecting mills, converting operations, and customers globally.

providers.name: Imajin
providers.description: Imajin is an Indonesian online manufacturing marketplace (the "Indonesia Manufacturing Hub") that connects buyers with vetted manufacturers and machine shops through a project-based workflow: post a project, receive quotes, and track production through to delivery. It brokers rapid 3D printing and prototyping, high-precision mold and die making, SPM and custom part fabrication, mass production (stamping, plastics, and fabrication), CNC milling and turning at machining centers, and broader manufacturing projects. The platform offers an instant-quote tool, real-time project notifications, integrated company profiles, team and project management, and up-front payment handling for suppliers. Imajin is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Peer Robotics
providers.description: Peer Robotics builds collaborative autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for manufacturing and warehouse material movement, designed to learn directly from humans to lower the cost and complexity of traditional automation. Its lineup includes the Peer 3000 collaborative mobile robot and the RM250 and RM500 AMRs (250kg and 500kg payloads) that handle pallets, trolleys, bin delivery, and machine tending through an intuitive human-robot dashboard interface. Backed by Techstars, the company operates a hardware and robotics product line rather than a public developer API surface; no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or GitHub repositories were found during enrichment probing.

providers.name: CHINT
providers.description: CHINT (Chint Group) is a global smart-energy and intelligent-electrical solutions provider founded in 1984 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, with operations across more than 140 countries. Its portfolio spans low-voltage electrical equipment (IEC and UL), power transmission and distribution systems, switchgear, instruments and meters, EV charging, and clean-energy systems including solar PV and battery storage, serving power utilities, buildings, telecom and data centers, industrial, and OEM sectors. CHINT does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and its public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan / former Sequoia China).

providers.name: Kintra Fibers
providers.description: Kintra Fibers is a Brooklyn, New York materials-science company that has developed a proprietary bio-based and biodegradable synthetic yarn as an alternative to conventional petroleum polyester. Its polymer is a novel form of polybutylene succinate (PBS) made from renewable corn- and wheat-derived sugar feedstocks, melt-spun on the same commercial equipment already used for polyester so that mills, spinners and extruders can adopt it without re-tooling. The company sells four physical products into the apparel supply chain — resin for extruders, staple fiber for spinners, 75D/72F multifilament yarn in FDY, ATY and DTY forms for mills, and finished performance fabric for brands. Co-founded by Billy McCall and Alissa Baier-Lentz, Kintra runs an in-house resin and fiber science lab in Brooklyn, launched a Fashion for Good consortium with Inditex, Bestseller and Reformation, and closed a funding round led by H&M Group. Kintra is a manufacturer of physical materials, not a software company: it operates no developer program, publishes no public API, SDK, webhook or machine-readable API contract, and its only web property is a Webflow marketing and contact site.

providers.name: Skeleton Technologies
providers.description: Skeleton Technologies is an Estonian-German energy storage manufacturer, founded in Tartu, Estonia in 2009 by Oliver Ahlberg and Taavi Madiberk, that designs and builds high-power supercapacitor and SuperBattery systems on its patented Curved Graphene material. Its product line spans SkelCap ultracapacitor cells, supercapacitor modules, and the GrapheneUPS, GrapheneGPU and GrapheneBBU power systems aimed at AI data centers, grid stability, defense, automotive, heavy transportation and industrial customers. The company has raised close to EUR 400 million, counts Marubeni and Siemens among its backers, and manufactures at its ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 certified Leipzig Superfactory in Germany, a Varkaus facility in Finland and a Curved Graphene plant in Bitterfeld-Wolfen. Skeleton sells physical power hardware; it operates no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Vitesse
providers.description: Vitesse is a universal physical-AI platform for industrial machines, founded by the team behind Tesla's "Model 3 automation hell" fix alongside leaders from SpaceX, Siemens, and Safran. It connects any machine - Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Fanuc, KUKA, ABB, and legacy PLCs - through 135 native OT connectors, generates control logic from a natural-language description of a process (up to 15x faster than traditional PLC programming), and runs the full stack at the edge on purpose-built industrial controllers with no cloud required. The platform layers hardware, live data dashboards and SCADA views, interoperability, physical AI, and zero-trust OT/IT cybersecurity (NIS2 and NIST aligned) into one stack, with real-time browser-based monitoring across 800,000+ machine hours. The company traded as Full Speed Automation and renamed to Vitesse Automation after acquiring Niagara Tech; the legacy fullspeedautomation.com domain no longer resolves over TLS. Vitesse exposes a marketing website and a login-gated product application at app.vitesse.dev; as of August 2026 it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL specification, SDK, webhooks, developer portal, or pricing page, and serves no /.well-known discovery documents.

providers.name: Andustry
providers.description: Andustry is an AI-native industrial equipment broker that streamlines sourcing and procurement for manufacturers. The platform combines AI-powered supplier discovery with manual qualification and commercial negotiation to source industrial machines (CNC mills, lathes, press brakes, laser cutters, robotic cells), machined/forged/cast parts, and robotics and electronics across Europe, China, India, and the United States. Clients hand off a sourcing need and Andustry returns a verified supplier shortlist within 24-48 hours, delivering an average of roughly 30% cost savings and 2x faster sourcing timelines on a commission-only basis with no subscription. Founded in 2026 (Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch) by Het Dave and Johann Stuerken and operated as Andustry GmbH.

providers.name: Domtar
providers.description: Domtar is committed to turning responsibly sourced wood fiber into essential products like paper, pulp, recycled packaging, tissue, and lumber. No public developer-facing APIs have been identified at this time; this index will be updated if any are made available.

providers.name: Lincoln Electric Holdings
providers.description: Lincoln Electric Holdings is a global manufacturer of arc welding products, robotic welding systems, plasma and oxyfuel cutting equipment, and brazing and soldering alloys. The company also offers connected welding solutions and equipment monitoring software for industrial environments.

providers.name: Walter
providers.description: Walter is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI employee for the manufacturing back office. Founded in 2026 by Nikolas Keller (CEO) and Lukas Postulka (CTO), Walter logs into the enterprise systems a company already runs on — SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Teams, Outlook and Gmail — the way a new hire would, and takes over manual paperwork: reading sales orders and purchase orders from emails and PDFs, capturing and validating the data, cross-checking it against the ERP, ordering from suppliers and catching pricing errors before they ship. It uses a purpose-built document-understanding model (rather than legacy template OCR) that supports 270+ languages and reaches 90%+ accuracy after minimal training, cutting an order that used to take 15 minutes down to about one. Walter requires no integration project and no rip-and-replace, operating the same screens the team already uses. It is an early-stage company with no public API, developer program, SDKs or documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ADChem Semi-Tech
providers.description: Anhui ADChem Semi-Tech Co., Ltd. (安徽安德科铭半导体科技股份有限公司) is a Hefei, China based manufacturer of electronic-grade semiconductor thin-film precursor materials, founded in 2018 and operating an R&D base in Hefei with production sites in Tongling plus sales and market-development offices in Shanghai and Wuhan. The company develops and produces high-purity ALD and CVD precursors — silicon-based precursors (BDEAS, BTBAS, DIPAS, DIS), High-K hafnium and zirconium precursors (TDMAHf, TEMAHf, CpHf, HfCl4, TEMAZ, CpZr, ZrCl4), metal and conductive-film precursors (TMA, TBTDEN, WCl5, MoCl5, CCTBA, Ru(EtCp)2) and perovskite photovoltaic precursors — alongside custom source canisters, liquid delivery systems and thin-film process solutions for integrated-circuit manufacturing, advanced display and new-energy customers. ADChem sells physical chemical products; it operates no public developer program, API, or software platform.

providers.name: Ayr Energy
providers.description: Ayr Energy is a power grid equipment manufacturer founded in 2024 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, backed by General Catalyst. The company designs and builds custom-engineered electrical infrastructure - power, distribution, and special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear - for renewable energy, data center, utility, industrial, and oil & gas customers. Ayr operates six manufacturing facilities across India (Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu) and emphasizes accelerated delivery of grid hardware in months rather than years. Ayr Energy does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: emergen
providers.description: emergen (智昌科技集团股份有限公司, Zhichang Technology Group) is a Chinese industrial intelligence company founded by Dr. Gan Zhongxue, an expert in intelligent manufacturing. Built around its proprietary "ternary control" technology and cluster (swarm) robotics, the company positions itself as "AI + Control," delivering integrated "industrial agent" solutions that install a control "brain" into individual machines, production lines, and whole factories. Its portfolio spans robot controllers, ubiquitous controllers, industrial and collaborative robots, life-science robots, GVision 2D/3D machine vision, the GSC-AI100 sense-compute-control AI controller, a swarm-intelligence network controller, a micro-control cloud platform, and the "Jiangxin" family of industrial large models (design, production, service, and management). emergen serves automotive, electronics, equipment manufacturing, steel, metallurgy, textile, furniture, and shipbuilding sectors, plus Robotics-as-a-Service. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this pass no public developer/API surface was found.

providers.name: Fabheads
providers.description: Fabheads is a carbon fiber and composite manufacturing company (Fabheads Automation) that delivers end-to-end composite product development — design, analysis, tooling, prototyping, and production — using its own fiber-printing and automated-layup technology alongside traditional craftsmanship. It serves aerospace, mobility, marine, robotics, medical, and sports customers from aerospace-grade facilities, and publishes the C6 Slicer tool for composite fiber printing. Backed by Accel. As a hardware manufacturer it exposes no public developer API; this profile captures identity and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Hydroleap
providers.description: Hydroleap is a Singapore-based greentech company revolutionizing industrial water and wastewater treatment through proprietary electrochemical technology. Its chemical-free, modularized systems - electro-coagulation (HL-EC), electro-oxidation (HL-EO), and electro-oxidation for cooling towers (HL-EO-CT) - replace conventional chemical-intensive processes with automated, energy-efficient alternatives. Hydroleap serves data centers, palm oil mills, food and beverage production, pharmaceuticals manufacturing, and municipal wastewater operators, helping businesses cut operating costs, improve regulatory compliance, and reduce environmental impact. Backed by 500 Global, the company is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a product and marketing website but no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Isengard Industries Inc
providers.description: Isengard Industries builds sovereign production capability for defense: the means for allied nations to manufacture precision-strike and counter-drone (counter-UAS) systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what traditional prime contractors charge. The company describes its approach as "Weapons of Mass Production." Founded in 2026 and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, it is led by Francisco Serra-Martins (previously co-founder/CEO of Terminal Autonomy) and James Tennant (former Australian Army officer), and is headquartered in San Francisco. As a hardware and defense-manufacturing company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: LiquidLight
providers.description: LiquidLight, Inc. (Liquid Light) was an electrochemistry company based in Monmouth Junction, New Jersey that developed and licensed process technology for converting carbon dioxide into industrial chemicals. Founded in 2009 by Kyle Teamey, Emily Cole, Andrew Bocarsly, Fouad Elnaggar and Nety Krishna around technology licensed from Princeton University, the company built a portfolio of more than 100 patents covering the electrochemical production of chemicals including monoethylene glycol (MEG), propylene and acetic acid, with MEG as its lead target market. It raised seed funding from Redpoint Ventures and a $15 million Series B in September 2014 from investors including VantagePoint Capital Partners and BP Ventures, and was also a Battery Ventures portfolio investment. Avantium acquired Liquid Light on January 10, 2017 and the company ceased operating independently. LiquidLight was a materials and process-technology company: it never published a public API, developer portal, SDKs or any machine-readable developer surface, and no company web property survives the acquisition. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an accurate, non-API portfolio record.

providers.name: MBA Polymers
providers.description: MBA Polymers is a global plastics recycling company founded in 1997 that transforms waste plastics recovered from end-of-life durable goods such as computers, electronics, appliances, and automobiles into high-quality post-consumer recycled polymer granulates. Grades include ABS, impact-modified PS, PC/ABS, PP copolymer, and HDPE, produced through a three-step separate, clean, and finish process across operations in several countries. The company publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical developer surface; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile of balderton-capital.

providers.name: RecommerceX
providers.description: RecommerceX is an engineering-driven manufacturing company applying circular-economy practices to transform industrial waste into advanced engineering materials. It operates three flagship brands: RexSteel (seamless and ERW stainless steel pipes, tubes, forgings, flanges and heat-exchanger tubes), RexPol (HDPE and DWC polymer pipes, polymer compounds and engineering plastics), and RexTherm (critical infrastructure including liquid cooling, heat exchangers, power components and acoustics). It serves oil & gas, chemical, pharmaceutical, infrastructure, automotive, water, power and industrial manufacturing sectors. Surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site publishes no API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Rhoda Ai
providers.description: Rhoda AI develops robotic intelligence for real-world industrial and commercial environments, building general-purpose foundation models that adapt to the variability of physical work through its Direct Video Action model. Its robots handle tasks across automotive, manufacturing, logistics, and ecommerce, including returns processing, component handling, and material breakdown. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of Mayfield and currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Seppure
providers.description: SepPure Technologies (Seppure) is a deep-tech company building advanced organic solvent nanofiltration (OSN) membrane systems that make industrial chemical separation dramatically more sustainable, claiming processes up to 580x less energy intensive than conventional thermal separation. Its product line includes GreenMem organic solvent nanofiltration membranes, RE(SOLV) solvent recovery systems, and DE(SOLV) oil-refinery equipment, serving edible-oil refining, pharmaceutical filtration, semiconductor processing, and specialty chemicals across offices in Singapore and Calgary, Canada. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. Seppure sells membranes online at seppure.shop and publishes no public API, developer documentation, or GitHub organization at this time.

providers.name: Substrate
providers.description: Substrate is a semiconductor manufacturing company building America's next-generation chip foundry, with the stated mission of returning the United States to dominance in advanced semiconductor fabrication. Rather than designing chips, the company is inventing manufacturing technology intended to extend Moore's Law while lowering the cost of building state-of-the-art fabs and the wafers they produce. Substrate is a hard-tech / advanced-manufacturing venture backed by General Catalyst; it is a physical-infrastructure company and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the General Catalyst portfolio and enriched with the provider's public identity and security surface.

providers.name: Avery Dennison
providers.description: Avery Dennison is a global materials science and manufacturing company specializing in the design and manufacture of labeling and functional materials, packaging, and intelligent labels.

providers.name: Avnet
providers.description: Avnet is a global technology distributor and solutions provider that delivers electronic components, embedded solutions, and design and supply chain services to industrial and commercial customers.

providers.name: Kaiser Aluminum
providers.description: Kaiser Aluminum manufactures semi-fabricated aluminum products for industrial applications across aerospace, packaging, general engineering, and automotive markets. The nearly century-old company delivers highly engineered aluminum products focused on strength, weight efficiency, and sustainability. Kaiser Online serves as a customer portal for quotes, order tracking, depot stock searches, and material certifications.

providers.name: Manufactured
providers.description: Manufactured is a supply-chain and production platform for hardware and consumer-product brands, backed by Bullpen Capital. Its web application (app.manufactured.com) helps teams run overseas production end to end — issuing sourcing requests to vendors, managing supplier and vendor profiles, negotiating order estimates and contracts under master procurement agreements, tracking production timelines and calendars, and financing purchase orders through production and repayment terms. The product also embeds an AI assistant built on LangChain. At the time of enrichment the public marketing site and the api/docs/developer subdomains were unreachable, and the GraphQL, Lambda and bot backends are private and authentication-gated (introspection blocked), so no public API specification, developer portal, or documentation could be harvested. This profile captures the real, observable surface only.

providers.name: Mirana Toys
providers.description: Mirana Toys (Mirana Innovations Pvt Ltd) is an India-based smart-toy company and OEM/ODM manufacturer of electronic toys — RC cars, monster trucks, drones, educational toys, and AI/AR toys. It pairs its consumer products with the Mirana smart app (iOS and Android), a mobile gaming platform that lets kids and adults control and play with Mirana toys over Bluetooth. As an OEM partner it offers in-house PCB/PCBA design and SMT assembly, tooling and mold design, mobile app development, compliance support (ASTM, EN-71, RoHS, ISO, SMETA), and global logistics for toy brands and retailers. Backed by Accel. The company publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront and support center but no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Archimetis
providers.description: Archimetis builds an AI-powered Operational Reasoning System for refineries, chemicals, and heavy process industries. The platform unifies data from disparate operational sources — plant historians, linear programs, advanced process control models, and digital engineering documents — into a single intelligence layer, then continuously monitors operations, performs complex engineering analysis, and applies industry best practices to surface actionable insights for operators and engineers. Marketed as "See more. Solve smarter," it targets margin improvement, cost savings, and process safety across refining, chemicals, and other heavy industries. Founded in 2023, the company raised $11.5M led by Inspired Capital. Archimetis is an enterprise B2B platform engaged through guided working sessions and demos; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: BYD
providers.description: BYD Company Ltd. is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, founded in 1995 by Wang Chuanfu and publicly listed in Hong Kong (1211) and Shenzhen (002594). Originally a rechargeable-battery maker, BYD has grown into one of the world's largest producers of new-energy vehicles (battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars, buses, and trucks), power batteries (including the Blade Battery), consumer and automotive electronics, rail transit systems (SkyRail/SkyShuttle), forklifts, and solar and energy-storage products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; BYD is a hardware and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer or API program.

providers.name: Cellinobio
providers.description: Cellino Bio develops AI-driven optical bioprocessing technology for personalized regenerative medicine. Its proprietary Nebula platform combines deep learning, laser-based cell management, and closed-loop optical bioprocesses to manufacture patient-specific, induced-pluripotent-stem-cell-derived cell and tissue replacements at scale. The company targets degenerative and chronic conditions including kidney disease, lung disease, spinal cord injury, Alzheimer's, and diabetes. Cellino is a life-sciences/biotech company with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence and is backed by Felicis and Khosla Ventures.

providers.name: Conundrum
providers.description: Conundrum (Conundrum Industrial Ltd, Cambridge, UK) is an industrial AI company building AI-driven, closed-loop advanced process control (APC) and model predictive control (MPC) software for the metals, mining, and cement industries. Its platform combines physics-informed and machine-learning models with real-time controllers, optimizers, data-quality tooling, interactive process-flow diagrams, drag-and-drop dashboards, and a Python SDK for building configurable runtime applications. Conundrum optimizes crushing, grinding, flotation, and cement processes to raise throughput and metal recovery while reducing energy consumption, deployed on-premises or in the cloud across plants running 24/7. The company is backed by Speedinvest and reports deployments across multiple plants in several countries.

providers.name: ConXtech
providers.description: ConXtech is a Pleasanton, California structural steel subcontractor that designs, fabricates, delivers and erects prefabricated steel building frames for commercial construction. Its ConX Systems product line — the XL-400 and XR-200 chassis — uses patented collar-and-column connection technology and AISC 358 seismic prequalification to erect frames the company reports are three to five times faster than traditional steel erection, across healthcare, data center, retail, office, education, high-density residential, hospitality, industrial and government projects totalling more than 20 million square feet. ConXtech is a private company; its equity trades on secondary markets. It sells a physical building system, not software, and publishes no public developer program, API or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Ethonai
providers.description: EthonAI AG is an ETH Zurich spin-off (founded 2021, Zurich, Switzerland) that builds an Industrial AI Platform — the Manufacturing Analytics System (MAS). It applies Causal AI through a no-code platform so manufacturing engineers can move from reactive dashboards to prescriptive quality and process analytics, deploying models to production in hours. The platform ships as Analyst, Inspector, and Operator modules, is cloud-agnostic (AWS, GCP, Azure), and is API-first: data flows in and out via a REST API, MQTT streaming, and a Python SDK for notebooks and custom applications. EthonAI is used by manufacturers including Siemens, Bosch, Roche, and Lindt & Sprüngli, is part of the Siemens Xcelerator ecosystem, and is backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Earlybird, and Founderful. It does not publish a public API reference or developer portal; its API and SDK are documented inside the authenticated product.

providers.name: Northvolt
providers.description: Northvolt AB is a Swedish lithium-ion battery developer and manufacturer, founded in Stockholm in 2016, that built and operated the Northvolt Ett gigafactory in Skelleftea and the Northvolt Labs R&D and qualification campus in Vasteras, with further sites in Heide (Germany), Gdansk (Poland) and Montreal (Canada). Its product line covered lithium-ion, sodium-ion and lithium-metal cells, the Voltpack Core and Voltpack Mobile System battery energy storage systems, the Revolt battery recycling operation, and a Connected Battery telemetry and fleet-management service. Northvolt AB filed for bankruptcy in Sweden on 12 March 2025; through 2025 its remaining assets in Sweden, Germany and Poland were acquired by Lyten. The company never published a public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract; its only named developer-facing surface, api.northvolt.com, no longer has a reachable origin.

providers.name: Owens-Illinois (O-I Glass)
providers.description: Owens-Illinois (now O-I Glass) is one of the world's leading manufacturers of glass containers, supplying glass packaging to the food, beverage, beer, wine, spirits, and pharmaceutical industries. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Advex AI
providers.description: Advex AI (Advex AI, Inc., San Francisco / Pleasanton, California; founded 2022 by Pedro Pachuca and Qasim Wani) builds generative-AI synthetic data and self-healing computer vision for industrial quality inspection. Its flagship product, Composer, is a no-code AI vision system that lets manufacturing and logistics teams train, deploy and manage visual inspection tasks — defect and anomaly detection, pick-and-place, kitting and assembly verification, counting — from a handful of real images, using diffusion models to synthesize the missing training data and VLMs to run the inspection. Composer is sold as an on-premises appliance (the "Advex box") paired with plant cameras and is explicitly designed to run entirely on-device without network connectivity. The company raised a $3.5M seed round in November 2024 led by Construct Capital with Pear VC and Emerson Collective. As of this profile Advex publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind, and its own website is currently unpublished.

providers.name: Vanti Analytics
providers.description: Vanti Analytics was an Israeli adaptive-AI-for-manufacturing company backed by Insight Partners, offering AI-based defect detection, early fault prediction, predictive quality, and process tuning across production lines via a hosted application (app.vanti-analytics.com). The company published no public API, OpenAPI spec, SDKs, or developer program, and as of 2026-07-21 it has no live web presence - vanti-analytics.com has lapsed and is parked by a third party, vanti.ai is for sale, and the former app/support/docs subdomains no longer resolve.

providers.name: Aqrose Technology
providers.description: Aqrose Technology (阿丘科技) is an industrial AI machine-vision platform provider founded in Beijing in 2017 out of the Tsinghua University AI Lab, now dual-headquartered in Beijing and Singapore with offices in Suzhou, Shenzhen, Hsinchu, Berlin, Tokyo, and Seoul. The company builds AI tools, models, and turnkey systems for manufacturing quality control, safety inspection, and process optimization, with 20,000+ AI deployments across 1,200+ clients in 50+ industrial sectors. Its product line spans the AIDI defect-inspection platform, the AQVision low-code AI vision development toolkit, the AIDG toolkit, the SV2000 smart vision hardware, an AI Review System (ARS), a robot inspection system, and the AQ-VLM industrial vision-language model, serving EV batteries, automotive, semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, electronics, photovoltaics, food and beverage, and packaging. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Atlas Motion Systems
providers.description: Atlas Motion Systems (atlasmotion.com) designs and builds brushless DC (BLDC) motors and actuators for defense and robotics applications, engineered around a customer's specific program and manufactured at scale. The public web presence is a single-page marketing site (hero plus a contact page); it is a hardware company that does not publish a developer portal, public API, SDKs, documentation, or well-known discovery surface. This profile was seeded as a Homebrew-portfolio lead and enriched with verifiable identity and live domain-security probe data only. Enrichment found no API surface to harvest.

providers.name: Cerrion
providers.description: Cerrion builds enterprise-grade video AI agents for manufacturing. Its platform connects to existing or provided factory cameras to monitor production lines in real time, using pre-trained visual triggers to automatically detect and respond to quality defects, safety hazards, process deviations, and equipment issues. The closed-loop system can slow or stop machines, raise alarms, and escalate alerts while giving operators root-cause insight, helping manufacturers resolve problems up to 50% faster and cut downtime and scrap. Cerrion is deployed in live production across glass, food & beverage, tableware, sawmilling/timber, and CPG environments (customers include Unilever, Riedel, Schott Zwiesel, Stölzle Lausitz, Sisecam, and Verallia). Zurich-based and backed by Creandum, Y Combinator, Goat Capital, 10x Founders, and Session VC. No public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Cooper Tire & Rubber
providers.description: Cooper Tire & Rubber Company is an American manufacturer of replacement tires for passenger cars, light trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles, founded in 1914 and headquartered in Findlay, Ohio. Cooper was acquired by The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company in June 2021 and now operates as a subsidiary, retaining the Cooper brand alongside Goodyear. The Cooper brand portfolio covers all-season, winter, all-terrain, and sport performance tires distributed through retailers and dealers worldwide. Cooper Tire does not publish a public developer program or REST APIs. Its digital presence is consumer-facing tire selection, retailer locators, and post-purchase tire registration.

providers.name: Fabrion
providers.description: Fabrion builds an AI Operating System for industrial manufacturers, applying artificial intelligence to manufacturing operations and the industrial sector. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of 8vc and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As of this enrichment pass Fabrion publishes a marketing website with AI Lab, Careers, and Contact pages, but exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, packages, MCP server, or other machine-readable developer artifacts. No developer, docs, or api subdomains resolve and no /.well-known/, llms.txt, pricing, or blog surfaces were found. This remains a lead awaiting a real API surface to enrich against.

providers.name: Kintep (Jiangsu Kintep Environmental Protection Co., Ltd.)
providers.description: Jiangsu Kintep Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. (江苏康泰环保股份有限公司), founded in 2011 and headquartered in Taizhou, Jiangsu, China, is a national high-tech enterprise that designs, manufactures, sells, and services new-type environmental-protection equipment and complete turnkey solutions. Kintep focuses on solid-liquid separation and intelligent sludge / pollutant collection and treatment. Its KINTEP product line includes multi-disc (stacked-screw) sludge dewatering machines, integrated automatic chemical dosing units, dense-phase belt sludge deep-dewatering machines, high-efficiency fully-automatic filter-press systems, Lamella sedimentation tanks, and screw presses. The company operates seven national customer-service centers (Shenzhen, Wuhan, Chongqing, Xi'an, Tianjin, Shanghai, Yixing) and exports to customers worldwide. Kintep is a physical industrial-equipment manufacturer and does not publish a public web API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: TripleW Ltd.
providers.description: TripleW Ltd. (Belgian operating entity TripleW NV) is an industrial biotechnology and specialty-chemicals company founded in 2016, headquartered at Innovatiestraat 1, 2030 Antwerpen, Belgium, with a US office in Shorewood, Wisconsin and R&D split between Israel and Belgium. Its patented process treats food waste as a third-generation renewable feedstock: hydrolysis, fermentation and purification yield pure lactic acid, sold under the Circulac brand in grades for personal care, home care, food and beverage and industrial use, and as the building block of polylactic acid (PLA) bioplastic. The same process chemically recycles discarded PLA back into feedstock, and can be installed inside existing waste-management infrastructure. Its flagship commercial Circulac facility is at the Port of Antwerp. TripleW sells industrial chemical product and engineering services, not software: no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Sila Nanotechnologies
providers.description: Sila Nanotechnologies is a next-generation battery materials company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Alameda, California, with a commercial-scale manufacturing plant in Moses Lake, Washington. Sila develops silicon-based anode materials — marketed as Titan Silicon — that replace conventional graphite anodes to increase the energy density of lithium-ion batteries used in consumer electronics, electric vehicles, and other applications. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8VC and Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Sila is a physical materials and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web and security posture only.

providers.name: 3S robotics
providers.description: 3S robotics (Shanghai Shengshi Weisheng Technology Co., Ltd. / 上海昇视唯盛科技有限公司) is a Chinese intelligent-robotics manufacturer founded in 2020 and headquartered in the Songjiang district of Shanghai, with a smart factory in the Haining Economic Development Zone, Zhejiang. It is a member company of the listed Harbin Institute of Technology intelligent-robotics group (哈工智能), and its majority-held subsidiary Hagong Hyundai (哈工现代, HGXD) builds general-purpose industrial robots. The company develops an in-house "AI + 3D + ROBOT" stack — machine-vision cameras, motion control, and offline path-planning software — packaged as task-specific intelligent robots for welding, grinding and assembly, marketed as needing no teach-pendant programming. Its flagship line is a 3D-vision intelligent welding robot aimed at steel-structure, tunnel arch, rail-transit and heavy-equipment fabrication. The software it ships is embedded machine-side control and vision tooling sold with the hardware; the company publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: Kytopen
providers.description: Kytopen Corp. is a Cambridge, Massachusetts life-sciences instrument company, spun out of MIT, that builds non-viral, continuous-flow cellular engineering hardware for cell and gene therapy discovery and manufacturing. Its Flowfect technology combines continuous fluid flow with electric fields to deliver mRNA, DNA and CRISPR payloads into cells, and is sold as two benchtop platforms: Flowfect Discover, an automated small-volume system that runs up to 96 high-throughput transfections in about ten minutes, and Flowfect TX, a closed-system instrument that processes 10-50 million cells per mL at 25-50 mL per minute for GMP-scale manufacturing. The company sells laboratory instruments and consumables to biopharma and CDMO customers through a quote and technology-access motion; it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Instrument data integration for Flowfect customers is delivered by a third party, Ganymede Bio, under its own platform and its own contract - that surface belongs to Ganymede, not to Kytopen.

providers.name: Aleris
providers.description: Aleris was a global producer of rolled aluminum products serving the aerospace, automotive, building and construction, and other industrial end-use markets. Founded as IMCO Recycling and later renamed Aleris International, the company operated manufacturing plants across North America, Europe, and Asia. Aleris was acquired by Novelis Inc. (a subsidiary of Hindalco Industries) on April 14, 2020 for approximately $2.8 billion. The company's primary product lines included aluminum sheet, plate, and engineered products for demanding applications such as aerospace structures and automotive body panels. As a manufacturing-focused business, Aleris did not maintain a public developer API program, but engaged in B2B EDI integrations with major customers and suppliers across its supply chain. The Aleris brand has since been absorbed into Novelis and aleris.com no longer serves a website.

providers.name: Aris Machina
providers.description: Aris Machina builds AI-powered industrial software for advanced manufacturing, describing its mission as delivering "industrial superintelligence" that unifies design, production, and operations through AI agents and a shared semantic knowledge model. Its products include Protos, an AI co-engineer for R&D teams that accelerates design validation and simulation; Gemba, shopfloor operational agents that provide real-time equipment diagnostics; and the Ontology Toolkit, a knowledge-integration layer that bridges data across MES, ERP, and PLM systems. Aris Machina serves batteries, biopharma, robotics, defense, and aerospace, and is backed by Earlybird. The company operates from Stockholm, Bangalore, and California. This profile was surfaced as an Earlybird portfolio company and enriched from public web sources; Aris Machina does not currently publish a public developer API surface, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs.

providers.name: Baan
providers.description: Baan (Baan Company N.V., originally The Baan Corporation) was a Dutch enterprise resource planning software vendor founded in 1978 in Barneveld, Netherlands by Jan Baan and later joined by his brother Paul Baan. Baan built one of the first genuinely component-based ERP suites, known for its Dynamic Enterprise Modeler (DEM), its Baan Tools 4GL development environment, and deep manufacturing and project-industry functionality. At its late-1990s peak Baan served roughly 3,000 customers and posted close to $700 million in revenue, making it one of the leading global ERP providers alongside SAP, Oracle and PeopleSoft. Following accounting controversy and a collapse in its share price, Baan was acquired by the British engineering group Invensys in 2000, sold on to SSA Global Technologies in 2003, and absorbed into Infor Global Solutions when Infor acquired SSA in 2006. Baan no longer exists as an operating company or an independent brand: the product line lives on as Infor LN, and the baan.com and baan.nl domains now permanently redirect to the Infor LN product page. Consequently this profile carries no first-party API surface of its own — any modern programmatic access to the Baan lineage is delivered through Infor LN REST APIs and the Infor ION API gateway on Infor's developer platform. Baan Company is listed by Battery Ventures as an exited investment.

providers.name: Dyna Robotics
providers.description: Dyna Robotics is a Redwood City, California robotics AI company founded in 2024 by Lindon Gao, York Yang and Jason Ma to build robot foundation models for real-world commercial automation. Its DYNA-1 vision-language-action (VLA) model drives pairs of stationary robotic arms through high-dexterity tasks such as napkin folding and garment handling, and the company reports a 99%+ autonomous success rate over 24-hour continuous runs. Dyna targets commercial laundry, food service and factory environments, and closed a $120M Series A in September 2025 led by Robostrategy, CRV and First Round Capital with participation from NVentures, the Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, Salesforce Ventures, Samsung Next and LG Technology Ventures, following a $23.5M seed. Dyna sells robotics-as-a-service rather than software: enrichment probing of dyna.co found no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK, developer portal, MCP server, agent card, or event surface.

providers.name: Krosslinker
providers.description: Krosslinker (KrossLinker) is a Singapore-based deep-tech advanced-materials company that designs and manufactures silica aerogels — among the most insulating solids known — using a proprietary, water-based and scalable chemistry and manufacturing platform the company calls Aspire. Its product line spans Cryar super-insulating aerogel composite board, QuintAero ultra-light silica aerogel powder, KrossShield SR Pro aerogel-powered cooling paint, and a flexible aerogel blanket in development, serving cold-chain pharma and food packaging, building and construction passive cooling, and industrial insulation. Krosslinker operates from CleanTech III in Singapore and is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a physical-materials manufacturer and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile captures its public web, product, and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Leggett and Platt
providers.description: Leggett and Platt is a diversified manufacturer that designs and produces engineered components and products found in many homes, offices, vehicles, and aircraft, including bedding components, automotive seating, hydraulic cylinders, and aerospace tube assemblies. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: USG
providers.description: USG Corporation is a leading manufacturer of building products and innovative solutions for the construction industry. USG produces Sheetrock brand drywall, Durock cement board, Securock glass-mat sheathing, and a wide range of interior finishing systems. The company serves contractors, architects, and building professionals through its distributor network and provides digital tools and APIs to support the building and construction workflow.

providers.name: Veo Robotics
providers.description: Veo Robotics built FreeMove, a 3D depth-sensing computer vision safety system that lets standard industrial robots work safely alongside people by monitoring workcells and dynamically restricting or resuming robot motion. Backed by GV and Lux Capital, the company's assets - including FreeMove and related intellectual property - were acquired by Symbotic in July 2024, and veobot.com now redirects to symbotic.com. Veo Robotics published no public API surface; this profile records the company in the API Evangelist network graph.

providers.name: MasterBrand
providers.description: MasterBrand, Inc. is the largest manufacturer of residential cabinets in North America, producing kitchen, bath, and home organization cabinetry across a portfolio of brands sold through dealers, retailers, and builders. The company designs, manufactures, and distributes a wide array of cabinetry products under brands such as Aristokraft, Diamond, Mid-Continent, Schrock, and others. MasterBrand does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: AI-Prime (Paidao Intelligence)
providers.description: AI-Prime (Paidao Intelligence / 湃道智能) is a Shanghai-based industrial-safety AI company founded in 2017 that builds computer-vision, deep-learning, and knowledge-graph platforms for high-hazard industries. Its full-stack products span an AI industrial-safety monitoring cloud platform, 40+ safety-scenario models (PPE detection, unsafe behavior, equipment leaks, fire/smoke, work-process compliance), a self-learning AI model-development platform, and Prime-Edge smart hardware (edge-computing boxes, inspection robots, AR work mirrors, and edge cameras) serving the chemical, steel, coal, oil & gas, energy, and mining sectors. AI-Prime is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It is an enterprise B2B provider with no public developer API program; this profile captures its identity and web presence.

providers.name: Arcstone
providers.description: Arcstone is a Singapore-based digital manufacturing technology company (founded 2013) that helps enterprises digitalize and gain real-time transparency across their shop floors and supply chains. Its product family spans arc.essentials (a lightweight Manufacturing Execution System for SMEs), arc.ops (a modular, next-generation MES for large enterprises), arc.net (multi-tier supply chain visibility), arc.studio (a low-code enterprise app and integration platform), arc.green (sustainability tracking), and arc.ai (an AI control tower for managed AI workforce deployment). Arcstone serves precision engineering, FMCG, mining, semiconductor, plastics, and biomedical manufacturers, and was named a Gartner Cool Vendor in Manufacturing Operations in 2022. The company is backed by 500 Global. No public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published at this time; this profile carries the identity and infrastructure signals harvested by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Boise Cascade
providers.description: Boise Cascade is a leading North American manufacturer and distributor of building materials for the residential and commercial construction industry. The company produces engineered wood products (EWP) including I-joists, LVL beams, and glulam, as well as structural panels and lumber, and distributes a broad range of building materials through its wholesale distribution network.

providers.name: Cambrio
providers.description: Cambrio is a manufacturing software company, now a Sandvik-owned brand, that develops CAD/CAM software for CNC programming and digital manufacturing. Its portfolio spans GibbsCAM for CNC milling and turning, SigmaNEST for nesting and material optimization, and Cimatron for integrated tooling and mold design. Cambrio serves the automotive, aerospace, medical, electronics, and general manufacturing industries. It was a Battery Ventures portfolio company before being acquired by Sandvik AB in 2021. Cambrio is desktop/on-premises manufacturing software and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Galactic Energy
providers.description: Galactic Energy (星河动力航天 — Galactic Energy (Beijing) Space Technology Co., Ltd.) is a private Chinese commercial launch company founded on 6 February 2018 and headquartered in Beijing E-Town. It builds and flies the Ceres family of solid-propellant small-lift rockets (Ceres-1, the sea-launched Ceres-1S, and the larger 3.35 m Ceres-2) and is developing the partly reusable liquid oxygen/kerosene Pallas-1 and Pallas-2 medium-lift vehicles, the Eros vehicle, the Welkin (苍穹) CQ-series liquid propellant engines, and the Edge attitude and orbital control system. Its public web surface is a corporate marketing site at galactic-energy.cn carrying product pages, a launch plan, completed-mission history, a news feed, careers listings, a Chinese-language document centre of launch-vehicle user manuals (PDF), and an HTML launch-reservation form. Contract discovery on 2026-08-04 found no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API surface of any kind: every probe for OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL, MCP, an A2A agent card, /llms.txt, robots.txt and the full /.well-known/ discovery set returned HTTP 404 on every galactic-energy.cn host, and no api./developer./docs. subdomain resolves. This profile is therefore identity and domain-security only.

providers.name: Grainger
providers.description: W.W. Grainger, Inc. is a Fortune 500 industrial supply company headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois. Grainger distributes maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) products and services to businesses, government agencies, and institutions across North America, Japan, and the United Kingdom. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Grainger. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Graphic Packaging
providers.description: Graphic Packaging International is a Fortune 500 global manufacturer of sustainable, paperboard-based consumer packaging. Products include folding cartons, multipack cartons, foodservice packaging (cups, lids, to-go containers), microwave and ovenable packaging, paperboard canisters, and packaging machinery. Markets served include food, beverage, foodservice, household, personal care, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, pet care, beauty, and e-commerce. No public developer APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: Greenbrier Companies
providers.description: The Greenbrier Companies is a leading international supplier of equipment and services to global freight transportation markets, designing, building, and marketing freight railcars in North America, Europe, and South America. Greenbrier also offers railcar leasing, repair, and digital fleet management services such as RailPulse.

providers.name: Hermeus
providers.description: Hermeus is an American aerospace and defense company building rapidly reusable high-Mach and hypersonic aircraft for national-security missions in partnership with the U.S. Department of Defense. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the company applies a hardware-rich, rapid design-build-test approach to move quickly from concept to flight. Its programs include Quarterhorse, a reusable high-speed flight-test aircraft; Darkhorse, a multi-mission reusable hypersonic uncrewed aerial system (UAS); and Chimera, a hybrid turbine-based combined-cycle engine that transitions from turbojet takeoff through supersonic flight into hypersonic acceleration. Hermeus is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile tracks the company's public web, security, and corporate properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Huntsman Corporation
providers.description: Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global chemical manufacturer of differentiated and specialty chemicals serving a diverse range of consumer and industrial end markets, with operating segments in polyurethanes, performance products, and advanced materials. Huntsman maintains a Technology Portal for partner collaborations, but no public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Martin Marietta Materials
providers.description: Martin Marietta Materials is a leading supplier of building materials, including aggregates, cement, ready-mixed concrete, asphalt, and paving products, used in construction, infrastructure, and residential projects across the United States.

providers.name: MITO Material Solutions
providers.description: MITO Material Solutions (MITO Materials) is a specialty chemical company that develops patented hybrid additive technology to strengthen composite and thermoplastic materials. Its platform functionalizes graphene and biomaterials to improve strength, durability, flexibility, and sustainability without requiring changes to a manufacturer's existing process. Core products include the MITO hybrid additive platform, MITO E-GO, MITO E-GO Res-1, and MITO ACRE, serving the sports and recreation, transportation, automotive, and infrastructure industries. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass, MITO publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Monolith AI
providers.description: Monolith AI develops artificial-intelligence software for engineering product development, helping R&D and test-lab teams validate physical products faster. Its cloud SaaS platform pairs a notebook-style workspace with proprietary self-learning models built for engineers: a Test Data Validation module whose anomaly detector flags errors across hundreds of data channels, a Test Plan Optimisation module whose next-test recommender can cut test plans by up to 70%, and a System Calibration module that tunes performance across operating conditions. It serves battery, automotive, aerospace and defense, and industrial and medical engineering teams. Monolith AI is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. No public developer API, portal, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: Packaging Corporation of America
providers.description: Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is the third largest producer of containerboard and corrugated packaging products in the United States, supplying packaging to food, beverage, and industrial customers. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Phantom Space
providers.description: Phantom Space Corporation is an American space transportation and satellite manufacturing company founded in 2019 and headquartered at 1816 S Research Loop in Tucson, Arizona. Co-founded by Jim Cantrell, Michael D'Angelo and Michal Prywata, it is developing the Daytona family of small-lift orbital launch vehicles — Daytona I, II and III — alongside modular satellite buses, spacecraft manufacturing and constellation deployment services, pursuing a mass-manufacturing, fully US-based supply chain approach to launch and spacecraft production. The company acquired StratSpace and Micro Aerospace Solutions in 2021 to build out its satellite supply chain. Phantom Space sells launch capacity and satellite build programs through direct commercial contracts; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Photon Crystal Energy
providers.description: Photon Crystal Energy Technology Ltd. (广东光晶能源科技有限公司) is a China-based perovskite photovoltaic module manufacturer, founded May 2022 and headquartered in Foshan, Guangdong. The company commercializes full wet-process, full-printed perovskite PV modules for building-integrated photovoltaics (BIPV), photovoltaic curtain walls, rooftop distributed solar, carports and architectural solar applications. Product families include standard, semi-transparent, textured, architectural color and solar tile modules, and the firm operates a 100 MW full-printed perovskite pilot line with IEC 61215 / IEC 61730 certification milestones. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a marketing/corporate website but no public API, SDK, or developer surface.

providers.name: Plantd
providers.description: Plantd is an American advanced-materials manufacturer based in Oxford, North Carolina, founded in 2021 by former SpaceX engineers Nathan Silvernail (CEO) and Huade Tan (CTO) with Josh Dorfman (CMO). The company grows and harvests fast-growing perennial grass on farms across North Carolina and Virginia and presses it into carbon-negative structural building panels intended to replace oriented strand board (OSB), plywood and other timber-based sheathing. Production runs on a modular, all-electric, closed-loop manufacturing platform in a 150,000+ sq ft facility, with a research farm in Stovall, NC. Customers and partners include homebuilder D.R. Horton and furniture brand Studio TK. Plantd has raised roughly $47.5M across seed, Series A and a $22M Series B (October 2025). Plantd is a physical-goods manufacturer: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind — this profile records that absence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Scodix
providers.description: Scodix is a digital print enhancement (embellishment) technology company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Rosh HaAyin, Israel. It manufactures the Scodix Ultra series of digital embellishment presses and the Scodix Studio web-to-print software, enabling decorative effects across 17 applications including Spot UV, foil, glitter, metallic, cast-and-cure, braille and variable data. Scodix serves commercial print, folding-carton packaging, publishing and web-to-print markets with over 400 installations worldwide, and went public on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE) in 2021. Scodix Studio exposes integration APIs for connecting embellishment workflows to MIS and web-to-print storefronts, but Scodix does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or self-serve API documentation.

providers.name: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings
providers.description: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings is one of the world's largest manufacturers of aerostructures for commercial airplanes, defense platforms, and business and regional jets. Spirit designs and builds fuselages, pylons, nacelles, and wing components for major aircraft programs including Boeing 737 MAX, 787, and Airbus A350. The company does not publicly expose developer APIs; its digital operations are focused on internal supply chain, manufacturing execution, and enterprise systems.

providers.name: Vulcan Elements
providers.description: Vulcan Elements is a United States manufacturer of sintered permanent neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) rare earth magnets, founded in 2023 and headquartered in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina. The company produces high-performance rare earth magnets domestically for defense and commercial applications — the components that convert electricity into motion in motors, drones, robotics, vehicles and consumer electronics — as an alternative to a supply chain concentrated in China. In 2025 it announced a $65 million Series A, a $620 million loan from the Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital, and a $1.4 billion partnership with the U.S. government and ReElement Technologies to build a vertically integrated domestic magnet supply chain, including a nearly $1 billion, 1,000-job magnet factory in Benson, Johnston County, North Carolina. Vulcan Elements is a physical-goods manufacturer: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Zetwerk
providers.description: Zetwerk is a global contract-manufacturing and B2B supply-chain company that connects original equipment manufacturers with a vetted network of manufacturing partners across processes including CNC machining, die casting, forging, injection molding, and sheet-metal stamping. It serves industries such as aerospace and defense, automotive, consumer electronics, renewable energy, and industrial equipment, offering production sourcing, quoting, and program management. Backed by Accel, D1 Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Lightspeed Venture Partners, Zetwerk operates as a manufacturing services marketplace rather than a developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: AEOL
providers.description: AEOL (AEOL KOREA Co., Ltd. / 주식회사 에이올코리아) is a South Korean advanced-materials and climate-technology manufacturer founded in February 2018 out of the Korea University Campus Town programme and headquartered in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province. The company holds a twenty-year exclusive licence from the Korea Research Institute of Chemical Technology to manufacture and sell Metal-Organic Framework (MOF) materials, and was the first Korean firm to commercialise MOF production at scale. It turns that porous-adsorbent chemistry into physical equipment: MOF desiccant rotors and hybrid dehumidifiers that regenerate at low temperature instead of using refrigerant compression, all-in-one units combining heat-recovery ventilation with UV-LED and HEPA air purification and auxiliary cooling, harmful-gas and odour adsorption products such as the Red Dot-awarded Mofresh Mini, and the CarbonSorV rotary wheel for continuous CO2 capture shown at CES 2025. AEOL won a CES 2024 Innovation Award and the FIX 2024 Grand Innovation Award, has raised roughly USD 10-23 million from investors including KU Startup, BlissVine Ventures, JCGI, KNET Investment Partners and NH Venture Investment, and sells through appliance-maker R&D partnerships and distribution agreements in North America and New Zealand. AEOL sells hardware and materials, not software: it operates a single Korean-language Cafe24-hosted corporate site with no developer section, publishes no API documentation, SDK, webhook or machine-readable API contract of any kind, and maintains no public code repositories or package-registry releases.

providers.name: Boston Metal
providers.description: Boston Metal is an industrial metals and materials company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, with a wholly owned subsidiary and commercial plant in Brazil. The company commercializes Molten Oxide Electrolysis (MOE), a one-step electrochemical process that uses clean electricity rather than fossil fuels to reduce iron ore into liquid metal, producing steel with no direct CO2 emissions, and to recover high-value critical metals such as niobium and tantalum from low-grade ore and mining waste. Boston Metal commissioned a multi-inert-anode industrial MOE cell at its Woburn facility and has raised over $500 million from investors including Tata Steel. Boston Metal is a physical process-technology and manufacturing company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, or machine-readable contract of any kind. This profile captures its public web, corporate, and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Firehawk Aerospace
providers.description: Firehawk Aerospace, Inc. is a Dallas, Texas defense-technology manufacturer founded in 2019 by Ronald Jones, Will Edwards and Steve Edwards that replaces conventional rocket-propulsion production with additive manufacturing. Its proprietary 3D-printed solid rocket fuel, branded 3D-Ultra, is used to build hybrid rocket engines and solid rocket motors whose fuel-grain geometry is printed rather than cast, cutting production timelines from years to weeks while removing the handling hazards of traditional energetics. The company works under U.S. Army Applications Laboratory SBIR Phase III and U.S. Air Force Test Center contracts, has flight-tested an additively manufactured GMLRS-class analog, and is expanding manufacturing capacity in Lawton, Oklahoma and Crawford, Mississippi. Firehawk now operates publicly as Firehawk Defense (firehawkdefense.com); the firehawkaerospace.com domain 301-redirects there. It is a hardware and energetics manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Project Prometheus
providers.description: Prometheus (announced in November 2025 as Project Prometheus) is a San Francisco based artificial intelligence company co-founded by Jeff Bezos and Vik Bajaj, who serve as co-CEOs. The company builds what it calls an "artificial general engineer" — physical-AI models intended to automate the design, simulation and manufacture of complex physical systems across computing, aerospace, automotive production and drug development, learning from real-world trial and error rather than from text corpora alone.
