It launched with roughly $6.2B in funding and raised a ~$12B Series B in June 2026 at a reported $41B valuation, backed by Bezos, ARCH Venture Partners, JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs and BlackRock, with offices in San Francisco, London and Zurich. As of August 2026 the company remains in stealth: prometheus.ai is served entirely behind a Vercel bot challenge, and no public developer portal, documentation, API, first-party GitHub organization, package or machine-readable contract could be located.

providers.name: SJSemi
providers.description: SJSemi (SJSemiconductor (Jiangyin) Corp.) is a Chinese semiconductor Middle-End-Of-Line (MEOL) pure-play foundry and outsourced assembly and test (OSAT) provider, founded in 2014 as a joint venture between JCET and SMIC and headquartered in the Jiangyin High-Tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu, with offices in Shanghai and Santa Clara, California. The company operates a 12-inch wafer bumping, wafer-level chip-scale packaging, chip probing and final-test line, and supplies advanced packaging and 3D multi-die integration services — Cu pillar, RDL, fan-out, TSV and silicon interposer 2.5D — into smartphone, 5G communications, high-performance computing, data-center and automotive electronics supply chains. It is a contract manufacturer of physical semiconductor packaging services and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: Tidal Vision
providers.description: Tidal Vision Products, Inc. is a Bellingham, Washington biotechnology and specialty-chemicals manufacturer, and the only commercial-scale US producer of chitosan — a non-toxic, non-hazmat, biodegradable industrial biopolymer upcycled from crab and shrimp shell waste. Its zero-waste Chitofining process extracts, modifies and formulates chitosan chemistries that displace PFAS, halogenated chemicals, toxic antimicrobials and persistent plastics across three business lines: Tidal Clear water and wastewater treatment, Tidal Grow AgriScience crop and soil inputs, and Tidal-Tec Biomaterial Science performance materials. The company closed an oversubscribed $140M+ Series B in 2025 and acquired Clear Water Services. It is a materials-science manufacturer and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: 011h
providers.description: 011h (011h Sustainable Construction S.L.) is a Barcelona-based construction technology company founded in 2020 that designs and builds low-carbon residential, affordable-housing, flex-living and hospitality buildings using an industrialized building system and a digital platform connecting factory, design and site. The company combines standardized hybrid concrete/wood/steel prefabricated components, an integrated network of qualified manufacturers, and an in-house software platform covering design, contracting and construction execution with end-to-end traceability. It is a certified B Corporation and raised EUR 20M in October 2025 co-led by Ship2B Ventures and CDTI. As of this profile 011h publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; its software is an internal/customer-facing product rather than a platform API.

providers.name: Axalta Coating Systems
providers.description: Axalta Coating Systems is a global supplier of liquid and powder coatings for transportation and industrial end-markets, operating through Performance Coatings (refinish and industrial) and Mobility Coatings (light vehicle and commercial vehicle) segments. Brands include Cromax, Spies Hecker, Standox, Imron, and Voltatex. In July 2024 Axalta acquired The CoverFlexx Group from Transtar Holding for $285 million to expand its economy-tier aftermarket coverage in North America. In November 2025 Axalta announced a $17 billion all-stock merger of equals with AkzoNobel that is expected to close in late 2026 or early 2027, forming a coatings company with dual headquarters in Amsterdam and Philadelphia.

providers.name: Boson Motors
providers.description: Boson Motors is an electric vehicle and robotics company founded in 2017, building a modular electric off-road utility vehicle (UTV) platform for agriculture, farm automation, and work applications. Its flagship LX40 is a user-serviceable, low-maintenance electric 4WD UTV that charges from a standard 110v outlet and accepts interchangeable work modules for spraying, hauling, and crew transport. The company operates engineering and production out of Tada, Andhra Pradesh, India, with a strategic base in Fremont, California, and maintains a robotics arm (Boson Robotics) focused on autonomous and agricultural automation. Boson Motors is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer marketing and reservation site with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer documentation; its public engineering footprint is a GitHub organization of ROS/robotics libraries. This profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead and enrichment target.

providers.name: Factory OS
providers.description: Factory OS (styled Factory_OS) is an off-site construction company founded in 2017 by Rick Holliday and Larry Pace that industrialized multifamily and affordable housing production on an assembly line inside a 275,000-square-foot facility in Building 680 on Mare Island in Vallejo, California. Union carpenters build wood-frame housing modules across roughly two dozen stations in a 33-step process, and the finished modules are trucked to the project site and assembled — an approach the company says cuts production time by about half and production cost by a quarter against conventional site-built construction. It raised roughly $132 million across three rounds, including $60 million from JPMorgan Chase and Saint-Gobain in 2021, and delivered more than 4,000 homes across California and Hawaii, about 90 percent of them affordable housing. In May 2024 the company was recapitalized and renamed Harbinger Homes (legal entity Harbinger Production Inc.), with Tom Smith as CEO and Kevin Brown as president; factoryos.com now 301-redirects every path to harbinger.homes. Harbinger filed a WARN notice on 12 February 2026 covering all 280 employees, citing a lack of new business and loss of capital funding, with layoffs beginning 13 April 2026. Factory OS is a manufacturer of physical housing modules, not a software company: it operates no developer program, API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification of any kind, and its GitHub organization has no public repositories.

providers.name: Foundation Robotics Labs
providers.description: Foundation Robotics Labs — trading publicly as Foundation and incorporated as Foundation Future Industries, Inc. — is a San Francisco humanoid robotics company founded in April 2024 by Sankaet Pathak, Arjun Sethi and Mike LeBlanc. It builds Phantom, a general-purpose humanoid robot aimed at industrial automation, logistics, inspection, disaster response and defense, and Cortex, the company's self-described physics foundation model built on Deep Variational Bayes Filters that pairs physics-informed prediction with vision-language reasoning to drive the robot. The company's published master plan runs from building humanoids through fleet coherence and on to building cities, and it states explicitly that it designs for military environments, unlike U.S. competitors committed to non-weaponization. Foundation has raised a reported $111M and is traded on the secondary market via Forge Global. As of this profile Foundation publishes NO public developer surface — no developer portal, documentation, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI definition, SDK, package, MCP server or agent card. Its entire public web presence is a five-page Framer marketing site (home, Phantom, Cortex, master plan, culture, careers) with no /docs, /developers, /api, /pricing, /terms or /privacy paths and no llms.txt. Its GitHub organization (github.com/foundationbot, verified first-party by @foundation.bot commit-author domains) holds internal test benches and forks of open-source robotics tooling — Drake, jetson-containers, Kalibr, PlotJuggler, Fast-DDS, an EtherCAT master, actuator dyno benches and NXP S32K MCU demos — and contains no API specification of any kind.

providers.name: Hyster-Yale Materials Handling
providers.description: Hyster-Yale Materials Handling is a global designer, engineer, manufacturer, seller, and servicer of a comprehensive line of forklifts and aftermarket parts marketed under the Hyster and Yale brands. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and integration touchpoints associated with Hyster-Yale.

providers.name: INDEX Robotics
providers.description: INDEX Robotics is a South Korean humanoid robotics startup based in Seongnam (Bundang) building high-precision actuators and upper-body humanoid robots for high-mix, low-volume industrial work. Its core products are the IA Series, a family of high-precision actuators purpose-built for humanoid joints, and INDEX01, a compact upper-body humanoid prototype that deliberately foregoes a mobile base so it can slot into constrained factory workspaces for logistics handling, machining support, and precision assembly. The company treats joint precision, responsiveness under sustained repetitive motion, and long-run performance consistency as the core unsolved problems in humanoid commercialization. In February 2026 INDEX Robotics closed a $1M (KRW 1.5B) seed round led by Futureplay with Bass Ventures and 500 Global co-investing. This is a hardware company with no public API, SDK, or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Local Motors
providers.description: Local Motors was an American vehicle manufacturer founded in 2007 by John "Jay" Rogers Jr. that built vehicles through open co-creation and distributed "microfactories" rather than conventional mass production. Its community designed and the company produced the Rally Fighter off-road car from its first Chandler, Arizona microfactory, the Strati — the first car to be 3D-printed live, in 44 hours at IMTS 2014 — and, from 2016, Olli, a 3D-printed electric autonomous shuttle whose conversational passenger interface ran on IBM Watson and which was piloted at National Harbor, Maryland and other campus and transit sites. The company operated microfactories in Chandler, Knoxville and National Harbor and spun its crowdsourcing community out as Launch Forth. Local Motors ceased operations in January 2022 after fifteen years, having failed to raise further capital, and its intellectual-property portfolio was acquired by drone manufacturer RapidFlight of Manassas, Virginia in July 2023. Local Motors never operated a public developer program: the archive of localmotors.com holds an internal django-tastypie JSON API under /api/v1/ that served the co-creation community website, but no developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable specification was ever published, and its GitHub organization has zero public repositories. The domain is no longer the company's — it now answers HTTP 301 on every path to a third-party affiliate article — so there is no live API surface to catalog. This profile is retained as a historical record.

providers.name: LyondellBasell
providers.description: LyondellBasell Industries N.V. (NYSE: LYB) is one of the world's largest producers of polymers and plastic resins, including polyethylene, polypropylene, and specialty polyolefins such as Catalloy and Polybutene-1. The company also produces chemicals, fuels, polyolefin process technology, and advanced polymer solutions, and operates a Circular & Low Carbon Solutions (CLCS) business marketing CirculenRecover and CirculenRenew recycled and renewable polymers. LyondellBasell has no public developer program, no API documentation, and no source code published in its (empty) GitHub organization. In January 2025 the company began the permanent closure of its Houston Refining facility — the 263,776 bpd, full-conversion plant that was the first refinery on the Houston Ship Channel when it opened in 1918 — eliminating more than 400 jobs and exiting the refining business entirely. Profiled as a Tier 3 industrial / no-APIs provider for portfolio completeness.

providers.name: Metis Labs
providers.description: Metis Labs Limited is a London-based industrial AI company founded in 2017 by Alex Appelbe and Bashir Beikzadeh (an Entrepreneur First EF8 alumnus and a Speedinvest portfolio company). Its product, Kelvin Analytics, is an intelligent factory-optimization platform that applies reinforcement machine-learning to real-time monitoring and predictive analysis, helping process manufacturers in consumer-packaged chemicals, food and beverage, and construction materials cut production-line waste, raise product quality, and improve throughput. Metis Labs was acquired by Ascalia in September 2024. No public API, developer portal, or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: NBTY
providers.description: NBTY was a leading global vertically integrated manufacturer, marketer, distributor, and retailer of vitamins and nutritional supplements before being renamed The Nature's Bounty Co., which was subsequently sold and reorganized. No public APIs exist under the NBTY name.

providers.name: Nortek
providers.description: Nortek is a global manufacturer of HVAC, data center cooling, and cleanroom systems, organized into three divisions: Nortek Air Solutions, Nortek Data Center Cooling, and Nortek Cleanroom Solutions. No public developer portal or OpenAPI specifications have been identified at this time; this repository tracks Nortek for future API discovery and integration intelligence.

providers.name: Owens Corning
providers.description: Owens Corning is a global Fortune 500 building and industrial materials leader committed to building a sustainable future through material innovation, providing roofing, insulation, composite materials, and doors. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Acchromtech
providers.description: Acchromtech (Acchrom Tech, legally Huapu Instrument (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Beijing-based analytical-instrument company founded in 2015 that develops, manufactures and services high-end chromatographic separation products: high-performance and ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography systems, triple-quadrupole LC-MS/MS, preparative and online-SPE instruments, and Alphasil / StarCore / SelectPrep / Marsil chromatographic columns and consumables. It also ships Chromloong, a self-developed chromatography data system (CDS) for chromatographic information management with distributed storage, network deployment and full-link audit. Its products are used in pharmaceutical, food-safety, environmental, disease-control, clinical-testing, inspection-and-quarantine, petrochemical and academic laboratories. It publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract; Chromloong is distributed as an end-user laboratory product.

providers.name: Radia
providers.description: Radia is a dual-use aerospace company founded in 2016 by MIT-trained aerospace engineer Mark Lundstrom, headquartered in Boulder, Colorado with a second operating base in Italy led by Giuseppe Giordo. After roughly seven years in stealth the company emerged in March 2024 with WindRunner, an aircraft it describes as the largest ever built: roughly ten times the cargo volume of a Boeing 777, sized to carry onshore wind turbine blades of up to about 105 metres, and designed to land on semi-prepared packed-dirt or gravel strips so that oversized cargo can be flown directly to a wind farm, a forward operating site or a disaster zone rather than trucked over highways it cannot fit on. Radia frames WindRunner as a deliberately low-novelty airframe assembled from existing certified technologies to shorten the certification path, targeting entry into service in the early 2030s across three markets: energy (delivering the very large blades that make low-wind onshore sites economic), defense (outsized-volume strategic airlift), and commercial supply-chain logistics. It has assembled an industrial ecosystem of more than twenty suppliers and technology partners including Aernnova, Leonardo, AFuzion, Atitech, Latecoere, Stirling Dynamics, Collier Aerospace and Maximus Air, and has raised roughly USD 128 million from investors including ConocoPhillips, Lauder Partners, LS Power Development and HCVC. Radia is an aircraft manufacturer and logistics operator rather than a software vendor: as of August 2026 it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its only machine-readable public surface is the Strapi headless-CMS backend at radia.com/strapi that renders its own marketing site, whose content API is permission-locked and undocumented.

providers.name: Acade Powder
providers.description: Acade Powder is the English trading name of Suzhou Luxin New Material Technology Co., Ltd. (苏州鲁信新材料科技有限公司), a Chinese advanced-materials manufacturer founded in 2013 and headquartered at No. 512 Fangqiao Road, Xiangcheng District, Suzhou, Jiangsu, with metal-powder production bases in Henan, Anhui and Jiangsu. It develops, produces and sells metal powders for additive manufacturing (3D printing), powder metallurgy, metal injection moulding and laser cladding — superalloy, titanium, aluminium, copper, cobalt-chrome, mould steel, high-speed steel and soft-magnetic grades, plus custom powders — for aerospace, new energy, electronics, photovoltaic, shipbuilding and medical/dental customers. A private pre-IPO company traded on the EquityZen secondary marketplace, it is a materials manufacturer rather than a software vendor and publishes no developer program, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Advanced Metal Research
providers.description: Advanced Metal Research is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company based in Los Angeles building machine intelligence for American welding. The company develops American-made robotic welding cells that pair computer vision with real-time seam tracking and post-weld inspection, turning welding from a scarce manual craft into a closed-loop manufacturing system that learns from every weld as it happens. Founded in 2025 by Julian Fried, Stephen Lin, and Angus Muffatti, it targets the projected shortage of skilled welding professionals across US industrial manufacturing. The company is early-stage and hardware-focused; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Agile Software
providers.description: Agile Software Corporation was an American product lifecycle management (PLM) software company founded in 1995 and headquartered in San Jose, California. Backed by Accel, it IPO'd on the NASDAQ in 1999 and built enterprise software that helped manufacturers manage product records, bills of materials, engineering change orders, quality, compliance, and supply-chain data across a product's development and production lifecycle. Oracle Corporation acquired Agile Software in July 2007 for approximately US$495 million; its products were rebranded as Oracle Agile PLM and folded into Oracle's supply-chain and applications suite. The company no longer operates independently: agilesoft.com now redirects to Oracle, and the only surviving developer surface is the legacy Oracle Agile PLM SDK (a Java API set) hosted on docs.oracle.com. This profile is retained as an acquired/historical record; there is no live, independent public API surface to enrich.

providers.name: AgroSpheres
providers.description: AgroSpheres is an agricultural biotechnology company based in Charlottesville, Virginia, founded by University of Virginia researchers, that develops bio-based crop protection products built on its AgriCell bioparticle platform. The company uses a single-step fermentation process that produces and biodegradably encapsulates biological actives all at once, giving added stability and a tunable release profile for targeted, non-toxic pest and disease control intended to be safe for pollinators, people and soil. Its first commercial product, the broad-spectrum biofungicide FUN-THYME, is marketed through an exclusive partnership with Wilbur-Ellis and was approved in California in 2026. AgroSpheres manufactures at a biomanufacturing facility in Charlottesville. It is a physical agricultural-inputs business and publishes no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: AInnovation
providers.description: AInnovation (创新奇智, Qingdao AInnovation Technology Group) is a Chinese enterprise artificial-intelligence company founded in 2018 and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (02121.HK). It focuses on "AI + Manufacturing", delivering industrial AI through its AInnoGC platform — an industrial large-language-model and AI-agent application-development platform — and its MMOC technology stack: ManuVision machine-vision, MatrixVision edge-video intelligence, and the Orion distributed machine-learning platform. It serves manufacturing verticals including semiconductors, steel, 3C electronics, automotive, energy, food and materials, construction, and financial services. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, the company reports 1,400+ patent applications. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: airquality
providers.description: AirQuality (爱优特) is a Shanghai-based manufacturer of high-efficiency electrostatic air purification and disinfection products, including central air filtration systems, commercial kitchen exhaust (hood) cleaners, odor-elimination units, and smart air-quality detection systems for schools, hospitals, offices, shopping malls, and hotels. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. It is a hardware/manufacturing business that publishes a consumer website and online shop but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time, so most enrichment artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: Apex Space
providers.description: Apex Space (Apex) is a Los Angeles based satellite manufacturing company that builds productized, configurable spacecraft bus platforms for proliferated constellations across LEO, MEO, and GEO orbital regimes. Apex offers three product lines: Aries (small satellites up to 150 kg payload), Nova (medium satellites up to 300 kg payload), and Comet (large satellites up to 3,000 kg payload), and operates Factory One, a high-rate manufacturing facility in Los Angeles with the capacity to produce more than 200 satellites annually. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. Apex does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; customers configure satellite platforms through the on-site Configurator and direct sales inquiries.

providers.name: Berry Plastics Group
providers.description: Berry Plastics Group was a manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials serving customers across consumer and industrial markets. The company was renamed Berry Global Group in 2017 to reflect its global operations and diversified product portfolio beyond plastics. As Berry Global, the company subsequently merged with Amcor in 2024.

providers.name: bomming
providers.description: Zhuhai Boming Vision Technology Co., Ltd. (珠海博明视觉科技有限公司) is a Chinese high-tech industrial machine-vision company founded in September 2016 and headquartered in the Zhuhai High-tech Zone. It develops optical and machine-vision inspection technology for manufacturing quality control, including 3D structured-light sensors, flash measuring instruments (闪测仪), 2D/3D profile measurement systems, PCB back-drill thickness gauges, surface-defect inspection systems, glue-dispensing systems, and an AI deep-learning algorithm platform for automated visual inspection. Its solutions serve the lithium-battery, magnetic-materials, 3C electronics, semiconductor, photovoltaic, metalworking, and pharmaceutical industries. This is a hardware/equipment manufacturer with no public developer or API surface; the profile is retained as a VC-portfolio company lead.

providers.name: CNANO
providers.description: CNANO (Jiangsu Cnano Technology Co., Ltd., Shanghai STAR Market 688116) is a carbon nanotube and graphene materials manufacturer founded in 2011 and headquartered in Zhenjiang, China, with a US arm (Cnano USA) in Santa Clara, California. It develops and mass-produces multi-wall and single-wall carbon nanotube powders, conductive pastes, graphene composite pastes, and conductive masterbatches used as additives in lithium-ion batteries, conductive polymer composites, antistatic coatings, and tire rubber reinforcement. It is one of the largest global producers of multi-wall carbon nanotubes for battery applications. Backed by IDG Capital. This is a physical-materials manufacturer with no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Consona
providers.description: Consona Corporation was an Indianapolis, Indiana enterprise software company founded in 1986 as Made2Manage Systems and taken private by Battery Ventures in 2003. Operating a roll-up strategy, it acquired multiple ERP and CRM product lines (DTR, Cimnet, AXIS, Encompix, Intuitive, Relevant, SupplyWorks) serving small and midsize manufacturers and field-service businesses. On August 7, 2012 Consona merged with CDC Software to form Aptean, and the Consona brand was retired from commercial use. The company is defunct, has no live web domain (consona.com does not resolve) and no public API or developer surface; its former products live on inside Aptean.

providers.name: Cover
providers.description: Cover (Cover Technologies Inc.) is a Los Angeles-based construction technology company that designs and builds custom, architect-grade backyard homes, accessory dwelling units (ADUs), and residential spaces using a prefabricated, factory-manufactured building system. Cover handles the full development process end to end, from initial consultation and design through permitting, manufacturing, and on-site installation, delivering custom spaces in weeks rather than years. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of General Catalyst. Cover is a physical-product homebuilder and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures verifiable company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CYGIA
providers.description: CYGIA (Zhuhai CYGIA Automation Equipment Co.) is an intelligent-factory equipment and solution provider founded in 2006 and headquartered in Zhuhai, China. It develops, manufactures, and services intelligent automation and automated-test equipment for consumer electronics, semiconductor and integrated-circuit, automotive, medical, and new-energy industries. Once backed by Qiming Venture Partners, CYGIA became a subsidiary of publicly traded CYG (Changyuan Group, Shanghai Stock Exchange 600525.SH) in 2015. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDK surface for CYGIA, which is a hardware/automation-equipment manufacturer rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Digiflex
providers.description: Digiflex (listed by Battery Ventures as "Digiflex, Ltd.") was an Israeli manufacturer of inkjet-based computer-to-plate and digital printing systems, best known for the Flexojet line of flexographic plate-making printers. It was a hardware company: the product was a physical printing press, not software, so it never had a developer program, a public API, or any machine-readable contract to publish. PV Nano Cell signed a $10M all-stock letter of intent in March 2017 and closed the acquisition on 3 December 2017, folding Digiflex in as a wholly-owned subsidiary to carry the Flexojet systems into printed electronics; Battery Ventures now carries the name on its list-of-all-companies page as an exited investment. The brand has since been fully absorbed — the acquirer's current site (pvnanocell.com, HTTP 200) makes no mention of DigiFlex, and digiflex.com, while still registered through Dynadot to an April 2027 expiry, has no working nameservers and returns SERVFAIL with no A record. The live domains sharing the name are unrelated third parties: digiflex.io is a West Midlands web-design agency, digiflex.co.uk is a separate UK business, and digiflex.ai sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge with no verifiable link to the Battery investment. No developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDK, package-registry presence, or any other API artifact exists for this company. This profile is retained as an honest record of an acquired and absorbed portfolio lead with no API surface rather than being enriched with speculative attribution.

providers.name: Drishti
providers.description: Drishti was an AI and computer-vision company that turned manual assembly-line activity into continuous streams of process data for discrete manufacturers. Cameras securely streamed factory-floor video into proprietary neural networks that generated cycle-time data and detected the sequence of human actions within each cycle, giving plant teams system-wide visibility into variability, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities. Founded in 2017 in Mountain View, California and backed by Emergence Capital, Drishti counted Ford, Honeywell, and Nissan among its customers before being acquired by Apple in September 2023. The company operated no public developer API, and all of its web and developer domains are now offline.

providers.name: Drishti Technologies
providers.description: Drishti Technologies was a Mountain View, California company (founded 2016 by Prasad Akella, Krishnendu Chaudhury, and Ashish Gupta) that applied AI-powered computer vision and video analytics to manual assembly lines in manufacturing. Its platform digitized human actions on the production floor to enable time-and-motion studies at scale, quality traceability, and continuous improvement, with products including Drishti Trace (video capture and traceability) and Drishti Flow (line analytics). The company was acquired by Apple in September 2023 and no longer operates an independent public website, developer portal, or API surface — its domains (drishti.com, drishti.ai) no longer resolve to a live product.

providers.name: Dyna
providers.description: DYNA Robotics builds commercial-grade, general-purpose robots for real-world automation across factories, restaurants, and laundromats. Its flagship DYNA-1 is a dual-arm robotic system powered by a vision-language-action (VLA) foundation model, running 24/7 in production with a reported 99.4% success rate and human-level dexterity. The company positions itself as building embodied AGI through high-performance robots that adapt across environments and learn new skills rapidly with minimal custom engineering. Backed by CRV, DYNA closed a $120M Series A in 2025. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface has been published to date; this profile tracks the company as an AI/robotics lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Eden Robotics
providers.description: Eden Robotics is a Y Combinator-backed robotics company building autonomous robots for industrial operations, delivered on a robots-as-a-service model that starts at roughly $10 per hour with no setup fees. The offering is positioned as plug-and-play, requiring no on-site engineers or specialized robotics hires, and is powered by the company's Theta OS platform. As of this profile the company publishes a single marketing and sales-contact website and does not expose a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition; this record captures the verified company identity and domain-security posture and will be upgraded if and when a developer surface is published.

providers.name: Effa
providers.description: Effa is a sustainable consumer goods company that makes the world's first 100% recyclable paper toothbrush, a disposable, plastic-free alternative to conventional plastic toothbrushes aimed at hotels, airlines, and retail consumers. Founded in Ukraine by Dasha and Ilya Kichuk and headquartered in San Francisco, California, the company supplies eco-friendly personal care and amenity products to hospitality and travel clients, with reported customers including Netflix and Radisson. Effa is backed by 500 Global and Startup Wise Guys. Effa does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Eggrock
providers.description: Eggrock (Eggrock Modular Solutions; legally Innovative Modular Pre-Fabrication LLC) is a North American manufacturer of prefabricated "bathroom-in-a-box" pods — complete, custom, ready-to-install bathrooms built off-site using BIM-driven design and lean manufacturing for hotels, hospitals, dormitories, military barracks, and other multi-unit construction projects. Off-site fabrication compresses construction schedules and improves quality versus building bathrooms on site. In 2012 Eggrock licensed exclusive North American manufacturing and distribution to Oldcastle Precast. It is a construction / building-products manufacturer with no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface.

providers.name: Enviri (formerly Harsco)
providers.description: Enviri Corporation, formerly known as Harsco Corporation, is a trusted global leader in environmental solutions, developing and refining methods of recycling and beneficial reuse for industrial customers. Enviri operates through three divisions: Clean Earth (hazardous waste management and recycling), Harsco Environmental (services to the global steel industry), and Harsco Rail (rail-track maintenance equipment and services). Enviri does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs.

providers.name: Exide Technologies
providers.description: Exide Technologies is a global producer and recycler of lead-acid batteries used in transportation and industrial applications, serving automotive, motive power, network power, and other markets. Headquartered in Milton, Georgia, the company operates manufacturing and recycling facilities worldwide. No public developer APIs have been identified; ordering and product data are provided through B2B portals and distributor channels.

providers.name: Fact Base Inc.
providers.description: Fact Base Inc. (株式会社Fact Base) is a Japanese manufacturing-technology company on a mission to make manufacturing seamless by driving the digitization of small and mid-sized factories (町工場). Its corporate site presents the company mission and vision for connecting Japan's fragmented small-factory manufacturing base through digital tooling. Surfaced through the API Evangelist network as an Insight Partners portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass no public developer program, API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation is published on the corporate domain.

providers.name: Faircraft
providers.description: Faircraft is a biotechnology company creating a new class of cultivated materials, starting with real leather grown in the lab from animal cells rather than raised on farms. Using cell biology and protein engineering, it produces genuine leather (product lines FCL_001 through FCL_006) with the look, feel, and performance of traditional hides but with a lower environmental footprint and no animal farming, and customizable properties for fashion, automotive, and luxury brands. Backed by Kindred Ventures, Faircraft is a materials-science company with no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Fastenal
providers.description: Fastenal is a leading distributor of industrial and construction supplies, offering fasteners, tools, safety equipment, and other industrial products through stores, vending, and e-commerce. While Fastenal provides EDI integrations and supply chain programs like FAST 360, FASTBin, and FASTStock to enterprise customers, no publicly documented API specifications are available.

providers.name: Figure
providers.description: Figure is a Sunnyvale, California humanoid robotics company building general-purpose bipedal robots for the home and the workplace. Its current flagship product is Figure 03, marketed as an everyday general-purpose humanoid robot, succeeding Figure 01 and Figure 02. Figure develops Helix, an in-house Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that unifies perception, language understanding, and learned control to drive a full upper humanoid body at 35 degrees of freedom and 200 Hz, with capabilities including novel-object manipulation from natural-language commands and multi-robot task coordination. Figure has run commercial pilots with partners such as BMW and previously collaborated with OpenAI on language models. The company's revenue model is robot sales/leasing and enterprise deployments; Helix is a proprietary on-board model and there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Figure or Helix.

providers.name: FireVisor
providers.description: FireVisor is an AI-based manufacturing analytics platform that helps manufacturers leverage their production data beyond traditional defect detection and process control methods. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Singapore (with a secondary office in Toronto, Canada), FireVisor works toward "self-aware factories powered by artificial intelligence," applying machine learning to manufacturing and industrial-automation data. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this profile the public firevisor.com site returns a 404 from its load balancer and exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: FogHorn Systems (Johnson Controls)
providers.description: FogHorn Systems was a Sunnyvale, California developer of edge AI and machine learning software for the industrial and commercial Internet of Things (IIoT). Its Lightning Edge AI platform and Lightning EdgeML brought real-time streaming analytics and ML inference to constrained on-premises edge hardware for predictive maintenance, machine optimization, and operational intelligence use cases. Johnson Controls acquired FogHorn in January 2022 and folded its team and technology into the OpenBlue suite of smart, autonomous building solutions, with the former Sunnyvale headquarters operating as a Johnson Controls "AI Hub." FogHorn no longer operates as a standalone brand and publishes no independent public developer surface — no developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or GitHub organization resolve as of this enrichment pass; the former foghorn.io/foghorn.ai domains are parked. This profile is retained as a network company record with no public API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: Forge Robotics
providers.description: Forge Robotics is a Galway, Ireland and San Francisco based robotics company building modular autonomous factories for metal fabrication. Its shipping container sized, software configurable units combine a vision system, sub millimeter 3D scanning, and robotic intelligence to autonomously handle, position, weld, laser engrave, and finish metal assemblies, turning conventional human programmed industrial welding robot arms into autonomous members of the workforce. The company targets the skilled welder shortage in US manufacturing with continuously operating, snap together production modules. Forge Robotics was co founded by Eoin Cobbe (CEO) and Robert Cormican (CTO) and is a Y Combinator backed pre seed startup. As of this profile the company exposes a marketing and product website only, with no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: General Cable
providers.description: General Cable Corporation was a global developer and manufacturer of copper, aluminum, and fiber optic wire and cable products. The company was acquired by Prysmian Group in 2018 and integrated into the Prysmian portfolio. No public developer APIs are documented for General Cable.

providers.name: Generalastro
providers.description: General Astronautics (Generalastro) is a Y Combinator (W26) space-robotics company founded in 2025 by Bram Schork, based in San Francisco, building autonomous dexterous robotic arms that perform laboratory research and manufacturing tasks in microgravity without astronaut intervention. Its systems handle work like pipetting, sample prep, plate handling, and reagent mixing, targeting microgravity production of pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and fiber optics where crew time on orbital stations is the bottleneck (NASA estimates ISS crew time at ~$130K/hour). The company is pre-product hardware, backed by Y Combinator and Planet Ventures (~$7.1M raised), and currently exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or other machine-readable surface; this profile captures company identity only.

providers.name: Ghost Robotics
providers.description: Ghost Robotics designs and manufactures quadrupedal unmanned ground vehicles (Q-UGV), with its flagship Vision 60 platform deployed across defense, public safety, law enforcement, industrial, construction, and education customers. The platform supports modular payloads for sensing, comms, and manipulation. Ghost Robotics provides a developer SDK only to vetted partners and integrators and does not operate a public developer portal, open API, or public GitHub organization.

providers.name: Gilmour Space
providers.description: Gilmour Space Technologies is an Australian venture-backed space company headquartered on the Gold Coast in Queensland, founded in 2012 by brothers Adam and James Gilmour. The company designs and manufactures hybrid-propulsion orbital launch vehicles (the Eris rocket) and satellite platforms (the G-class / ElaraSat bus), and operates the Bowen Orbital Spaceport in North Queensland from which it is pursuing Australia's first sovereign orbital launch. Gilmour Space is backed by investors including Blackbird Ventures, Main Sequence Ventures, 500 Global, Fine Structure Ventures and HESTA. It is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; the company operates in aerospace and space launch and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Good Manufacturing Practices
providers.description: A system of processes, procedures, and documentation that ensures products are consistently produced and controlled according to quality standards, commonly used in pharmaceutical, food, and medical device manufacturing. Proper implementation reduces legal and operational risk while supporting audit readiness.

providers.name: graphenest.com
providers.description: Graphenest is a Portuguese nano-cleantech company that develops sustainable, high-performance graphene-based materials for electromagnetic interference (EMI/EMC/RF) shielding. Its proprietary, scalable and low-energy graphene production process powers two industrial-ready product lines: HexaShield, a sprayable conductive coating for high-frequency applications, and G-Shield, a family of conductive thermoplastics for extrusion and injection moulding, plus the G-Prime graphene material. The solutions deliver higher shielding performance at lower cost and weight (up to 75% lighter than metal alternatives) for Tier 1/Tier 2 manufacturers in batteries, electronics, telecom (radar, LiDAR, 5G/6G), and cables & wires. Graphenest is a materials and manufacturing company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars-linked portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Greif
providers.description: Greif is an industrial packaging products and services leader with a vision to be the best performing customer service company in the world. Greif also offers digital tools such as the Greif Green Tool carbon footprint calculator and the Greif+ online platform for customers.

providers.name: Hlabs
providers.description: Hlabs (Harrison Laboratories, Inc., operating as hlaboratories.com) is a US-based, Y Combinator-backed (Winter 2026) manufacturer of plug-and-play robotics components. The company produces a domestically-manufactured, integrated hardware ecosystem for robot builders — including the RB1 main board (powered by Nvidia Jetson), wireless communication modules, field-oriented control (FOC) boards, pancake motors, and actuators. Its stated goal is to eliminate the complexity of sourcing mismatched components from overseas and integrating them, so roboticists can focus on design rather than electronics debugging. Hlabs targets teams building medium-to-large robots such as quadrupeds, humanoids, and robot arms, and serves customers across household robotics, defense, and other robotic platforms. This is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer/API surface at the time of profiling.

providers.name: Hologix
providers.description: Hologix, Inc. (formerly MBA Technologies, founded 1989) was a Phoenix, Arizona software company that developed Attricom, a business-to-business eCommerce order management solution built for manufacturers with complex, attribute-based product lines in the metals, textile, and paper and forest products industries. Attricom streamlined configuration, quoting, and order management so large-scale producers could offer closer, self-service ordering relationships to their customers. Hologix was venture-backed by Insight Partners, Adams Capital Management, Integral Capital Partners, and Kemper Ventures, and has since ceased operations. It is retained in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public API, developer portal, or product website is currently reachable.

providers.name: IBEX Process Technology
providers.description: IBEX Process Technology was a semiconductor-industry technology company based in Lowell, Massachusetts, founded around 2000, that developed neural-network-based process control systems for semiconductor fabrication. The company raised roughly $6.8M across two funding rounds and is now defunct (deadpooled), with an Involuntary Revocation status on its Massachusetts registration. It was surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub from battery-ventures data; enrichment finds no live website, no developer/API surface, and no machine-readable specifications to harvest.

providers.name: Identify3D
providers.description: Identify3D developed software to secure the digital (additive / 3D-printing) manufacturing supply chain by encrypting, distributing, and tracing digital part files, so that a part could only be produced by an authorized user, machine, and material and non-conforming or counterfeit parts could not enter the physical supply chain. The suite coupled part designs with production criteria (designated user, machine, material) and provided intellectual-property protection, digital-rights management, and traceability for distributed manufacturing. Founded in San Francisco and backed by Uncork Capital, Identify3D was acquired by Materialise NV in October 2021 and its technology was folded into the Materialise CO-AM distributed-manufacturing platform. The company no longer operates a standalone product, developer portal, or public API; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network for historical and VC portfolio-graph purposes.

providers.name: Illinois Tool Works
providers.description: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) is a Fortune 500 global multi-industrial manufacturer of value-added consumables and specialty equipment with related service businesses across automotive OEM, food equipment, test and measurement, electronics, welding, polymers and fluids, construction products, and specialty products. ITW does not publish a public API or developer program. This repository exists to track APIs, SDKs, and developer resources should they become available.

providers.name: Infra.Market
providers.description: Infra.Market is a technology-enabled building materials platform serving India's construction and real estate sectors across the entire project lifecycle. Operating as a house of brands, it supplies concrete, aggregates, steel, AAC blocks, plywood, tiles, sanitaryware, paints, plumbing, modular kitchens, hardware, electricals, appliances, and rental equipment through both B2B (direct corporate sales with site delivery) and B2R (retail via dealers and distributors across 17,000+ touchpoints). It is backed by 280+ manufacturing facilities across 22 Indian states under brands including Shalimar Paints, RDC, IVAS, Robo, and Ultrafine, and is headquartered in Thane, Maharashtra. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company; no public developer API surface has been identified to date.

providers.name: Inloop Robotics
providers.description: Inloop Robotics (InLoop) is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup in San Francisco offering robotics-as-a-service for warehouses, fulfillment centers, and light manufacturing. Its bimanual "Loop V1" robot performs box assembly, kitting, visual inspection, content preparation, unpackaging, and order pick-and-pack. The system runs a hybrid-autonomy, human-in-the-loop model: onboard AI handles routine work while remote teleoperators take over on edge cases, and production failures feed continuous learning. InLoop sells this as a flat monthly subscription that bundles the hardware, ongoing AI updates, and 24/7 teleassistance fallback, rather than selling robots outright. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site only, with no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record tracks it as an API Evangelist network lead pending any future developer/API program.

providers.name: International Paper
providers.description: International Paper is a Fortune 500 producer of fiber-based packaging, pulp, and paper products serving customers in more than 150 countries. The company does not currently publish a public developer API program; business integrations are handled through customer and supplier portals.

providers.name: JAKA
providers.description: JAKA (Shanghai JAKA Robotics Co., Ltd.) is a collaborative robot (cobot) manufacturer founded in 2014 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, with origins in robotics research at Shanghai University. The company designs and builds lightweight, human-collaborative industrial robot arms — including its JAKA Zu series and MiniCobo — used across manufacturing, 3C electronics, automotive, healthcare, education, and commercial service applications. JAKA robots are programmed through the company's on-device control software and a robot SDK (C++/Python) that communicates with the robot controller over TCP/IP on the local network, rather than a public cloud web API. As of this profile JAKA does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or hosted REST/MCP API surface; this repository is a company profile in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Jjgmachining
providers.description: JJG (JJG Aero Pvt Ltd, JJG Machining Pvt Ltd, and JJG Special Processing Pvt Ltd) is a precision contract-manufacturing group founded in 2004 that produces machined components for the aerospace, automotive, and industrial sectors. It offers 2-5 axis CNC machining alongside high-volume turned and turn-mill parts in ferrous, aluminum, copper alloys, and titanium, backed by 30+ NADCAP-approved special processes such as electroplating, anodizing, paint, and NDT. This is a physical manufacturing company with no public API, developer program, or machine-readable API artifacts; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record only.

providers.name: Junlebao
providers.description: Junlebao Dairy Group (Shijiazhuang Junlebao Dairy Co., Ltd., 君乐宝乳业) is one of China's largest dairy processors, founded in 1995 and headquartered in Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province. Its business spans the full dairy value chain: infant and toddler formula, low-temperature (chilled) yogurt, room-temperature liquid milk, fresh milk, cheese and dairy-farming/animal-husbandry operations. Junlebao is the largest dairy company in Hebei and ranks among China's top dairy producers, leading domestic infant-formula sales volume and holding a top position in low-temperature yogurt. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HSG). As a consumer packaged-goods / food manufacturer it publishes no public developer program, API, or open-data surface; this profile tracks its corporate web presence and company identity.

providers.name: K2 Space
providers.description: K2 Space (K2 Space Corporation) is a Los Angeles / Torrance, California aerospace startup that designs and manufactures high-power "Mega Class" satellite buses. Its platforms deliver roughly 20kW of array power and up to one metric ton of payload capacity - about ten times the power and payload of conventional buses - to maximize the throw-weight of next-generation launch vehicles like SpaceX Starship and Blue Origin New Glenn. K2 builds radiation-tolerant, vertically integrated (80% in-house) spacecraft with redundant avionics and high-delta-v propulsion for LEO, MEO, GEO and cislunar missions, serving commercial and U.S. government / defense customers. Backed by First Round Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Redpoint Ventures, the company raised a $250M Series C at a $3B valuation and is preparing its first production satellite, GRAVITAS. K2 Space is a hardware company with no public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Katerra
providers.description: Katerra was a Menlo Park, California off-site construction and building-technology company founded in 2015 by former Flextronics chief executive Michael Marks with Fritz Wolff and Jim Davidson, built on the thesis that a single vertically integrated firm could design, engineer, manufacture and assemble buildings end to end — running its own architecture practice, factories in Phoenix, Tracy and Spokane producing cross-laminated timber and prefabricated wall, floor and bathroom assemblies, and its own supply chain and general contracting arm. It raised more than $2 billion across a dozen rounds, including an $865M Series D led by the SoftBank Vision Fund in January 2018 at a valuation above $3 billion and a $200M recapitalization in December 2020 that handed SoftBank majority control. Its only software product was Katerra Apollo, announced in February 2019 as a design-to-field platform (Apollo Construct, Apollo Insight, Apollo Connect) whose launch materials promised "open API integration" with existing construction workflows — but Apollo was sold to Katerra's own construction customers and never shipped a public developer portal, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification. The insolvency of its SoftBank-backed lender Greensill Capital cost Katerra its bonding capacity, and the company shut down and filed Chapter 11 in the Southern District of Texas on 6 June 2021. Its assets were broken up: the Apollo software went to Builders FirstSource for roughly $4.5M on 9 September 2021, and the factories were sold separately. katerra.com no longer serves a site — it answers a Cloudflare error 1001 on every path and cannot complete a TLS handshake at all. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no API surface left to catalog.

providers.name: Kennametal
providers.description: Kennametal is a leading provider of productivity solutions for metalworking, earth cutting, and wear components, coatings, and powders. Kennametal offers online integration services including Punch-Out / OCI (Open Catalog Interface), EDI, and a Product Data Portal for catalog and product information.

providers.name: Kishlay Foods
providers.description: Kishlay Foods is a snack-food manufacturing company based in Guwahati, Assam, India, operating since 2003. The company produces premium potato chips, namkeens, and traditional Indian savory snacks, with regional varieties such as Aloo Bhujia, Bengali Mix, Chakna Mix, Cocktail Peanut, and Chana Jor Garam. Kishlay Foods runs a consumer/distributor marketing website and recruits distributor partners across the region; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, webhook, or developer-portal surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Kubota Corporation
providers.description: Kubota Corporation is a Japanese multinational manufacturing agricultural, construction, and industrial machinery, including compact tractors, excavators, mowers, utility vehicles, engines, and water and environmental infrastructure systems sold in over 120 countries. Kubota does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; equipment telematics (KubotaNOW) and dealer integrations are handled through partner channels rather than open APIs.

providers.name: Lorillard
providers.description: Lorillard Tobacco Company was the third-largest cigarette manufacturer in the United States, marketing cigarettes under brand names including Newport, Kent, True, and Old Gold. In 2015, Lorillard was acquired by Reynolds American Inc. (RAI), and its operations and brands have since been integrated into the Reynolds American family of companies. Lorillard does not operate a public developer program or API platform.

providers.name: LuxCreo
providers.description: LuxCreo is a hardtech company delivering same-day dental 3D printing through an integrated ecosystem of hardware, materials, and cloud software. Its dental line pairs the FDA Class II 510(k)-cleared iLux Pro Dental printer, iLuxWash cleaning, and iLuxCure curing hardware with proprietary resins and ActiveMemory polymer technology (4D Aligner, 4D Bright). The software stack — LuxFlow Pro print prep, LuxDesign AI design automation, LuxLink fleet management, and the LuxCloud Dental platform — runs the in-house aligner and appliance workflow. Backed by Kleiner Perkins. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and processed by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; no public developer API surface was found.

providers.name: Manitowoc
providers.description: Manitowoc Cranes is one of the world's largest providers of lifting equipment for the global construction industry, including lattice-boom crawler cranes, tower cranes, mobile hydraulic cranes, and boom trucks. No public developer APIs have been documented.

providers.name: Masco Corporation
providers.description: Masco Corporation is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of branded home improvement and building products, including faucets, plumbing fixtures, cabinets, paints, and architectural coatings under brands such as Delta, Behr, Hansgrohe, KILZ, and Liberty Hardware.

providers.name: Metaldyne Performance Group
providers.description: Metaldyne Performance Group was a leading provider of components for use in powertrain and safety-critical platforms for the global light, commercial, and industrial vehicle markets before being acquired by American Axle.

providers.name: Mind Robotics
providers.description: Mind Robotics is an industrial robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for real-world industrial deployment. The company focuses on clearly defined, high-impact environments — narrowing scope to the settings with the greatest operational need as a path toward broadly capable robots. Mind Robotics is a Kleiner Perkins portfolio company in the hardtech sector. As of this profile the company operates a single-page marketing website and an Ashby-hosted careers page and publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Module
providers.description: Module is a vertically integrated sustainable housing company that designs, manufactures, and builds modular homes. Operating across design (architecture and engineering with BIM), manufacturing (its Last Mile Facility in Pittsburgh), and construction (licensed general contracting), Module focuses on infill and "missing middle" housing, small-footprint and energy-efficient affordable homes, and mixed-income developments through its Last Mile Network of design, construction, and mission-driven developer partner programs. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched in the API Evangelist network; Module publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Mushroom Material
providers.description: Mushroom Material is a New Zealand and Singapore based sustainable-packaging startup founded in 2020 by Shaun Seaman and Jotinder Singh that grows a biodegradable, home-compostable alternative to expanded polystyrene (Styrofoam) from fungal mycelium. The company combines agricultural byproducts such as wood chips, sawdust, hemp straw and cardboard with mycelium to grow millions of pellets, coats them in a biopolymer binder, and uses compression molding to shape protective packaging that drops into existing Styrofoam production lines. The material offers shock absorption, low density and natural water resistance while composting in months. A Techstars-backed company, Mushroom Material raised a US$5M+ (NZ$8.5M) seed round led by Wavemaker Partners and Singapore's SEEDS Capital (with Icehouse Ventures, K1W1 and Black Kite Capital) to build a pilot plant in Auckland. This profile is a materials/manufacturing company in the API Evangelist network; it has no public API surface.

providers.name: Mutto Optronics
providers.description: Mutto Optronics (Mutto Inc) is a Taipei, Taiwan-based provider of resistive and capacitive touch panels for the mobile phone and tablet market. Formerly a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company, it is now publicly held. It is a hardware/optronics manufacturer with no public API, developer program, or documented software surface. The registered domain (muttoinc.com) has lapsed and now resolves to a domain-parking and ad-monetization landing page across all hosts, so there is no first-party developer, docs, or API infrastructure to enrich.

providers.name: Mycoworks
providers.description: MycoWorks is a San Francisco Bay Area biotechnology and advanced-materials company founded in 2013 by artist Philip Ross and Sophia Wang, headquartered in Emeryville, California. It engineers premium leather-alternative biomaterials from mycelium using its patented Fine Mycelium process, sold under the Reishi brand to luxury fashion, automotive, and design partners. The company was backed by DCVC and other investors; it entered insolvency and was wound down through an Assignment for the Benefit of Creditors in late 2025. MycoWorks operates as a physical-materials manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or developer portal, so this API Evangelist profile carries company identity only.

providers.name: nasn-auto
providers.description: NASN Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. is a Shanghai-based automotive chassis electronic-control manufacturer founded in 2016, developing brake-by-wire and steer-by-wire systems for smart and assisted driving. Its products include the NBooster intelligent braking system, brushless electric power steering (EPS) controllers, and motion-control solutions for autonomous vehicles. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Matrix Partners China, Hillhouse and CATL, NASN has raised roughly $231M and is a Tier-1 supplier pursuing a Hong Kong listing. Surfaced as a Qiming portfolio company; NASN is an automotive hardware manufacturer with no public developer API surface at nasn-auto.com.

providers.name: Newmark Group
providers.description: Newmark Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: NMRK) is a global commercial real estate advisory and services firm headquartered in New York City. Founded in 1929 and acquired by BGC Partners in October 2011, Newmark provides capital markets, leasing, valuation & advisory, global corporate services (GCS), property management, industrial and logistics, multifamily, and retail services. The firm expanded its international footprint with the 2023 acquisition of UK-based Gerald Eve and its multifamily platform via Open Realty Advisors. Newmark publishes recurring industry research under the MarketBeat / market-report brand but does not operate a public developer program or expose machine-readable APIs.

providers.name: Nova Instruments
providers.description: Nova Instruments is a test-and-measurement platform company that designs, develops, and manufactures instruments and systems for analyzing fluid and solid mechanics. It operates a family of established brands — Brookhaven Instruments, Dantec Dynamics, DegreeC, NDT Systems, Phoenix Inspection Systems, Technology Design, and Stresstech — spanning particle characterization, optical measurement, thermal management, and non-destructive testing. A portfolio company of Battery Ventures since 2010, it operates as part of the Nova Ventures Group. As a hardware-focused instruments manufacturer, Nova Instruments does not currently publish a public web API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Nucor
providers.description: Nucor Corporation is a Fortune 500 American steel and steel products manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is the largest steel producer in the United States and the largest recycler of any material in North America. Nucor does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this index captures the corporate, sustainability, and certification resources that are publicly available.

providers.name: Omen
providers.description: Omen (omen.ai) delivers real-time asset intelligence through continuous fluid analysis, monitoring the health of mission-critical machinery in data centers and heavy industry. Its two offerings are a non-invasive permanent sensor that attaches to equipment for continuous, automated fluid (oil, coolant, water) analysis and real-time health tracking, and a portable canister lab that performs on-site, off-site, and field spectroscopic testing. The platform detects wear, contamination, and degradation before failures occur, targeting the machines the world depends on. Backed by CRV. As of this enrichment pass Omen publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures company identity only.

providers.name: Optiant
providers.description: Optiant, Inc. was a Boston-area supply chain optimization software company founded in 2000 on multi-echelon inventory optimization technology developed by researchers at MIT. Its flagship PowerChain suite (Network Design, Inventory, and Planner) let global manufacturers and distributors model multidimensional supply chains and free up working capital trapped across multi-echelon networks. Optiant was acquired by Logility, Inc. in 2010 (~$3.3M) and its technology was folded into Logility's Voyager Solutions suite as Voyager Inventory Optimization. The company no longer operates independently and publishes no public API surface; the optiant.com domain no longer resolves. This profile was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and enriched as a historical/defunct lead.

providers.name: Padminivna
providers.description: Padminivna (padminivna.com resolves to Padmini VNA Mechatronics Ltd.) is an automotive component manufacturer established in 1991, specializing in innovation and manufacturing of technologies for the auto components industry across passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles (M&HCV, LCV), two- and three-wheelers, tractors, and off-road vehicles. Its offerings span ICE, hybrid, and EV powertrains plus sensors and agnostic technologies, with a focus on fuel efficiency, quality, and environmental sustainability. Surfaced as a portfolio lead of norwest-venture-partners; the public site exposes only a vendor portal and employee login and publishes no public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pall Corporation
providers.description: Pall Corporation is a filtration, separation, and purification solutions provider serving aerospace and defense, food and beverage, semiconductors, oil and gas, and industrial manufacturing industries. Pall does not currently publish a public developer platform or REST API.

providers.name: PCH International
providers.description: PCH International (pchintl.com) is a global supply chain solutions provider that helps brands bring innovative physical products to market across the entire product lifecycle. Its services span new product introduction (NPI) planning, design and development, validation and manufacturing (EVT/DVT/PVT), and post-production revenue optimization, plus global logistics, direct-to-consumer (D2C) transformation, supply-chain financing, and sustainability programs. PCH serves personal care and beauty, health and fitness, home and lifestyle, accessories, audio and entertainment, and smart retail sectors. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners, PCH is a B2B services provider with no public developer API or platform at this time.

providers.name: Philly Shipyard
providers.description: Philly Shipyard (now Hanwha Philly Shipyard, Inc.) is a commercial shipbuilder based at the former Philadelphia Naval Shipyard, constructing Jones Act-compliant container ships, product and Aframax tankers, and National Security Multi-Mission Vessels (NSMVs) for the U.S. Maritime Administration and state maritime academies. In December 2024, Hanwha Systems and Hanwha Ocean (subsidiaries of South Korea's Hanwha Group) completed the acquisition of Philly Shipyard for approximately $100M, rebranding the operation as Hanwha Philly Shipyard Inc. (HPSI). No public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Phoenix Tailings
providers.description: Phoenix Tailings is a clean rare earth and critical minerals refining company working to restore U.S. industrial independence by building domestic refining capacity for the metals behind every major technology. It recovers rare earth elements and other critical minerals from mining waste (tailings) and low-grade feedstocks using a low-emission, zero-landfill process, supplying materials for medical devices, electric vehicles and automotive systems, electronics, and defense applications. The company operates as a materials producer and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks its identity and web/domain security posture.

providers.name: Pinshape
providers.description: Pinshape is an online marketplace and community for 3D-printable designs, where makers, designers, and hobbyists browse, download, and sell STL and other printable model files for use on desktop 3D printers. The platform hosts both free and premium designs across categories such as toys, gadgets, art, jewelry, and functional parts, and was acquired by desktop 3D-printing manufacturer Formlabs. This profile was surfaced as a venture portfolio lead and enriched through the API Evangelist network; Pinshape publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: PPG Industries
providers.description: PPG Industries is a Fortune 500 global supplier of paints, coatings, and specialty materials serving customers in construction, consumer products, industrial, transportation markets, and aftermarkets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with PPG Industries. As of the last review, no public APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Pratt & Whitney
providers.description: A major American aerospace manufacturer designing, manufacturing, and servicing aircraft engines for commercial, military, and business aviation applications. A division of RTX Corporation (formerly Raytheon Technologies), Pratt & Whitney is known for its geared turbofan (GTF) engine technology (PW1000G family) powering the Airbus A220 and A320neo, the F135 powering the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter, and the PT6 turboprop family. Customer-facing digital services - EngineWise health monitoring, FAST (Full-flight data Acquisition Storage and Transmission), and the Customer Portal - are operated privately for airline, MRO, and military customers behind credentialed access and are not exposed as a public developer API or open partner integration portal.

providers.name: Precision Castparts
providers.description: Precision Castparts Corp. is a worldwide manufacturer of complex metal components and products including investment castings, forgings, and fasteners and structurals for aerospace and industrial gas turbine markets. The company is owned by Berkshire Hathaway.

providers.name: prmeasure
providers.description: prmeasure (Precision Measurement & Control, 精实测控) is a Zhuhai, China based high-tech enterprise specializing in measurement, control, and artificial intelligence technologies for flexible manufacturing. The company builds industrial-grade testing and control equipment for the consumer electronics, automotive, and home-appliance industries, and offers consumer-level customized production through a C2M (customer-to-manufacturer) model. Its WowNow platform (iwownow.com) provides creative prototyping tools and flexible manufacturing equipment for individuals. prmeasure was surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming Venture Partners investment graph and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate marketing website only, with no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Process Sensing Technologies
providers.description: Process Sensing Technologies (PST) is a measurement instrumentation group that designs and manufactures precision sensors and analyzers for moisture, humidity, dew point, oxygen, and trace gas measurement across industrial, pharmaceutical, food, and life-science applications. Its brand portfolio includes Michell Instruments, Rotronic, Analytical Industries, Ntron, SensoScientific, and Isensix, spanning process gas analysis and real-time environmental monitoring. The company now operates under the DwyerOmega brand following its combination with Dwyer Instruments. It was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; probing of its public web surface found hardware, software downloads, calibration tooling, and monitoring platforms but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Pure Watercraft
providers.description: Pure Watercraft was a Seattle, Washington electric marine propulsion company founded in 2011 by Andy Rebele. It built electric outboard motors marketed as drop-in replacements for 20 to 50 horsepower gas engines, along with lithium-ion battery packs, chargers and Wi-Fi throttle controls, plus a consumer companion mobile app that pulled trip history and telemetry off the outboard over Bluetooth and pushed firmware updates to it. General Motors took a reported 25 percent stake in 2021. The company wound down and sold its assets in 2024, with the outboard line acquired by Raider Outboards and other assets going to a Seattle electric boat club. purewatercraft.com and the former companion-app host app.purewatercraft.com both now 301 to www.pureoutboards.com, the Pure Electric Outboard storefront operated by the acquirer. Pure Watercraft never published a public developer program, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API contract; its telemetry cloud was private to its own mobile app.

providers.name: Raphe Mphibr
providers.description: Raphe mPhibr is an Indian deep-tech aerospace company revolutionizing unmanned aviation through in-house carbon fiber composites, UAV airframes, propulsion, and end-to-end manufacturing. The company designs and builds heavy-lift and tactical unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs/drones) for defense and industrial applications, emphasizing research-driven innovation and vertically integrated production. Raphe mPhibr is a B2B / defense-oriented manufacturer surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface — its digital presence is a corporate marketing site only.

providers.name: Ready Robotics
providers.description: READY Robotics was a Columbus, Ohio industrial-automation software company, founded in 2016 out of Johns Hopkins University, that built Forge/OS — a universal operating system for industrial robots. Forge/OS presented one low-code programming and control surface across hundreds of robot models from ABB, Epson, FANUC, Kawasaki, Stäubli, Universal Robots and Yaskawa, and its Forge Edge product advertised a REST API with an OpenAPI/Swagger description plus client tooling for Python, JavaScript and C++, alongside the RAL2 (Robot Abstraction Layer 2) C++/Qt plugin interface used to write new robot drivers. The company ceased operations in August 2024 after a funding round collapsed, and its assets were liquidated through an assignment for the benefit of creditors. Every developer-facing host it operated — developer., docs., portal., market. and support.ready-robotics.com — no longer resolves in DNS, so no live machine-readable contract remains. What survives publicly is the marketing site behind a Cloudflare challenge and the GitHub organization, which still carries the RAL2 sample driver and the vendored C++ dependencies Forge/OS was built on.

providers.name: Rev1
providers.description: Rev1 (REV1, Inc.) is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building an AI-powered platform that automatically converts 3D CAD models into fully annotated, production-ready 2D manufacturing drawings in minutes instead of hours. The software applies ASME Y14.5-2018 geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) standards, captures design intent, and lets mechanical engineers review the design rationale before sharing with manufacturers, reportedly recovering roughly 25% of engineering time at hardware companies across robotics, aerospace, automotive, medical devices, and consumer electronics. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes only a marketing site and a demo-request flow — there is no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface to catalog.

providers.name: Revolution Precrafted
providers.description: Revolution Precrafted is a Manila, Philippines-based prefabricated design and proptech company founded in 2015 by Robbie Antonio. It designs and sells limited-edition prefab homes, pavilions, modular hotels, pop-up retail spaces, glamping structures, and furniture created by more than 80 leading global architects, designers, and artists under exclusive partnership. Backed by 500 Startups (500 Durians) and K2 Global, it reached a reported unicorn valuation. The company runs a consumer real-estate and construction business and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and mislabeled "Strategic Grow" in the source stub; the website revolutionprecrafted.com is authoritative.

providers.name: Rise Robotics
providers.description: RISE Robotics develops industrial linear-actuation technology designed to replace traditional hydraulic systems.
