Its flagship Beltdraulic Cylinder is a fluid-free hydraulic alternative delivering faster actuation, higher reliability, no fire hazard, and fuel-source flexibility for large-scale industrial applications. The company builds actuation products (Beltdraulic Cylinder, Railgate, SuperJammer, CLD) for Tier 1 suppliers, OEMs, and the US Department of Defense. RISE Robotics is a hardware and heavy-equipment company backed by Techstars; it publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this API Evangelist profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Rocket Lab
providers.description: Rocket Lab (Rocket Lab Corporation, formerly Rocket Lab USA; Nasdaq RKLB) is an American aerospace manufacturer and end-to-end space company founded in 2006 by Peter Beck. It designs and launches the Electron small-lift orbital rocket, is developing the reusable Neutron medium-lift vehicle, and builds the Photon spacecraft platform along with satellites, spacecraft components, solar cells, reaction wheels, star trackers, separation systems and other space systems. Rocket Lab operates launch complexes in Mahia, New Zealand and at Wallops Island, Virginia, providing dedicated and rideshare launch services plus on-orbit management for commercial, civil and national-security customers. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures; this profile is enriched from public identity and live domain probes only, as Rocket Lab publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Rtv
providers.description: Rtv (Return to Vendor) is a materials-innovation company building a circular recycling system for nylon-6. Its patented molecular design regenerates nylon that can be recycled infinitely without quality loss, yielding production-ready recyclable yarn, monomaterial stretch fabric, and regenerated pellets for injection molding and extrusion. The company also offers end-of-life textile collection, waste reprocessing, and regulatory-compliance support (EPR, California SB 707, EU textile regulations) for apparel, automotive, and technical industrial applications. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Third Sphere, Teknor Apex, and NSF SBIR grants.

providers.name: Saudara Ai
providers.description: Saudara AI is an AI-native sourcing brokerage, founded in 2024 and based in Spokane, Washington, that connects American brands with vetted Indonesian manufacturers. Buyers submit requests for quotes (RFQs) and the company pairs human brokers with AI agents that scan factories, verify certifications, benchmark pricing against market data, and prepare quotes, returning vetted supplier options within 48 hours. Saudara AI also handles quality control, logistics, improved payment terms (30/70 and net-60), and vendor financing. As of its launch the company reports having sourced over $1M for 40+ brands. It operates as a brokerage service and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Simplex
providers.description: Simplex (سيمبلكس) is an Egyptian industrial company representing local manufacturing and contributing to industrial development across Egypt, the Middle East, and Africa. Its public website (simplexarabia.com) is an Arabic catalog site focused on industrial spare parts and representation of Egyptian industry; it exposes no developer portal, API, documentation, SDK, or machine-readable specification. This profile was surfaced as a stub via VC-portfolio scraping and has no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Solugen
providers.description: Solugen is a chemical manufacturing company that produces sustainable industrial chemicals through its proprietary Bioforge platform, which combines engineered enzymes, metal catalysis, and modular process design to convert renewable feedstocks into products with minimal waste. Solugen serves markets including oil and gas, renewable fuels, aerospace and defense, water treatment, cleaning, agriculture, concrete, and personal care. Backed by Founders Fund, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Solugen publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface.

providers.name: supermag
providers.description: Suzhou Supermag Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese deep-tech manufacturer specializing in magnetic levitation (maglev) motion and fluid-handling systems. Its product lines include SCM maglev wafer turntables for ultra-clean semiconductor rotation, SCP maglev pumps for contamination-free fluid transport, MSS maglev stirring systems for low-shear mixing, and SCT maglev turbomolecular pumps for high-vacuum applications, serving the semiconductor, biopharmaceutical, chemical, and energy industries. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, the company markets physical industrial hardware and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Symbio Robotics
providers.description: Symbio Robotics is an AI industrial-automation company founded in 2014 and based in Emeryville, California. Its flagship product, SymbioDCS, is a robot-agnostic middleware and Python programming framework that lets automation teams build, deploy, and continuously improve AI-driven assembly applications on existing factory robots. Symbio has publicly worked with automakers including Ford, Nissan, and Toyota to speed transmission and vehicle assembly. SymbioDCS is deployed on-premises inside manufacturing lines rather than offered as a public web API; as of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer portal, documentation, SDK/package registry presence, MCP server, or API surface, and its former web domains (symb.io, symbiorobotics.com) now resolve to parked/for-sale landing pages.

providers.name: Systemax
providers.description: Systemax Inc. (now operating as Global Industrial Company, NYSE: SYX) is a B2B direct marketer of industrial, maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products in North America. The company sells storage and shelving, material handling equipment, safety products, tools, HVAC, office supplies, and thousands of other industrial products to businesses, educational organizations, and government entities through its Global Industrial brand. Systemax was founded in 1949 and rebranded its primary segment to Global Industrial in 2021.

providers.name: Tempo Automation
providers.description: Tempo Automation is a San Francisco-based software-automated printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) manufacturer, founded in 2013 and formerly publicly traded on Nasdaq as TMPO. Its software-driven manufacturing platform was built to take complex electronics from design to physical prototype and new product introduction in as little as a few days, serving customers in aerospace, medical technology, semiconductor, industrial, and automotive. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lux Capital and Uncork Capital. The company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its current website is a single-page placeholder offering on-demand circuit board manufacturing through a contact form.

providers.name: Tenet Industries
providers.description: Tenet Industries is a Swedish defense-technology startup founded in 2026 by Hugo Frisk, Fabian Andersson, and Emil Falk (students from KTH Royal Institute of Technology and the Stockholm School of Economics) building low-cost, mass-producible defense systems. Applying design-for-manufacturing and first-principles engineering, the company starts with strike/attack drones — a kamikaze quadcopter that assembles in two minutes with roughly half the parts of comparable systems — and extends the same hardware/software platform to loitering munitions, jammers, radars, and missile systems. Backed by Y Combinator ($500K). As a defense hardware manufacturer, Tenet Industries currently publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Trinity Industries
providers.description: Trinity Industries, Inc. is a leading manufacturer and lessor of railcars in North America, providing products and services to the industrial, energy, transportation, and construction sectors. The company designs, manufactures, leases, and manages railcars used to transport commodities such as energy products, agricultural goods, construction materials, and consumer staples. Trinity operates a lease fleet of over 140,000 owned and managed railcars through its TrinityRail division.

providers.name: Vero Software
providers.description: Vero Software is a developer of CAD/CAM software for manufacturing, headquartered in the United Kingdom and part of Hexagon's Manufacturing Intelligence division (Production Software). Its portfolio spans computer-aided manufacturing across metalworking, sheet metal, stone, and woodworking, with long-established desktop applications such as Alphacam, Cabinet Vision, Edgecam, Radan, SURFCAM, VISI, WorkNC, WorkXplore, Machining STRATEGIST, and PEPS. These are primarily installed engineering and CNC programming products rather than web services; as of this enrichment pass the company does not publish a public web API, developer portal, or SDK, and the verosoftware.com domain now redirects to Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence marketing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vicarious
providers.description: Vicarious (Vicarious FPC) was an artificial intelligence and industrial robotics company founded in 2010 by D. Scott Phoenix and Dileep George. It pursued brain-inspired machine learning, notably the Recursive Cortical Network that solved text CAPTCHAs with far less training data, then applied that research to general-purpose robotic automation for warehouse and manufacturing tasks. The company was backed by DCVC, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, ABB, Samsung, and Wipro, and was acquired by Intrinsic, Alphabet's robotics moonshot, in 2022. Its vicarious.com domain no longer resolves and it exposes no public API surface.

providers.name: Vision Space Inc.
providers.description: Vision Space Inc. (VisionSpace) is a South Korean company building Physical AI robot simulation software for automation in the logistics and manufacturing sectors. Its TESSERACT product implements logistics and manufacturing sites as digital twins, visualizing process data and predicting operational efficiency through AI-based simulation, while its TARS product delivers real-time 3D monitoring that integrates and manages data from equipment and robots in a unified 3D control dashboard. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass VisionSpace publishes a marketing website only and exposes no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or GitHub organization.

providers.name: Zwitterco
providers.description: ZwitterCo is an advanced water treatment company that manufactures filtration membranes based on zwitterionic chemistry, a surface science that makes membranes attract water rather than organic compounds and thereby resist the organic fouling that limits conventional membranes. Its product families target food and dairy processing (Evolution membranes for whey and milk concentration), industrial and municipal wastewater (Elevation membranes for landfill leachate, refinery streams, and produced water), and extreme high-fouling waste streams (Expedition superfiltration). ZwitterCo is a DCVC portfolio company. It sells physical membrane hardware and treatment systems through direct sales and does not currently publish any public developer portal, API, SDKs, or machine-readable interface; this profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Advanced Drainage Systems
providers.description: Advanced Drainage Systems (ADS) is a leading manufacturer of stormwater and onsite septic wastewater solutions. The company produces drainage infrastructure including pipes, chambers, basins, and water quality treatment products serving residential, commercial, agricultural, airport, and transportation markets. ADS provides CAD integrations and engineering resources for civil engineering professionals.

providers.name: Hillenbrand
providers.description: Hillenbrand is a global manufacturer of highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and systems serving the plastics, food, and recycling industries. The company operates across more than 60 global locations with a portfolio of leading industrial brands. Hillenbrand reports approximately $2.7 billion in annual revenue and employs over 8,000 associates worldwide.

providers.name: Sylvamo
providers.description: Sylvamo is a global producer of uncoated freesheet paper, pulp, and other forest products, with mills and operations across North America, Latin America, and Europe. The company is recognized for brands such as HP Papers, Hammermill, and Chamex. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified; Sylvamo operates primarily through B2B sales channels and investor and corporate communications channels.

providers.name: Entegris
providers.description: Entegris is a global supplier of advanced materials and process solutions for the semiconductor and other high-technology industries. The company develops and manufactures specialty chemicals, gases, filtration and purification systems, advanced materials handling, and process control products. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified at the corporate level; technical integration is typically supported through sales engineering, the supplier portal, and product documentation.

providers.name: GE Aerospace
providers.description: A leading manufacturer of jet engines and aviation systems for commercial and military aircraft. Spun off from General Electric to focus exclusively on aerospace propulsion and services, GE Aerospace also offers software-as-a-service tooling, engine health monitoring (Collaborative Insight), TRUEngine certification, and OnPoint maintenance and support services.

providers.name: Ateios
providers.description: Ateios Systems is an Indianapolis-based advanced battery manufacturer that produces high-energy, recyclable, PFA-free battery electrodes for global battery makers. Its proprietary RaiCure platform is a solvent-free, cure-on-command coating process using energy-curable polymers instead of solvent-based thermal drying, enabling thicker electrodes (>10 mAh/cm2), higher energy density, and roughly 5x faster coating throughput at lower cost and emissions. Ateios targets medical device, IoT, mobility, and defense markets. Founded in 2017 and backed by Techstars, TitletownTech, Good Growth Capital and others, the company is a materials/hardware manufacturer and publishes no developer API, SDK, or programmatic developer platform.

providers.name: finern
providers.description: Finern (Finern Automation) is a China-based industrial automation company that designs and builds fully automated production lines and intelligent measurement systems for manufacturing. It serves five sectors — automotive, electronics, new energy (battery/EV), healthcare/pharmaceutical equipment, and consumer goods — with automated assembly, testing, and inspection systems. The company reports 600+ personnel, 30,000+ square meters of facilities, 100+ global clients, 8 international sites, and 4 R&D centers. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Finern publishes a corporate marketing website but does not currently expose any public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable discovery surface (no /.well-known/*, llms.txt, or OpenAPI found on probe).

providers.name: Fortive
providers.description: Fortive Corporation is a Fortune 500 diversified industrial technology conglomerate headquartered in Everett, Washington. The company operates across two main segments, Advanced Healthcare Solutions and Intelligent Operating Solutions, providing essential technologies for medical device safety, radiation protection, workflow automation, hazard detection, and predictive maintenance through its operating companies. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Fortive at the parent company level. Most APIs and developer resources are maintained by Fortive's individual operating companies.

providers.name: Gokin
providers.description: Gokin Solar Co., Ltd. (高景太阳能股份有限公司) is a Chinese photovoltaic manufacturer founded in 2019 and headquartered in Jiangsu, China. The company produces monocrystalline silicon ingots and wafers (N-type and P-type) and high-efficiency solar modules (GOKIN BC and FLAMINGO series), operating four major production bases with roughly 100 GW of wafer and 16 GW of module annual capacity. Ranked among the top three global silicon-wafer shippers, Gokin employs 6,000+ people, holds 500+ patents, and serves utility, commercial, and residential solar projects across 30+ countries. Backed by IDG Capital, Gokin is a solar-hardware manufacturer with a corporate marketing website and no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Shinehe (Hangzhou Xinzeyuan Medical Technology)
providers.description: Shinehe (Hangzhou Xinzeyuan Medical Technology Co., Ltd. / 杭州鑫泽源医疗科技有限公司) is a Hangzhou, China based contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for the minimally invasive medical device sector. Founded in 2015, the company provides precision component manufacturing, customized development, and OEM/ODM services covering endoscope accessories (insertion, operation, and light guide components), single-use consumables (hemostasis, biopsy, EMR, dilation), rigid endoscope components, and minimally invasive surgical instruments, aiming to be a global minimally invasive medical device supply-chain platform. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or SDK surface was found during enrichment; this profile is maintained as a company identity record.

providers.name: Solestial
providers.description: Solestial is a space solar energy company developing space-stable silicon photovoltaics — radiation-hardened, ultrathin flexible silicon heterojunction solar cells and modules for spacecraft. Its products are the only solar products on the market that self-cure radiation damage at operating temperatures, offering competitive performance at lower cost than III-V multijunction solar. Solestial has flight heritage across multiple spacecraft and works with customers including NASA, Boeing, and the U.S. Space Force. This is a hardware and manufacturing company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Ultra Safe Nuclear
providers.description: Ultra Safe Nuclear Corporation (USNC) was a Seattle-based advanced nuclear company, founded in 2011, that vertically integrated fourth-generation nuclear power — the Micro Modular Reactor (MMR), the Pylon space reactor developed through its USNC-Tech subsidiary, and Fully Ceramic Microencapsulated (FCM) TRISO nuclear fuel manufactured at Oak Ridge, Tennessee. It filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the District of Delaware in October 2024 following the death of its principal investor, and its assets were sold in a bifurcated Section 363 auction: NANO Nuclear Energy acquired the MMR and Pylon reactor patents and demonstration partnerships for $8.5 million (court-approved 18 December 2024), and Standard Nuclear acquired the FCM/TRISO fuel business and the Oak Ridge facility for $28 million (closed February 2025). The company no longer operates. Its primary domain, usnc.com, is still registered and still routes mail on the Microsoft 365 US Government cloud but publishes no address record, so the corporate web presence is gone. As a reactor and nuclear-fuel manufacturer it never ran a developer program, and no public API, specification, SDK, or agent surface was found under its name.

providers.name: Yuze Semiconductor
providers.description: Yuze Semiconductor — legally Yunnan Yuze New Energy Co., Ltd. (云南宇泽新能源股份有限公司), trading internationally as Unigrace New Energy — is a Chinese photovoltaic materials manufacturer founded in May 2019 and headquartered in Kunming, Yunnan. It produces N-type solar monocrystalline silicon rods and wafers covering the three mainstream N-type cell routes (HJT, TOPCon and IBC), operating manufacturing bases in Chuxiong, Wenshan and Kunming in Yunnan and Yichun in Jiangxi, with a sales centre in Suzhou. The company was named a 2022 Chinese Unicorn Enterprise and its shares trade on secondary private markets. It is a physical-goods manufacturer: its public web presence carries company, product, news and recruitment pages only, with no developer program, no API, and no machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: ADM Labs
providers.description: ADM Labs is a Denver, Colorado hemp processor founded in 2017 by Arman Motiwalla as a subsidiary of ADM Group, running an extraction facility on Tejon Street that manufactured and wholesaled hemp-derived extracts - biomass, premium smokable, crude, distillate, isolate and water-soluble CBD, plus newer exotic cannabinoids - with white-label formulation for retail brands. It is a physical-goods manufacturer, not a software business, and never ran a developer program: its 2018-2021 site was a WordPress marketing site whose only transactional surface was a hosted Zoho Commerce storefront at store.adm-labs.com, with no API, SDK, webhook or developer link in its navigation. The company has since rebranded as Hemp Corp, which its original LinkedIn page still carries, and both adm-labs.com and the successor hempcorpusa.com now serve parking pages.

providers.name: Atomic Semi
providers.description: Atomic Semi is a semiconductor company founded in 2023 by Sam Zeloof and Jim Keller, now operating publicly as fab2 (atomicsemi.com redirects to fab2.com). It designs and manufactures semiconductor fabrication equipment and the fabs that house it — pumps, valves, sensors, actuators, chambers, heaters, gas lines and robots — with the stated goal of mass-producing small, software-defined chip fabs, a "fab fab". It runs a 120K sq ft chip fab in Austin TX (HQ), a 30K sq ft fab fab in Lockhart TX, and the original 25K sq ft garage fab in San Francisco. Its one software product, Studio (formerly Atomic Studio), is an in-browser collaborative EDA for schematic capture, layout and simulation, used internally rather than sold as a developer platform. The company publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Builders FirstSource
providers.description: Builders FirstSource (NYSE: BLDR) is the nation's largest supplier and manufacturer of structural building products, value-added components, and construction services to the professional market for single-family and multi-family construction. The company operates approximately 570 locations across 43 states with 28,000 team members, headquartered in Irving, Texas. Its product portfolio includes lumber, manufactured components, doors, windows, millwork, cabinets, and roofing, complemented by digital procurement and project management tools through the myBLDR platform.

providers.name: Genuine Parts Company
providers.description: Genuine Parts Company is a Fortune 500 service organization engaged in the distribution of automotive replacement parts (the parent of NAPA Auto Parts), industrial replacement parts, and electrical materials and electronic components.

providers.name: Huntington Ingalls Industries
providers.description: Huntington Ingalls Industries is the largest military shipbuilding company in the United States, designing, building, overhauling, and repairing ships primarily for the U.S. Navy and Coast Guard, while also providing professional services including unmanned systems, defense solutions, and cybersecurity. No public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Inxeption
providers.description: Inxeption was a B2B "industrial commerce" software company founded in 2017 by serial entrepreneur Farzad Dibachi and headquartered in Silicon Valley (San Jose / Cupertino, California). It sold a cloud commerce platform that let manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers stand up a branded online storefront and digital product catalog, then manage quoting, contract-specific pricing, purchase orders, bulk and multimodal orders, freight and logistics, returns, payments and sales analytics from one place — a category it marketed as the "Industrial Commerce SuperApp". Its best-known product was Inxeption Zippy, launched in March 2019 with UPS after an equity investment from the UPS Strategic Enterprise Fund, which bundled UPS as the shipper of choice into the storefront. The company raised roughly $186M across its rounds, including a $125M Series E in January 2022. Inxeption shut down on 2024-08-15. It never operated a public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK or package was ever published, and its integration story was bespoke customer and EDI connections delivered under contract. Today only the apex domain resolves, and it no longer belongs to the company — it is listed for sale on the serp.domains domain marketplace. This profile is retained as a historical company record.

providers.name: Nexa3D
providers.description: Nexa3D was a Ventura, California additive-manufacturing company that built ultrafast photopolymer 3D printers (NXE 400, XiP, XiP Pro) around its Lubricant Sublayer Photo-curing (LSPc) process, QLS selective-laser-sintering systems, and the NexaX print-preparation and print-management software. The company disclosed severe funding challenges in late 2024, withdrew from Formnext, scaled back operations, and in July 2025 sold select assets — intellectual property, inventory and equipment, but not personnel — to Stratasys, with customer support and materials continuity moving to Stratasys subsidiary iSQUARED. Nexa3D no longer operates as an independent company: nexa3d.com now 301-redirects to a third-party additive-manufacturing materials marketplace, and no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, MCP manifest, agent card) was found on any Nexa3D host, live or archived.

providers.name: Prescient
providers.description: Prescient Co. Inc. was a United States construction-technology and manufacturing company that sold an integrated design, engineering, manufacturing and assembly platform for multi-unit buildings — apartments, condominiums, student and military dormitories, hotels and senior-living communities. Its product was the patented Prescient Solution built on the Unified Truss Construction System (UTCS), a light-gauge steel structural framing system manufactured off-site in panelised components and assembled on-site, marketed as a faster, greener and lower-cost alternative to conventional cast-in-place and wood-frame structures at heights up to roughly twelve stories. The "technology" in the offering was internal design-automation software that linked architectural design, structural engineering, factory manufacturing and field assembly into one digital model; it was delivered as a design-build service to real-estate developers and general contractors, never as a product a third party could integrate with. Founded in 2012 (some sources list 2013) and headquartered in North Carolina — Charlotte, later Durham — with manufacturing in Mebane, North Carolina and Arvada, Colorado, the company raised a large private round stack including a $40M Series D and a Series E led by Eldridge Industries at a reported $650M valuation; publicly reported lifetime totals disagree, with EquityZen listing $103M and Crunchbase reporting roughly $375M through Series G. The company contracted sharply: the Mebane plant closed in 2022 with 83 jobs cut, 50 Arvada jobs were cut in April 2023, and a Colorado WARN notice filed on 31 August 2023 announced the permanent closure of the Arvada plant and a further 60 jobs, stating that upon conclusion of the shutdown activities the company would be closed. Prescient never operated a public developer program, API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification, and prescientco.com has since passed out of the company's control. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Rapid Robotics
providers.description: Rapid Robotics was a San Francisco robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) company, founded in 2019 by Jordan Kretchmer, that rented pre-trained six-axis "Rapid Machine Operators" to small and mid-size manufacturers on a subscription — roughly $25,000 per robot per year — to cover repetitive machine-tending work such as pad printing, injection molding, heat staking, heat stamping, ultrasonic welding, pick-and-place and parts inspection. The robots shipped with grippers, computer-vision software and models pre-trained on CAD, and were set up and supervised through a proprietary no-code fleet console rather than through a developer interface. The company raised about $54.2M in total — a $12M Series A in 2021 and a $36.7M Series B co-led by Kleiner Perkins and Tiger Global — and announced partnerships with Universal Robots and Yaskawa Motoman in early 2023. Rapid Robotics subsequently wound down, and its assets — hardware, marquee customers and the US team — were acquired by Munich-based RaaS company RobCo, which used them to enter the US market and announced a new San Francisco headquarters on 9 September 2025. The company never published a public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable specification of any kind: 1,773 unique archived URLs on rapidrobotics.com contain no /api, /apis, /docs, /developer, /graphql or /sdk path. The domain is no longer operated by the company — it is delegated to ns1/ns2.atom.com and redirects to a brand-name marketplace listing. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical record; there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Rizm
providers.description: RIZM is a holistic energy optimization platform for industrial enterprises, operated by Kerith GmbH of Münster, Germany. It integrates data from production, energy procurement, and infrastructure into a digital twin, then optimizes energy system design and day-to-day operational decisions — from long-term infrastructure investment and power purchase agreements to short-term asset dispatch and production scheduling — helping manufacturers cut energy costs and emissions at the same time. Named customers include BMW Group, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, and BSH. The product is delivered as a login-gated web application (app.rizm.de) with authenticated documentation; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time. Backed by Point Nine, this profile was surfaced from the venture portfolio graph.

providers.name: Ynsect
providers.description: Ÿnsect (Ÿnsect SAS) was a French agri-technology company, founded in Évry, Essonne on 4 October 2011 by Antoine Hubert, Jean-Gabriel Levon, Fabrice Berro and Alexis Angot, that farmed Tenebrio molitor mealworms and Alphitobius diaperinus buffalo larvae in automated vertical farms and processed them into high-protein ingredients for aquaculture and animal feed, the Spryng pet-food line, food-grade ingredients for human nutrition, and the Ynfrass organic fertiliser made from insect frass. It was for a time the best-funded insect-protein company in the world, raising roughly €600 million over fourteen years, including a €372 million Series C in 2020 and a further €160 million in early 2023, and it operated sites at Dole and Damparis in the Jura while building the Ynfarm vertical farm at Poulainville near Amiens. The economics never closed: Ÿnsect requested safeguard proceedings on 26 September 2024, was placed in judicial reorganisation on 3 March 2025, and — unable to fund a continuation plan within the observation period — was placed in judicial liquidation on 1 December 2025. The Damparis site was taken over in 2025 by Keprea, a separate company founded by Ÿnsect alumni, to make fertiliser from insect frass; Keprea is not a successor to Ÿnsect and its surfaces are not part of this profile. Ÿnsect was an industrial producer of physical goods and never operated a developer program, public API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification of any kind. Its host ynsect.com is still registered to the company but the web origin has been switched off — TCP 80 and 443 refuse connections — and ynsect.fr is a bare OVH redirect to that dead host, so no pointer to a live company website is wired. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Advanced Solar Power
providers.description: Advanced Solar Power (Hangzhou) Inc. is a Chinese photovoltaic manufacturer founded in 2008 that researches, produces and sells cadmium telluride (CdTe) thin-film solar modules, photovoltaic system engineering, and building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) application products. It was the first CdTe thin-film module manufacturer in China, is led by former CdTe conversion-efficiency world-record holder Professor Xuanzhi Wu, and has developed its own deposition equipment and process technology. Its S1, S2 and S4 standard modules and BIPV lines (photovoltaic floor tiles, imitation-aluminum and imitation-marble facade modules, shaped and insulated modules) carry ISO, TUV, CE, UL, CQC, Australia CEC and California CEC certifications, and have been deployed on the China Pavilion of the 2019 Beijing Horticultural Expo and other landmark facade and rooftop projects. The company sells physical hardware and system integration; it publishes no developer program, API, or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Beyond Imagination
providers.description: Beyond Imagination, Inc. is a Los Angeles based robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in January 2018 by Dr. Harry Kloor and Dr. Ray Kurzweil, building general-purpose humanoid robots and the AI software stack that runs them. Its flagship platform is Beomni, a wheeled humanoid robot with an articulated upper body and dexterous hands that can be teleoperated through VR headsets and haptic gloves or run autonomously. The software side is marketed as four products: AURA (Adaptive Unified Robotic/Human Administrator), a universal operating system for coordinating robots, humans and infrastructure across manufacturing ecosystems; ARCANA, an LLM-free synthetic brain architecture for real-time perception, decision making and coordination; Expert Minds, modular AI job modules trained for specialized roles such as chemical handling, bio-reactor operation, surgical prep and warehouse logistics; and Hive Mind Intelligence, a fleet learning layer where robots upload new skills to a shared cloud memory. The company has run pilot programs in commercial kitchens, laboratory work, healthcare and pharmaceutical manufacturing, and announced a manufacturing partnership with Korean electronics manufacturer Dreamtech. As of this profiling pass Beyond Imagination publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs or MCP/agent surface; its public web presence is a marketing site only.

providers.name: General Electric
providers.description: General Electric Company has reorganized into separate publicly traded companies: GE Aerospace, focused on jet engines and aviation systems, and GE Vernova, focused on energy and power generation. GE HealthCare was spun off in 2023. No unified public developer API portal is currently published by GE Aerospace or GE Vernova.

providers.name: Utility Global
providers.description: Utility Global is a Houston, Texas industrial decarbonization company founded in 2018. Its proprietary H2Gen and eXERO platform converts water into high-purity hydrogen using the residual electrochemical energy already present in industrial off-gases and biogenic gases — driving water electrolysis without electricity — while concentrating CO2 into a separate capture-ready stream. The company sells into steel, low-carbon fuels, and refining, petrochemicals and chemicals, and has run demonstration programs on blast-furnace off-gas at commercial steel facilities. It is a hardware and process-technology business, not a software vendor: its public web presence is a marketing site with no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Atkore
providers.description: Atkore is a manufacturer of electrical conduit, cable management systems, metal framing, and other safety and infrastructure products used in commercial, industrial, and residential construction. The company offers several end-user technical tools, including the Atkore BIM Toolbar (a Revit plugin), Atkore Virtual 3D, and an online Hanger Configurator, but does not expose a public REST API or self-service developer portal at this time.

providers.name: BociMed
providers.description: Shanghai BociMed Pharmaceutical Research Co., Ltd. (上海博志研新药物研究有限公司) is a Chinese pharmaceutical CRO/CDMO founded in 2012 in the Zhangjiang Pharmaceutical Valley, Shanghai, with an R&D headquarters in Zhangjiang, a production base in Lingang, and a clinical subsidiary in Chengdu. BociMed offers small-molecule chemistry, CMC and process development, a portfolio of drug delivery technology platforms (oral, injectable, nasal, pulmonary, transdermal, ocular, implant, liposome and exosome), clinical research and SMO services, global regulatory registration consulting, and commercial API, intermediate and solid-dosage manufacturing. It is a laboratory and manufacturing services business rather than a software vendor: it publishes a marketing website in Chinese and English and no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Jabil
providers.description: Jabil is a global manufacturing services company that provides engineering, supply chain, and manufactured product solutions for the world's leading brands across industries including automotive, healthcare, industrial, consumer electronics, networking, and cloud infrastructure.

providers.name: Jabil Circuit
providers.description: Jabil (formerly Jabil Circuit) is a global manufacturing services and solutions company providing comprehensive electronics design, production, and product management services to electronics and technology companies in a broad range of industries.

providers.name: PACCAR
providers.description: PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture, and customer support of premium light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF nameplates. PACCAR also designs and manufactures advanced diesel engines, provides financial services and information technology, and distributes truck parts related to its principal business.

providers.name: Parker Hannifin
providers.description: Parker Hannifin is a global leader in motion and control technologies, providing precision-engineered solutions for a wide variety of mobile, industrial, and aerospace markets. No public developer API has been documented at this time.

providers.name: PEI-Genesis
providers.description: PEI-Genesis is a privately held, Philadelphia-headquartered global authorized distributor and value-added assembler of interconnect components (cable and circular connectors), founded in 1946. The company self-describes on LinkedIn as providing "Engineered Solutions for Connectors and Cables" in the Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing industry, with 501-1,000 employees. The public-facing peigenesis.com web property is a product catalog and quote-request portal protected by an interstitial JavaScript challenge; no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, EDI integration documentation, PunchOut catalog, or GitHub organization could be located. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: XING Mobility
providers.description: XING Mobility (行競科技) is a Taiwan-based battery technology company building immersion-cooled lithium battery systems under the IMMERSIO brand, including cell-to-pack (CTP) battery platforms, battery backup units (BBU) for AI data centers, and the automotive-grade XBE energy storage series, serving electric mobility, energy storage (ESS), marine, and data center markets from its Taoyuan City headquarters. A 500 Global portfolio company, XING Mobility publishes no public developer API or API documentation as of July 2026.

providers.name: TeraWatt Technology
providers.description: TeraWatt Technology Inc. is a next-generation lithium-ion battery company founded in 2020 by Ken Ogata (CEO) and Yifan Tang, headquartered in California with an R&D center in Santa Clara and operations in Japan, including its first mass-production facility in Shizuoka. The company develops, manufactures and commercializes lithium-ion cells engineered for ultra-high energy density, high power output, improved safety and competitive cost, aimed at electric vehicles, drones, eVTOL aircraft and grid-scale energy-storage systems. It closed a Series C round with investors including Khosla Ventures, Temasek, JIC Venture Growth Investments, JBIC, JERA and ITOCHU Technology Ventures. TeraWatt Technology is a hardware manufacturer: it publishes no public API, developer portal, machine-readable contract or SDK, which was verified by probing its only public host rather than assumed.

providers.name: Toyota Motor Corporation
providers.description: The world's largest automobile manufacturer by production volume, producing a wide range of vehicles from sedans and SUVs to hybrids and hydrogen fuel cell cars. Pioneer of lean manufacturing and hybrid technology through the iconic Prius.

providers.name: Raytheon
providers.description: Raytheon is an American aerospace and defense manufacturer operating as a business of RTX Corporation, the world's largest aerospace and defense company. Raytheon designs, develops, and produces advanced defense systems including precision weapons, air and missile defense systems, sensors, radar, electronic warfare, command-and-control solutions, and cyber capabilities for the U.S. military and allied governments worldwide. Key products include the Patriot missile defense system, StormBreaker smart weapons, RAIVEN electro-optical/infrared sensor suites, and advanced electronic attack systems. Raytheon also develops world-class logistics software through the EAGLE team supporting production management, technical manual development, and product support data. No public developer API or machine-readable specification is available at this time; Raytheon's software solutions are deployed within government program contracts.

providers.name: ATI
providers.description: ATI Inc. is a specialty materials and components manufacturer that produces high-performance alloys, titanium products, nickel-based superalloys, and engineered components. The company primarily serves the aerospace, defense, energy, electronics, and medical industries. ATI focuses on direct B2B customer relationships and does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Axio Biosolutions
providers.description: Axio Biosolutions Private Limited is a medical technology manufacturer headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, focused on advanced chitosan-based solutions for bleeding control, trauma care, surgical care, and advanced wound care. Its Axiostat hemostatic dressings deliver rapid hemostasis for emergency, military, and surgical bleeding, while its MaxioCel microfiber gelling wound dressings support wound healing, exudate management, and infection risk reduction across chronic and acute wounds. Axio operates its own manufacturing and quality systems and holds FDA and CE regulatory certifications. The company publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile captures its public web and discovery surface.

providers.name: Donaldson
providers.description: Donaldson Company, Inc. is a global leader in providing engine and industrial air, oil and liquid filtration solutions. No public developer-facing APIs have been identified at this time; this index will be updated if any are made available.

providers.name: Dover Corporation
providers.description: Dover Corporation is a diversified American industrial conglomerate headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois. Dover operates across five segments - Engineered Products, Clean Energy and Fueling, Imaging and Identification, Pumps and Process Solutions, and Climate and Sustainability Technologies - through a portfolio of decentralized operating companies including Dover Fueling Solutions, OPW, Markem-Imaje, PSG, and Vehicle Service Group.

providers.name: DuPont
providers.description: DuPont is a leading solutions provider for healthcare, water, and a broad range of industrial segments, powered by high-performance engineered products, leading-edge application development, and top-tier manufacturing. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time; this index captures DuPont's web presence for monitoring future developer activity.

providers.name: Howmet Aerospace
providers.description: Howmet Aerospace is a global leader in advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries, providing engine components, fastening systems, engineered structures, and forged wheels.

providers.name: IDEX Corporation
providers.description: IDEX Corporation (NYSE: IEX) is a global engineered products company that designs and manufactures pumps, flow meters, valves, fluidics systems, precision components, and fire and safety equipment. IDEX serves health, science, water, energy, semiconductor, aerospace, fire and safety, and industrial markets through three segments: Fluid and Metering Technologies, Health and Science Technologies, and Fire and Safety / Diversified Products.

providers.name: Joy Global (Komatsu Mining)
providers.description: Joy Global was a worldwide leader in manufacturing, servicing, and distributing equipment for surface mining, underground mining, and rock excavation before being acquired by Komatsu and rebranded as Komatsu Mining. There is no public developer program or APIs published for Joy Global / Komatsu Mining at this time.

providers.name: Lean Manufacturing
providers.description: Lean Manufacturing is a manufacturing philosophy that focuses on minimizing waste within manufacturing systems while simultaneously maximizing productivity. It leverages automation, precision engineering, and digital controls to improve quality, efficiency, and throughput.

providers.name: MeadWestvaco
providers.description: MeadWestvaco was a global packaging company providing packaging solutions to many of the world's most-admired brands in the personal and beauty care, food, beverage, home and garden, and other industries. In 2015 MeadWestvaco merged with Rock-Tenn to form WestRock, and the MeadWestvaco brand has since been retired. No public APIs or developer resources are documented for the legacy MeadWestvaco entity or for its WestRock successor.

providers.name: MillerKnoll
providers.description: MillerKnoll is a global collective of design brands including Herman Miller, Knoll, and other heritage furniture and design companies. The company designs and manufactures office, residential, and contract furniture, lighting, and accessories sold through retail, contract, and dealer channels. MillerKnoll does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: MSC Industrial Direct
providers.description: MSC Industrial Direct is one of the largest industrial product distributors in North America, providing metalworking, maintenance, repair, and operations products and services to manufacturers.

providers.name: Mueller Industries
providers.description: Mueller Industries is a leading manufacturer of copper, brass, aluminum, and plastic products serving the plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration, industrial, automotive, and other markets.

providers.name: Navistar International
providers.description: Navistar International is a holding company that produces International brand commercial and military trucks, proprietary diesel engines, and IC Bus brand school and commercial buses. The company is now part of Traton Group (a Volkswagen Group subsidiary). No public APIs have been identified at this time; the legacy navistar-international.com domain currently redirects to a parts marketplace.

providers.name: Titan Machinery
providers.description: Titan Machinery Inc. owns and operates one of the largest networks of full-service agricultural and construction equipment dealer stores in North America and Europe. The company sells, services, and rents new and used Case IH, New Holland, Case Construction, and other branded equipment, along with parts and precision farming technology. Titan Machinery serves farmers, ranchers, and construction contractors across multiple states and countries.

providers.name: VR Medical
providers.description: VR Medical (Kunshan Weirui Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a medical device company founded in 2009 that designs, develops, and manufactures devices for respiratory care, critical care, and wound care, operating an FDA-registered, ISO 13485 certified plant in Kunshan, China. Qiming Venture Partners led its Series A in February 2016. The company publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Kyten Technologies
providers.description: Kyten Technologies is a Seattle, Washington hardware manufacturing startup building a factory to produce custom aerospace-grade battery packs. The founders spent six years at Starlink, where they put more than 5,000 battery packs into space, and are now bringing rapid development and volume production of aerospace-grade battery packs to the wider industry. The company positions itself against a legacy supply chain that cannot keep up with the 100,000+ drones, submarines, and satellites being built in the United States. Kyten Technologies is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company, classified under Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics, and was an early-stage two-person team at the time of profiling. As a hardware manufacturer it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Letel
providers.description: Shanghai Letel Communication Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd. (上海乐通通信设备（集团）股份有限公司) is a Chinese manufacturer of information and communication network infrastructure, founded in March 1992 and headquartered in Shanghai with over 1,500 employees and 20+ service locations nationwide. Letel builds data center physical infrastructure — cabinet micromodules, cold aisle micromodules, containerized micromodules, pallet IT cabins, and cabinets — alongside communication cabling equipment, optical communication devices, data communication equipment, broadband access equipment, and structural components for notebooks and servers. It operates through subsidiaries including Zhongle Communication Technology Co., Ltd. Letel publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; this is a company profile in the API Evangelist network, surfaced as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company.

providers.name: Modern Electron
providers.description: Modern Electron is a Bothell, Washington energy-hardware company founded in 2015 by Tony Pan (CEO) and Max Mankin (CTO) as a spin-out of Intellectual Ventures. It was built to commercialize advanced thermionic energy converters — solid-state, direct heat-to-electricity devices intended to add on-site generation to combustion and thermal equipment. The company now operates publicly as Modern Hydrogen, applying methane pyrolysis behind the meter to crack natural gas into hydrogen and solid carbon before combustion, for industrial heat and steam, on-site power, data-center energy, asphalt products and heavy-duty fleet fueling. The product is physical equipment installed at customer sites; Modern Electron / Modern Hydrogen operates no developer program, publishes no public API, SDK or machine-readable specification, and its public GitHub organization holds only forks of open-source scientific-computing projects (WarpX, AMReX, PICMI, GPy) used in its own R&D.

providers.name: Polyone
providers.description: PolyOne Corporation was a specialty polymer materials and services company formed in 2000 through the merger of M.A. Hanna Company and The Geon Company. In 2020, after acquiring a division from Clariant, the company rebranded as Avient Corporation. No public developer APIs are documented.

regulatory.note: provider declares no identity tags; regime could not be determined

providers.name: Winnebago Industries
providers.description: Winnebago Industries is a leading North American manufacturer of outdoor lifestyle products under the Winnebago, Grand Design, Newmar, Chris-Craft, Barletta, and Lithionics Battery brands. The company designs, manufactures, and markets recreational vehicles, marine products, and supporting components. Winnebago Industries does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Alsym Energy
providers.description: Alsym Energy is a Malden, Massachusetts battery technology company founded in 2015 by Mukesh Chatter, Rahul Mukherjee, and Kripa Varanasi to develop low-cost, high-performance rechargeable batteries that are free of lithium and cobalt. Its Na-Series is a line of non-flammable, non-toxic sodium-ion batteries aimed at grid and utility-scale energy storage, data-center backup, and industrial applications where safety and supply-chain resilience matter. The company uses a proprietary AI/computational-materials platform to accelerate battery chemistry development, and has raised roughly $111M+ including a $78M round in 2024 led by Tata Limited and General Catalyst. Alsym is a hardware/energy-infrastructure manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Amprius Technologies
providers.description: Amprius Technologies is a Fremont, California-based developer and manufacturer of high-energy density lithium-ion batteries built on a proprietary 100% silicon anode platform. Its flagship SiCore and SiMaxx cell families are marketed as among the industry's highest gravimetric and volumetric energy density rechargeable cells, enabling longer endurance, faster charging, and higher payload capacity than conventional graphite-anode chemistries. Amprius targets aviation and aerospace (high-altitude pseudo-satellites, unmanned aerial systems, electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft), defense (US Army soldier-worn power, BAE Systems), light electric vehicles, robotics, and AI hardware. Public references include AALTO's Airbus-derived Zephyr HAPS programs, Prismatic's PHASA-35 stratospheric aircraft, Nokia Drone Networks, and Matternet drone delivery. The company runs pilot manufacturing and R&D in Fremont and is scaling a GWh-scale Brighton, Colorado plant alongside contract manufacturing partnerships in Asia. Amprius is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker AMPX. It is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100:2016. Amprius sells cells, modules, and engineering services to OEMs and defense primes; it does not publish a developer API, SDK, or open-source battery telemetry interface, and has no public GitHub organization.

providers.name: Coreshell
providers.description: Coreshell (Coreshell Technologies, Inc.) is a San Leandro, California battery technology company founded in 2017 that develops silicon-anode lithium-ion battery cells built on low-cost, domestically sourced metallurgical-grade silicon instead of graphite or refined polysilicon. A proprietary nanolayer surface coating stabilizes the silicon anode, and the company has unveiled commercial-scale 60 Ah cells aimed at electric vehicles, defense platforms and stationary energy storage. Coreshell is a materials and cell manufacturer, not a software vendor: its public web presence is a Webflow marketing site with no developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, SDK, or public code repository.

providers.name: Form Energy
providers.description: Form Energy is a long-duration energy storage company headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts and Weirton, West Virginia. Its flagship product is an iron-air battery designed to store electricity for up to 100 hours, intended to enable utilities and grid operators to firm renewable generation across multi-day weather events, replace aging fossil-fueled peakers, and defer transmission and distribution upgrades. The company manufactures its battery at Form Factory 1, a 550,000-square-foot facility built on the former Weirton Steel mill site that employs roughly 400 people. Form Energy also publishes Formware, a grid-modeling software suite used by utilities to plan resource portfolios that include multi-day storage. Notable customers and partners include Georgia Power, Xcel Energy, Great River Energy, Dominion Energy, PG&E, New York Power Authority, and Crusoe Energy (a 12 GWh agreement to firm power for AI data centers). Form Energy does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK; engagement is through utility sales, partnership, and policy channels.

providers.name: Plexus
providers.description: Plexus is a global manufacturing and product development company that helps customers in highly regulated industries (Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Industrial, and Semiconductor Capital Equipment) design, manufacture, and service their products. Plexus does not currently publish a public developer API; this index tracks customer/supplier portals and corporate web properties.

providers.name: Quantumscape
providers.description: QuantumScape is a battery technology company developing next-generation solid-state lithium-metal batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage. Its anode-free cell design aims to deliver greater energy density, faster charging, longer life, and improved safety versus conventional lithium-ion cells, while simplifying manufacturing and lowering cost. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a corporate website, blog, and investor relations resources but no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: ChampionX
providers.description: ChampionX provides oilfield and gas technology solutions, including chemical technologies, artificial lift systems, digital monitoring platforms, and emissions monitoring equipment. The company serves upstream and midstream operators around the world. ChampionX does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Cummins
providers.description: Cummins is a global power leader that designs, manufactures, distributes, and services diesel and natural gas engines, electric and hybrid powertrains, electrified power systems, components such as filtration, aftertreatment, turbochargers, fuel systems, controls systems, air handling systems, automated transmissions, and electric power generation systems. Cummins serves customers in approximately 190 countries and territories through a network of more than 600 company-owned and independent distributor locations and approximately 7,200 dealer locations.

providers.name: Dresser-Rand Group
providers.description: Dresser-Rand Group was a global supplier of rotating equipment solutions to the worldwide oil, gas, petrochemical, and process industries. It was acquired by Siemens in 2015 and now operates as part of Siemens Energy.

providers.name: FMC Technologies (now TechnipFMC)
providers.description: FMC Technologies was a Houston-based energy services and equipment company serving the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly subsea, surface, and measurement solutions for hydrocarbon production. In January 2017 FMC Technologies completed its merger with Technip to form TechnipFMC, a global energy services company serving the subsea, surface, and offshore project markets. This repository tracks the legacy FMC Technologies brand and any successor APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with the merged TechnipFMC entity. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published.

providers.name: Johnson Controls
providers.description: Johnson Controls is a global diversified technology and multi-industrial leader serving customers in over 150 countries, providing products, services, and solutions for buildings (HVAC, fire, security, building automation), energy storage, and connected building platforms (Metasys, OpenBlue). No public, self-service developer portal or OpenAPI is currently published; partner and customer integrations are typically delivered through the OpenBlue and Metasys product lines.

providers.name: Newcleo
providers.description: Newcleo is a nuclear energy company founded in September 2021 by Stefano Buono, Luciano Cinotti and Elisabeth Rizzotti, headquartered in Paris with operations across France, Italy, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Belgium and Slovakia. It designs small modular lead-cooled fast reactors (LFR) fuelled with mixed oxide (MOX) fuel made from reprocessed spent nuclear fuel, with the aim of closing the nuclear fuel cycle and reducing long-lived waste. The group employs roughly 1,000 people, has raised over EUR 780 million, and has grown by acquisition (Hydromine Nuclear Energy, SRS-Fucina, Rutschi Group). Newcleo publishes no public developer API or developer program; its only public machine-consumable software is a small set of open-source scientific Python libraries released through its newcleo-dev-team GitHub organisation.

providers.name: onsemi
providers.description: ON Semiconductor (now branded as onsemi) is a global supplier of semiconductor-based solutions for power efficiency, image sensing, and signal processing in automotive, industrial, and other applications. No public APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: Mativ Holdings
providers.description: Mativ Holdings is a global leader in specialty materials and a Fortune 1000 company, manufacturing engineered films, filtration media, release liners, protective solutions, and other performance materials for filtration, healthcare, packaging, infrastructure, and industrial applications. Mativ does not publish a public developer portal or external API.

providers.name: TSMC
providers.description: The world's largest dedicated semiconductor foundry manufacturing chips for leading technology companies. Produces the most advanced processor chips used in smartphones, data centers, and AI applications for clients including Apple, NVIDIA, and AMD.

providers.name: Resideo Technologies
providers.description: Profile for Resideo Technologies in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 548).

regulatory.note: provider declares no identity tags; regime could not be determined

providers.name: AccuPulse Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
providers.description: AccuPulse Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (Suzhou AccuPulse, 艾科脉) is a cardiac electrophysiology medical device company in Suzhou Industrial Park, Jiangsu, China, founded in November 2020 to treat atrial fibrillation with non-thermal ablation. It is developing a pulsed electric field ablation (PFA) system — the AccuBlator generator and AccuPulse catheter — using high-voltage fields to induce irreversible electroporation in endocardial cells instead of the thermal injury caused by radiofrequency and cryoablation, plus Accu-System, a 3D cardiac electroanatomic mapping and navigation platform with magnetic/electrical localization and high-channel intracardiac EGM acquisition. The founding team came out of Johnson & Johnson, GE, Abbott, Acutus Medical and MicroPort, with R&D in China and the United States. AccuPulse sells regulated devices to hospitals; it runs no developer program and publishes no public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: AeroShield
providers.description: AeroShield (AeroShield Materials, Inc.) is a Waltham, Massachusetts materials science company spun out of MIT in 2019 that has developed and scaled the world's most transparent silica aerogel. Its ultra-clear aerogel sheets are laminated into insulated glass units so that a standard double-pane window or door can outperform a triple pane while remaining thinner and lighter, boosting thermal efficiency by up to 65%. The company sells business-to-business to window, door and skylight manufacturers rather than to consumers, operates a pilot manufacturing facility in Waltham, and was selected for a $14.5M ARPA-E award. It publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API artifacts; this profile records that absence.

providers.name: Amphiform
providers.description: Amphiform is an energy technology company redefining the future of energy by developing new materials and manufacturing processes that create clean, abundant, and dense energy sources. Rather than scaling existing technologies, Amphiform engineers entirely new materials using precise manufacturing tools to address energy demands for decarbonization, computing, and space exploration. A General Catalyst portfolio company in the energy-infrastructure sector, it is pre-product and does not currently publish any public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Bemis
providers.description: Bemis Company, Inc. was a global leader in developing and producing flexible packaging solutions for food, beverage, and pharmaceutical applications. Founded in 1858 and headquartered in Neenah, Wisconsin, Bemis completed a $6.8 billion merger with Amcor Limited in June 2019, creating the global leader in consumer packaging. The combined entity operates as Amcor, and the Bemis brand continues as Bemis Manufacturing for FDA-compliant healthcare and pharmaceutical packaging, serving customers across 50+ countries with ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certified manufacturing operations.

providers.name: Benchmark Electronics
providers.description: Benchmark Electronics, Inc. is an advanced electronics engineering and manufacturing services (EMS) company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. The company provides integrated design, engineering, and manufacturing services from prototypes to high-volume production, including procurement, logistics, and repair. Benchmark serves original equipment manufacturers in defense, medical technologies, commercial aerospace, industrial, next-gen communications, advanced computing, and semiconductor capital equipment markets. The company operates approximately 22 locations in 8 countries with around 13,000 employees.

providers.name: BioOrbit
providers.description: BioOrbit is a London-based in-space manufacturing company, founded in 2023, that uses microgravity to crystallise protein-based biologic drugs at scale. Its autonomous BOX hardware — a compact, microwave-sized manufacturing unit designed to operate in low-Earth orbit — grows highly ordered crystalline forms of therapeutic proteins that reduce viscosity, enabling treatments normally given intravenously (including cancer therapies) to be reformulated as subcutaneous, self-injectable products. Co-founded by Dr Katie King and Dr Leonor Teles, BioOrbit raised the world's largest seed round for in-space manufacturing (~£9.8M / $13.2M) co-led by LocalGlobe and Breega with Seedcamp, Auxxo, Type One, 7percent and angels, and is supported by the UK Space Agency, ESA BIC and ESA BSGN. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Seedcamp portfolio company; it publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: BTR New Material Group
providers.description: BTR New Material Group Co., Ltd. (贝特瑞新材料集团股份有限公司) is a globally leading supplier of lithium-ion battery materials headquartered in China. The company produces anode materials for high-capacity batteries across soft-pack, aluminum-shell, and cylindrical formats; cathode materials for consumer electronics, power tools, energy storage, and electric vehicles; and advanced new materials used in smartphones, tablets, PCs, and displays. BTR operates a central research institute of roughly 50,000 square meters staffed by about 900 researchers. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. BTR is a materials manufacturer and publishes no developer API, documentation portal, or SDK surface; this profile captures its public web and domain-security footprint.

providers.name: Cencorp
providers.description: Cencorp (Zhuhai) Industrial Technology Co., Ltd. is a process-automation equipment manufacturer that designs and builds high-end laser processing, dispensing, automated optical inspection (AOI), and system-integration & automation systems for the consumer electronics, automotive electronics, semiconductor, and new-energy industries. Formed in 2020 and combining the acquired Finland-based Cencorp automation business with operations headquartered in Zhuhai, China, the company runs 12 offices worldwide with 400+ R&D engineers and 300+ patents, and is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — this is a physical automation-equipment business.

providers.name: Collaborative Robotics
providers.description: Collaborative Robotics (Cobot) is a Physical AI company founded by Brad Porter building AI-powered collaborative robots that work safely alongside people. Its flagship robot, Proxie, is a human-capable mobile manipulator designed to address labor shortages across warehousing, manufacturing, logistics, and healthcare. The company uses ScoutMap to analyze facility operations and identify automation opportunities, then deploys robots that learn real-world workflow patterns. Backed by General Catalyst, Collaborative Robotics is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it is a hardware / Physical AI provider with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Curtiss-Wright
providers.description: Curtiss-Wright is a global integrated business that provides highly engineered products, solutions, and services mainly to the aerospace, defense, commercial power, process, and general industrial markets. Its product portfolio spans rugged embedded computing, mission-critical avionics, electronic packaging, naval propulsion, reactor coolant pumps for nuclear power, surface treatment services, industrial valves, sensors, data acquisition systems, telemetry ground stations, emergency arresting systems for military aircraft, and electronic systems for naval shipbuilding programs. The company traces its lineage to the aviation pioneers Glenn Curtiss and the Wright brothers and today operates across the Defense Electronics, Naval & Power, and Aerospace & Industrial segments.

providers.name: Electroflow
providers.description: Electroflow Technologies is a United States deep-tech company (founded 2023, headquartered in San Bruno, California) developing an electrochemical direct lithium extraction (DLE) process that pulls lithium from dilute North American brines containing under 200ppm lithium using renewable electricity and minimal chemicals. Its cell uses anodes that absorb lithium ions from brine on one pass and release them into a carbonate solution on the reverse pass, producing battery-grade lithium carbonate that is reacted with iron and phosphate to make lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cathode powder domestically — a three-step route versus the traditional ten-step process, targeting LFP material at roughly 40% below Chinese producers. The company raised a $10M seed round in October 2025 led by Union Square Ventures with Voyager Ventures, Fifty Years, and Harpoon Ventures, and counts Breakthrough Energy among its backers. Electroflow is a hardware and battery-materials company; it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signal only.

providers.name: Elevation Spine
providers.description: Elevation Spine is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Monterey, California, founded in 2015, that designs and manufactures integrated-fixation spinal implants. Its Saber platform combines interbody support with in-line spike or screw fixation in a single construct; the flagship Saber-C anterior cervical fusion system is a zero-profile ACDF device cleared as an anterior cervical plate, and the company received FDA 510(k) clearance for Saber-C AVIA, a porous 3D-printed titanium interbody, in July 2026. Elevation Spine sells physical surgical implants and instrumentation to hospitals and surgeons through distributors; it operates a Webflow marketing site and a customer login portal, and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Fla
providers.description: FLA Orthopedics (FLA Holdings) is a United States-based manufacturer of orthopedic, sports medicine, and bracing products, including supports, braces, splints, and soft-goods for the medical, clinical, and consumer health markets. Canaan Partners invested in FLA Holdings at the Series D stage; the company was surfaced through that portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. FLA Orthopedics is a physical medical-device maker and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile is identity-only and carries no API artifacts.

providers.name: Fujian Deer Technology
providers.description: Fujian Deer Technology (福建德尔科技股份有限公司) is a Chinese specialty-chemicals manufacturer founded in June 2014 and headquartered in the Jiaoyang Industrial Concentration Zone, Shanghang County, Longyan City, Fujian Province. The company pursues a full fluorine-chemistry industry-chain strategy, researching, producing and selling basic chemical materials, fluorine-containing electronic gases, high-purity semiconductor wet electronic chemicals, new-energy (lithium battery) materials and other fluorinated advanced materials. Its electronic-grade gases include trifluoromethane, carbon tetrafluoride, sulfur hexafluoride, hexafluoroethane, chlorine trifluoride and octafluorocyclobutane, supplied into semiconductor chips, LED chips, flat-panel displays, communications optical fibre, power and energy-storage batteries, ultra-high-voltage transmission and transformation, and photovoltaic power generation. It is a designated national high-tech enterprise and is privately held; its shares appear on secondary-market venues. It manufactures physical materials and publishes no public API, developer program or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: GCL
providers.description: GCL System Integration Technology Co., Ltd. (GCL SI, Shenzhen: 002506) is one of the four listed companies of China's GCL Group and a global leading provider of photovoltaic and clean-energy solutions. Headquartered in Suzhou Industrial Park, Jiangsu Province, the company manufactures high-efficiency solar cells, large-size photovoltaic modules, energy-storage systems, and next-generation perovskite solar technology, with operations spanning six continents. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; GCL SI is an industrial manufacturer and publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: GlassPoint
providers.description: GlassPoint is an industrial solar process heat company founded in 2009 that designs, builds, owns and operates enclosed-trough solar thermal systems delivering steam to industrial customers under a Steam-as-a-Service model. Its enclosed trough places mirrors inside a glasshouse to cut capital cost and wind loading, and it has delivered commercial solar process steam since the Amal project in Oman went online in 2012, followed by Miraah and the Ma'aden Solar I project in Saudi Arabia. The company sells decarbonized industrial heat and energy plants, not software: it operates a marketing and press site at glasspoint.com and publishes no developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Graham Holdings
providers.description: Graham Holdings (NYSE: GHC) is a diversified holding company with operations in education, television broadcasting, digital media, manufacturing, healthcare, automotive, restaurants, and custom framing. Principal subsidiaries include Kaplan (educational services), Graham Media Group and Social News Desk (broadcasting and social media tools), The Slate Group and Foreign Policy (digital publishing), Code3 and City Cast (digital marketing and local news), Hoover Treated Wood Products, Joyce/Dayton, Group Dekko, and Forney (manufacturing), Graham Healthcare Group (home health and hospice), Graham Automotive (dealerships), Clyde's Restaurant Group (including Old Ebbitt Grill), and Framebridge (online custom framing). No public developer APIs have been identified across the portfolio.

providers.name: Hubbell
providers.description: Hubbell is a global manufacturer of high-quality electrical and electronic products for non-residential and residential construction, industrial, and utility applications. The company has provided trusted infrastructure solutions since 1888 across power and utilities, lighting and controls, wiring and electrical, and datacom product categories serving commercial, data center, industrial, healthcare, telecom, and water and gas markets.

providers.name: Jinsheng New Energy
providers.description: Guangdong Jinsheng New Energy Co., Ltd. (广东金晟新能源股份有限公司) is a Chinese lithium-battery recycling and materials company headquartered in Zhaoqing, Guangdong, founded in 2010 and originally focused on nickel sulfate production. It operates a closed-loop "urban mine" business: harmless treatment, echelon (second-life) use and hydrometallurgical regeneration of retired lithium-ion batteries into battery-grade nickel sulfate, cobalt sulfate, manganese sulfate and lithium carbonate, plus ternary and iron-phosphate precursors and LFP cathode material, and downstream cells for light mobility, commercial and industrial storage, outdoor power stations and solar street lighting. Production is split across Zhaoqing (Gaoyao) in Guangdong and Yichun/Ganzhou in Jiangxi through the wholly owned subsidiary Jiangxi Ruida New Energy Technology, with approved processing capacity of about 204,000 tonnes of spent lithium battery per year. Both the parent and Jiangxi Ruida appear on MIIT's echelon-use and regeneration white lists. The company completed a Series C, is a Hurun and Forbes unicorn-list member, and has pursued a public listing. It is an industrial materials manufacturer and publishes no developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Linear Labs
providers.description: Linear Labs is an industrial motor technology company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, building high-torque motor systems for wind, nuclear, pumps, actuators, mining, and defense applications.
